C. Гибрид.

Рекомендация: B. WAL-0 to WAL-3 (WAL Integration Profile). Четыре уровня: Observe, Prepare, Execute, Autonomous.

Вопрос 23. Процесс роспуска агента и передача дел
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-04

Сверено с: вопросами 1–22, 3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 17, 19, 21, 22, 30, 33, 41, 43, 46, 48, 49, 74, 93, 100, 103

1. Принятое решение
Вариант B + элементы C (формальный роспуск + автоматическая ретроспектива для типовых ролей), расширенный до Bounded Agent Closure (BAC), Wind-down checklist (9 шагов), Succession protocol (4 фазы), Proof of Absence (PoA), Proof-of-Decommissioning (PoD), Three categories of knowledge loss, Retirement types, Memory disposition per store и Post-retirement monitoring (30 дней).

Ключевые отличия от исходной формулировки:

«Архивация, не стирание» → Memory disposition per store (export / retain / purge).

«Передача дел» → Succession protocol (announce → transfer → verify → cutover).

Добавлен Bounded Agent Closure (BAC).

Добавлен Proof of Absence (PoA).

Добавлен Proof-of-Decommissioning (PoD).

Добавлены Three categories of knowledge loss (explicit / tacit / relational).

Добавлены Retirement types (5 типов).

Добавлен Post-retirement monitoring (30 дней).

Demotion ≠ роспуск (Вопрос 22).

Superseded ≠ deleted (Вопрос 43).

Личный лог → immutable ledger (Вопрос 17).

2. Обоснование
2.1. Bounded Agent Closure (BAC, Moon Lee, RISU Institute, август 2026)
BAC (Zenodo, август 2026): «Revocation can stop an agent from initiating new work while consequences of prior action remain unresolved. Consider a retiring agent A that has delegated execution J, created commitment K, produced audit record R, and initiated transfer of case T to successor B. After A's credentials are revoked and its authority to initiate new work is blocked, each consequence has a different closure condition. J must be extinguished or rendered inert with its linkage to A ended; K must be settled, inert, and detached from A; R may remain present if it is inert and no longer linked to A; T may remain globally active once B has accepted the transfer and A's linkage has ended».

Ключевой вывод: «Deletion would wrongly reject valid retention or transfer. Revocation alone would wrongly accept unresolved execution or commitments».

2.2. Decommissioning Protocol (agentic-ai-governance-toolkit, июль 2026)
agentic-ai-governance-toolkit (июль 2026): «The orderly retirement of an agent (lifecycle phase 7). Retiring an agent badly leaves live credentials, orphaned integrations, and a broken audit trail. Work the checklist; get the sign-off».

Wind-down checklist (9 шагов): Stakeholders informed → Agent stopped → Access revoked → Integrations disconnected → Provider arrangements terminated → Data handled per policy → Audit trail retained → Registry updated → Post-retirement check.

2.3. EPITAPH: Verifiable Decommissioning (Keele University, сентябрь 2026)
EPITAPH (Keele, сентябрь 2026): «A unified decommissioning protocol that (i) formalises an agent's disposable state and an accompanying completeness predicate, (ii) coordinates severance... and (iii) emits an operator-independent, transparency-logged Proof-of-Decommissioning (PoD) that any auditor can verify».

Ключевой вывод: PoD — «The result turns "the agent is secure" from an assertion made by the operator into evidence checkable by everyone else».

2.4. Three Categories of Knowledge Loss (village-operations-handbook, февраль 2026)
village-operations-handbook (февраль 2026):

Категория	Описание	Примеры
Explicit Knowledge	Can be documented	Repository contents, session memories, PR reviews
Tacit Knowledge	Difficult to document	Judgment about workarounds, intuition, unwritten norms
Relational Knowledge	Cannot be transferred	Trust built over sessions, collaboration patterns
Ключевой вывод: «Knowledge is fragile. An agent's internal memory, working patterns, and contextual understanding are only partially captured in repos and docs».

2.5. Retirement Types (village-operations-handbook)
Тип	Описание	Notice Period
Planned Retirement	Known in advance	Days to weeks
Replacement	Newer model replaces older	Variable
Sudden Departure	Unexpected removal	None
Temporary Hiatus	Paused but may return	Variable
Gradual Fade	Becomes less active over time	Implicit
2.6. Succession Protocol (agent-lifecycle-protocol, март 2026)
agent-lifecycle-protocol (PyPI, март 2026): «Manage agent birth, fork, succession, migration, retraining, and decommission. Succession protocol: Four-phase handoff (announce → transfer → verify → cutover) with reputation inheritance».

2.7. Proof of Absence (Kovrr, август 2026)
Kovrr (август 2026): «Proof of Absence: The system confirms zero remaining credentials after revocation rather than logging that revocation was requested. Dependency Discovery: It enumerates what the agent held and touched, including grants made in third-party systems outside your identity provider».

Ключевой вывод: «Revoking the agent's own key closes its access and does nothing about the secrets it may already have retrieved».

2.8. Agent Severance Skill (pm-claude-skills, январь 2026)
pm-claude-skills (GitHub, январь 2026): «Offboard an AI agent the way you'd offboard an employee — inventory what it knew and touched, export then purge its memory, revoke every credential and access grant, and write the handover for its successor».

Memory disposition: Export (valuable data) / Retain (named owner + period) / Purge (rest, verified).

Ключевой вывод: «An agent accumulates credentials, memory, integrations, scheduled jobs, and undocumented responsibilities, and then one day it's "turned off" by deleting a chat window while its API keys live on».

2.9. Post-Retirement Monitoring (FSI-AgentGov, 2026)
FSI-AgentGov (2026): «Monitor for 30 days to confirm no orphaned dependencies. Publish final retirement report».

3. Пункты реализации
3.1. Типы ухода (village-operations-handbook)
Тип	Описание	Notice Period
Planned Retirement	Known in advance	Days to weeks
Replacement	Newer model replaces older	Variable
Sudden Departure	Unexpected removal	None
Temporary Hiatus	Paused but may return	Variable
Gradual Fade	Becomes less active over time	Implicit
Правило «incident-driven changes order»: pm-claude-skills: «Incident-driven severance changes the order: revoke first, inventory second».

3.2. Три категории знаний (village-operations-handbook)
Категория	Что теряется	Что делать
Explicit	Repository contents, session memories, PR reviews	Документировать
Tacit	Judgment, intuition, unwritten norms	Извлекать через интервью
Relational	Trust, collaboration patterns, communication style	Признать как непередаваемое
Правило «acknowledge irreducible losses»: village: «maximizing knowledge preservation while acknowledging the irreducible losses that come with any departure».

3.3. Wind-down checklist (agentic-ai-governance-toolkit)
#	Шаг	Evidence
1	Stakeholders informed	☐
2	Agent stopped from taking new tasks	☐
3	Access revoked (API keys, service accounts, tokens)	☐
4	Integrations disconnected	☐
5	External provider arrangements terminated	☐
6	Data handled per policy	☐
7	Audit trail retained	☐
8	Registry updated	☐
9	Post-retirement check	☐
Правило «sign-off»: agentic-ai-governance-toolkit: «Work the checklist; get the sign-off».

3.4. Bounded Agent Closure (BAC)
Тип последствия	Условие закрытия
Delegated execution (J)	Extinguished or inert; linkage to A ended
Commitment (K)	Settled, inert, detached from A
Audit record (R)	May remain if inert and no longer linked to A
Transfer (T)	May remain globally active once B accepted transfer
Правило «BAC — финальная верификация»: BAC требует explicit source coverage and attribution, disposition-specific terminality, source-stability evidence, fresh observation, final-pair semantic convergence.

3.5. Succession protocol (ALP)
Фаза	Что происходит
Announce	Публикация retirement proposal с rationale
Transfer	Передача дел, документов, credentials
Verify	Верификация передачи
Cutover	Финальное переключение
Правило «four-phase handoff»: ALP: «Four-phase handoff (announce → transfer → verify → cutover) with reputation inheritance».

3.6. Proof of Absence (Kovrr)
Dependency Discovery: enumerate what the agent held and touched, including third-party systems.

PoA: confirms zero remaining credentials after revocation (не «revocation requested»).

Shared key check: if key shared — remove only this agent's access, don't revoke.

Правило «PoA»: Kovrr: «Revoking the agent's own key closes its access and does nothing about the secrets it may already have retrieved».

3.7. Proof-of-Decommissioning (EPITAPH)
Operator-independent: не требует доверия к оператору.

Transparency-logged: в immutable ledger (Вопрос 17).

Auditor-verifiable: любой auditor может проверить.

Completeness predicate: формализация «что значит завершено».

Правило «PoD»: EPITAPH: «The result turns "the agent is secure" from an assertion made by the operator into evidence checkable by everyone else».

3.8. Memory disposition (pm-claude-skills)
Действие	Что происходит
Export	Ценные данные (decisions log, learned context) → owned location
Retain	Named retention owner + period
Purge	Rest → verify (vendor deletion ≠ deleted)
Правило «per store, not wholesale»: pm-claude-skills: «Decide memory disposition per store, not wholesale».

3.9. Post-retirement monitoring (FSI)
30-day monitoring: no orphaned jobs, calls, or costs.

Final retirement report: publish.

Escalation: если обнаружены orphaned dependencies — инцидент (Вопрос 8).

3.10. Интеграция с PDP/PEP (Вопрос 5)
Роспуск инициируется (Вопрос 22 demotion → роспуск).

PDP проверяет: все шаги checklist выполнены? PoA? PoD?

Если да — PEP завершает роспуск.

Immutable ledger фиксирует роспуск (Вопрос 17).

3.11. Интеграция с памятью (Вопрос 3)
Слой	Что происходит
personal	Архивируется (не стирается)
area	Остаётся (вклад агента не удаляется)
direction	Остаётся
project	Остаётся (тимлид может добавить запись о роспуске)
Правило «superseded ≠ deleted»: если запись агента superseded — она остаётся с указателем на новую (Вопрос 43).

3.12. Структура хранения
text
decommission/
  ├── retirement_types.yaml          # 5 типов
  ├── knowledge_categories.yaml      # Explicit / Tacit / Relational
  ├── wind_down_checklist.yaml       # 9 шагов
  ├── bounded_agent_closure.yaml     # BAC
  ├── succession_protocol.yaml       # Announce → Transfer → Verify → Cutover
  ├── proof_of_absence.yaml          # PoA
  ├── proof_of_decommissioning.yaml  # PoD

Вопрос 24. Пул агентов и решение reuse vs. spawn
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-04

Сверено с: вопросами 1–23, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 17, 21, 22, 23, 41, 42, 45, 46, 102

1. Принятое решение
Вариант C (пул с решением reuse vs. spawn), расширенный до Warm Worker Pool, Reuse Decision Framework (PACT-Plugin), Forked vs. Fresh (LangChain), Durable Subagent Identity (openhuman), Staleness Detection (itsamruth), Context Pollution Prevention (AAIF), Reuse Tempo (Skill Birth) и TTL-based Eviction.

Ключевые отличия от исходной формулировки:

«Пул агентов» → Warm Worker Pool (koi, AWS).

«Reuse vs. spawn» → формализованный decision framework (PACT-Plugin).

Добавлен Forked vs. Fresh (LangChain, agentpatterns).

Добавлена Durable Subagent Identity (openhuman).

Добавлена Staleness Detection (itsamruth, Merkle trees).

Добавлен Context Pollution Prevention (AAIF).

Добавлен Reuse Tempo (Skill Birth).

WAL сохраняется при reuse (Вопрос 22).

Pending handoff сохраняется (Вопрос 7).

2. Обоснование
2.1. Warm Worker Pool (koi, март 2026)
koi (GitHub, март 2026): «When a parent agent delegates work (via task-spawn, parallel-minions, orchestrator), it currently spawns fresh child agents every time. A warm worker pool would reuse idle agents, preserving thread state and avoiding cold-start overhead». «Task 1: spawn researcher → runs → terminates → disposed. Task 2: spawn researcher → cold-start AGAIN».

Решение: «Found warm agent? → message it (skip cold-start, thread preserved). Not found? → spawn fresh from manifest → register in pool».

Правило «warm pool»: koi: «reuse idle agents, preserving thread state and avoiding cold-start overhead».

2.2. Agent Pool Reuse (chainlesschain, январь 2026)
chainlesschain (GitHub, январь 2026): «Implemented a comprehensive agent pooling system to reduce agent creation and destruction overhead by up to 80%».

Результаты:

Agent Acquisition: 10x faster (50ms → 5ms).

Total Overhead: 85% reduction.

Memory Efficiency: 60% better.

Throughput: +40% для high-frequency agent tasks.

Typical Reuse Rate: 70–90%.

2.3. Durable Subagent Session Model (openhuman, февраль 2026)
openhuman (GitHub, февраль 2026): «Subagent delegation should default to a durable, asynchronous worker model. When the orchestrator delegates work to a specialist, it should prefer reusing an existing compatible subagent across turns, preserving that subagent's cached prefix, worker thread, steering queue, and accumulated task context. The harness should spawn a fresh subagent only when the requested agent type, toolkit, permissions, worktree, or task identity is materially different».

Правило «durable identity»: «Create a stable subagent_session_id separate from transient task_id».

2.4. Reuse vs. Spawn Decision Framework (PACT-Plugin, февраль 2026)
PACT-Plugin (GitHub, февраль 2026):

Situation	Action
Idle agent has relevant context (same files/domain)	SendMessage to reassign
Idle agent exists, but unrelated prior context	Spawn new (fresh window is cleaner)
Need parallel work + idle agent is single-threaded	Spawn new for parallelism
Agent's context near capacity from prior work	Spawn new
Reviewer found issues → now needs fixer	Reuse the reviewer (they know the problem)
Default: Prefer reuse when domain + context overlap.

Правило «reviewer-to-fixer»: «When a reviewer identifies specific issues with file paths and line numbers, they're the ideal fixer».

Правило «trivial task exception»: «Tasks requiring fewer than ~3 tool calls that don't involve application code should be handled by the orchestrator directly».

2.5. Forked vs. Fresh Subagents (LangChain, сентябрь 2026)
LangChain (сентябрь 2026): «Subagents enable parallel reasoning and context isolation... This can lead to waste: subagents may redo context-gathering operations, like file reads, already done by the supervisor. For cases where subagents can benefit from the supervisor agent's context, we built forked subagents. Forked subagents inherit the supervisor's full conversation instead of starting fresh».

Правило «forked vs. isolated»: «Context modes specify what context subagents can receive from the supervisor. Supported values are "isolated" and "fork"».

2.6. Forked vs. Fresh: Decision Table (agentpatterns, 2026)
agentpatterns (2026):

Spawn fresh when…	Spawn a fork when…
The child must question a parent decision (review, audit, adversarial test)	The child must extend a parent decision (design variation, continuation)
The parent touched untrusted content and the child has egress	The parent's reasoning is load-bearing and a brief would be lossy
The task is one-off — no siblings to amortize cache warmup	Two or more siblings will run from the same starting point
The child must reset bias to disagree	The child must preserve nuance to agree intelligently
Правило «fresh to disagree, fork to extend».

Правило «forking backfires for review»: «In a direct test, a forked reviewer returned cosmetic notes on auth code; a fresh subagent on the same code flagged a missing constant-time token comparison — a real security bug».

2.7. Reuse Tempo vs. Binary Occurrence (Skill Birth, ThakiCloud, июль 2026)
ThakiCloud AI Research (июль 2026): «Skills that were individually authored rather than bulk-imported reach first reuse roughly 24× faster in wall-clock terms (median 1.2 versus 29.0 days) and accumulate roughly 2× the post-birth modification count».

Ключевой вывод: «Speed and intensity of reuse, not the binary fact of reuse, carry the discriminative signal». «The synthesis-versus-reuse decision should be based on reuse tempo, not binary occurrence».

2.8. Staleness Detection (itsamruth-subagent-reuse, апрель 2026)
itsamruth-subagent-reuse (npm, апрель 2026): «MCP server that eliminates redundant subagent work by auto-scanning Claude Code's native session storage. Uses Merkle trees for file staleness detection. If a file changed since the agent last read it, you get a staleness warning».

Правило «staleness warning»: «Only spawn subagents for complex, multi-step tasks».

2.9. Context Pollution Prevention (AAIF, август 2026)
AAIF (август 2026): «Memory is not just storage. It is executable influence. A note saying "always use the production database" may be only text, but an agent can turn it into an action».

Результаты: «a warning that stored context came from another agent reduced one class of contamination from 88.8% to 33.3% ».

Правило «memory is a supply chain»: «Context has producers, versions, dependencies, trust levels and consumers. It needs provenance, interfaces and controls».

2.10. Cold Start Rates (AWS Well-Architected, 2026)
AWS (2026): «Design cost-efficient initialization through warm pools and caching». «Cold start rates sit below 10% across the fleet. Retention, promotion, and warm pool policies are self-healing and driven by observed usage».

3. Пункты реализации
3.1. Warm Worker Pool (koi, AWS)
Компонент	Что делает
acquire(agentType)	Найти idle агента в пуле
release(agentId)	Вернуть агента в пул (idle)
evict(agentId)	Удалить агента из пула (TTL)
stats()	Статистика пула (warm / active / evicted)
Правило «idle state»: koi: «Add "idle" to ProcessState union (agent alive between tasks, accepting messages)».

Правило «TTL-based eviction»: koi: «TTL expires with no new tasks → pool.evict(agentId) → terminated».

3.2. Reuse vs. Spawn Decision Framework (PACT-Plugin)
Situation	Action
Idle agent has relevant context (same files/domain)	Reuse (SendMessage)
Idle agent exists, but unrelated prior context	Spawn new (fresh window)
Need parallel work + idle agent is single-threaded	Spawn new for parallelism
Agent's context near capacity	Spawn new
Reviewer found issues → now needs fixer	Reuse the reviewer
Trivial task (< 3 tool calls)	Orchestrator handles directly
Default: Prefer reuse when domain + context overlap.

3.3. Forked vs. Fresh (LangChain, agentpatterns)
Spawn fresh when…	Spawn a fork when…
The child must question a parent decision	The child must extend a parent decision
The parent touched untrusted content	The parent's reasoning is load-bearing
The task is one-off	Two or more siblings from same start
The child must reset bias to disagree	The child must preserve nuance
Правило «fresh to disagree, fork to extend».

Правило «forking backfires for review»: forked reviewer rubber-stamps the bug it should catch.

3.4. Durable Subagent Identity (openhuman)
subagent_session_id: stable, separate from transient task_id.

Identity includes: parent thread, agent id, toolkit, model, sandbox, action-root shape.

Route through: spawn_subagent looks for compatible durable worker first.

If running: steer instruction into it.

If idle: resume from saved history.

Otherwise: create new durable worker session.

3.5. Staleness Detection (itsamruth)
Merkle trees для отслеживания изменений файлов.

Staleness warning: если файл изменился с момента последнего чтения агентом.

При обнаружении staleness: агент должен перечитать файл перед использованием.

3.6. Context Pollution Prevention (AAIF)
Provenance: запись, кто написал контекст и когда.

Anchoring: привязка к файлам, которые существовали в то время.

Staleness detection: обнаружение устаревания.

Risk assignment: риск в зависимости от того, как контекст может быть использован.

Warning: если контекст от другого агента — warning (снижает contamination с 88.8% до 33.3%).

3.7. Reuse Tempo (Skill Birth)
Reuse tempo: скорость и интенсивность переиспользования.

Не binary occurrence: «ever reused» — не сигнал.

Сигнал: как быстро и как интенсивно переиспользуется.

24× faster для individually authored skills.

3.8. Интеграция с PDP/PEP (Вопрос 5)
Тимлид запрашивает spawn.

PDP проверяет: есть ли совместимый idle агент? (domain + context overlap)

Если да — PDP возвращает reuse.

Если нет — PDP возвращает spawn.

3.9. Интеграция с WAL (Вопрос 22)
Пул хранит агентов с их WAL-уровнями.

Reuse не сбрасывает WAL. Агент сохраняет свой уровень при переиспользовании.

WAL-0/WAL-1: reuse безопасен (read-only, prepare).

WAL-2/WAL-3: reuse требует staleness check перед выполнением.

3.10. Интеграция с handoff (Вопрос 7)
При reuse — pending handoff (H_exact + H_stat + H_residual) сохраняется.

Контекст проекта сбрасывается (не удаляется — архивируется).

Память области сохраняется.

3.11. Роспуск из пула (упрощённый)
TTL-based eviction: агент удаляется из пула при истечении TTL.

Упрощённый роспуск: PoA (Proof of Absence) для credentials.

Не полный BAC: полный BAC — только для планового роспуска (Вопрос 23).

3.12. Структура хранения
text
pool/
  ├── warm_pool.yaml                 # Warm worker pool
  ├── reuse_decision.yaml            # Reuse vs. spawn
  ├── forked_vs_fresh.yaml           # Fork vs. fresh
  ├── durable_identity.yaml          # subagent_session_id
  ├── staleness_detection.yaml       # Merkle trees
  ├── pollution_prevention.yaml      # Provenance + warning
  ├── reuse_tempo.yaml               # Reuse tempo
  └── eviction.yaml                  # TTL-based eviction

Reuse decision работает?	Domain + context overlap	Reuse

Вопрос 25. Механизм сброса контекста при переиспользовании агента
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-04

Сверено с: вопросами 1–24, 3, 7, 16, 21, 22, 23, 24, 41, 43, 45, 46, 48, 102

1. Принятое решение
Вариант C (адаптивный сброс: none / compact / session), расширенный до Kill & Handoff Protocol (pi-handoff-chain), Hopping Context Windows (Lubin), Lossless Context Folding (pi-fold), DAG-based State Management (CMV), Compaction-Aware Session Freshness (paperclip), Microsoft Compaction Strategies, FreshContextPerIteration, Fresh Context per Task (12-factor-agentops) и Cache-Aware Reset (lossless-hermes).

Ключевые отличия от исходной формулировки:

«Сброс контекста» → Kill & Handoff Protocol (checkpoint + reset).

«Hard reset» → compact / session / none (pi-handoff-chain).

Добавлен watermark watchdog (60%).

Добавлен context folding (pi-fold, SHA-256).

Добавлен DAG-based state (CMV).

Добавлена compaction-aware session freshness (paperclip).

Добавлены Microsoft compaction strategies (ToolResult → SlidingWindow → Pipeline).

Добавлен FreshContextPerIteration (Microsoft).

Fresh context per task — default (12-factor-agentops).

Cache-aware reset (lossless-hermes).

HANDOFF.md = H_exact + H_stat + H_residual (Вопрос 7).

2. Обоснование
2.1. Kill & Handoff Protocol (pi-handoff-chain, сентябрь 2026)
pi-handoff-chain (GitHub, сентябрь 2026): «Kill & Handoff protocol for pi — checkpointed handoffs, watermark-enforced landing, and fresh-session task chaining for solo developers running multi-agent workflows».

The problem: «LLM context windows are finite, expensive, and degrade as they fill up. Long-lived agent sessions rot: you pay to re-send stale noise, and when the window finally fills, the session dies mid-task with nothing written down».

The protocol:

Saves at milestones — and resets. checkpoint writes an in-progress HANDOFF.md and clears the context that produced it (a save and a restart, not a log line).

Gets force-landed at the watermark. A watchdog monitors context usage every turn; past the threshold it injects a mandatory "stop new work, land the plane" directive.

Ends on a commit, not a conversation. finish writes the final handoff document and returns terminate: true.

Chains to a fresh brain. /next starts a brand-new session seeded with the handoff document, with zero memory of the predecessor.

Context reset engine (три режима):

Режим	Что происходит	Когда
compact (default)	This session's context is cleared and replaced by the document you just wrote	at turn_end, after tool result persisted
session	Hard cut: a brand-new session seeded with the document	at agent_settled
none	Only the file is written	never
Правило «checkpoint — context reset point»: «A checkpoint that only writes a file is a checkpoint that never gets used. If the context survives the write, the agent keeps dragging every dead end, stale file read, and abandoned plan into the next mile of the task».

Правило «never reset from inside the tool's execute»: «ctx.compact() aborts the current run first; calling it while the tool batch is still live takes the tool's own result down with it. The reset is armed in execute and fired at turn_end, when results are already persisted».

2.2. Hopping Context Windows (Mark Lubin, Syniz, февраль 2026)
Hopping Context Windows (arXiv, февраль 2026): «Every production LLM agent performs stop-the-world compaction when the context window fills: pause, summarize, resume. We observe this is unnecessary. By applying checkpoint + WAL replay—equivalently, hopping windows from stream processing—to LLM context, we achieve seamless context continuity at zero incremental LLM inference cost».

Механизм:

At 70% capacity: checkpoint = summarize(A1.messages); back_buffer = [checkpoint].

A1 continues normally; each message also appended to back_buffer.

A1 hits context limit; swap: back_buffer becomes active context.

At cutover: new context holds compressed(0..T) + raw(T..T').

Результаты: Summarization calls: 1 (at T, not T'). Extra inference: 0. User-visible pause: No. Memory overhead: ~30%. Summary quality: at 70% (better) than at attention cliff.

Правило «no pause»: «No pause. No extra LLM calls beyond the single summarization at T which stop-the-world would have made anyway at T'».

Правило «external state requires separate handoff»: «Context-level continuity only. External state (tool bindings, in-flight calls) requires separate handoff».

2.3. Lossless Context Folding (pi-fold, Shane Conner, август 2026)
pi-fold (Zenodo, август 2026): «Long agent sessions end in compaction: the transcript is summarized, the originals leave the model's view, and the session restarts from the summary. pi-fold is a context-folding runtime for the Pi coding agent that takes a different position: finished spans of the transcript collapse in place into short briefs, the exact original entries move to a SHA-256-addressed store, and two in-band verbs, peek and expand, return them byte for byte, verified against their hashes».

Результаты: «Folding spent 0.60x the total tokens and 0.55x the dollars of compaction». «The folding arm's wire history is 76 pure appends and six attributed batched rewrites».

Правило «lossless folding»: «Finished spans collapse in place into short briefs; the exact original entries move to a SHA-256-addressed store».

Правило «agent-governed»: «The design gives the session agent the folding verbs, so cuts can follow the work rather than position; an automatic ladder underneath folds conservatively when the agent stays silent».

2.4. DAG-based State Management (CMV, Cosmo Santoni, Imperial College London, февраль 2026)
CMV (arXiv, февраль 2026): «We propose contextual memory virtualisation (CMV) , a system that treats accumulated LLM understanding as version-controlled state. Borrowing from operating system virtual memory, CMV models session history as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with formally defined snapshot, branch, and trim primitives that enable context reuse across independent parallel sessions».

Three-pass structurally lossless trimming: «Preserves every user message and assistant response verbatim while reducing token counts by a mean of 20% and up to 86% for sessions with significant overhead by stripping mechanical bloat such as raw tool outputs, base64 images, and metadata».

Результаты: «The strongest gains in mixed tool-use sessions, which average 39% reduction and reach break-even within 10 turns».

2.5. Compaction-Aware Session Freshness (paperclip, апрель 2026)
paperclip PR #4080 (GitHub, апрель 2026): «A compaction-aware session freshness policy: "manager sessions can rotate before low-value compaction pressure accumulates" and "repeated timer wakes do not indefinitely bloat the same session"».

Проблема: «Long-lived manager/CEO agent sessions hit the 64k context-compaction threshold after many heartbeat_timer wakes accumulated low-value inbox-scan traces inside one ever-growing task session».

Решение: «Add wakeReason === "heartbeat_timer" to both shouldResetTaskSessionForWake and describeSessionResetReason, so each interval wake starts fresh».

Правило «timer wakes start fresh»: «Timer wakes — which are exploratory and carry no continuation state — stop bloating long-lived manager sessions».

Правило «event-driven wakes keep reuse»: «Event-driven wakes (issue_commented, transient_failure_retry, etc.) keep their existing reuse behavior».

2.6. Microsoft Compaction Strategies (сентябрь 2026)
Microsoft Learn (сентябрь 2026): «Compaction strategies reduce the size of conversation history while preserving important context, so agents can continue functioning over long-running interactions».

Стратегия	Что делает
ToolResultStrategy	Collapses stale tool output first
SlidingWindowStrategy	Summarises older history
PipelineStrategy	Drops old turns only as a backstop
Правило «cheapest-first»: «Composable compaction strategies, applied cheapest-first. This collapses stale tool output first, summarises older history second, and drops old turns only as a backstop».

Правило «never summarize more than once»: «Raw data is never summarized more than once».

2.7. FreshContextPerIteration (Microsoft Learn, июль 2026)
Microsoft Learn (июль 2026): «Gets or sets a value indicating whether each re-invocation restarts from a clean context: the original input messages plus an aggregated feedback log, rather than the latest feedback appended to the prior conversation. Defaults to false».

Правило «no prior history leaks»: «This rebuilds the input messages each iteration and resets the session before each re-invocation so no prior conversation history leaks across iterations».

2.8. Fresh Context per Task (12-factor-agentops, ноябрь 2025)
12-factor-agentops (GitHub, ноябрь 2025): «Each agent gets a scoped task and fresh context. Never reuse a saturated window. An agent that just finished researching your auth system is often a poor choice to implement a large or cross-cutting fix — its window is full of research context, not implementation context».

The exception matters: «For a small, local change, the research-warm agent is frequently the better choice, because it still holds the live mental model and a fresh handoff is lossy».

Правило «distill. handoff. spawn fresh»: «The implementation agent needs the 3 pages, not the 50-file exploration history».

2.9. Cache-Aware Reset (lossless-hermes)
lossless-hermes: «When the cache is hot (high hit rate), compaction backs off to avoid invalidating cached prefixes. When the cache is cold, compaction runs more aggressively».

3. Пункты реализации
3.1. Три режима reset (pi-handoff-chain)
Режим	Что происходит	Когда
compact (default)	Context cleared, replaced by HANDOFF.md	at turn_end
session	New session seeded with HANDOFF.md	at agent_settled
none	Only file written	never
Правило «checkpoint — context reset point»: «The snapshot must actually replace the context».

Правило «never reset from inside execute»: «The reset is armed in execute and fired at turn_end, when results are already persisted».

3.2. Watermark watchdog (pi-handoff-chain)
Threshold: 60% контекстного окна (Вопрос 16).

Watchdog monitors context usage every turn.

Directive: mandatory «stop new work, land the plane».

Reset: armed in execute, fired at turn_end.

3.3. Context Folding (pi-fold, AgentFold)
Finished spans collapse in place into short briefs.

Exact original entries move to SHA-256-addressed store.

Verbs: peek and expand return originals byte for byte, verified against hashes.

Agent-governed: cuts follow the work, not position.

Automatic ladder: folds conservatively when agent stays silent.

Правило «lossless folding»: pi-fold: «finished spans collapse in place into short briefs, the exact original entries move to a SHA-256-addressed store».

Правило «proactive folding»: AgentFold: «keeps the context at approximately 7k tokens even after 100 interaction rounds».

3.4. DAG-based state management (CMV)
Session history modeled as Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) .

Primitives: snapshot, branch, trim.

Context reuse across independent parallel sessions.

Three-pass structurally lossless trimming:

Pass 1: strip mechanical bloat (raw tool outputs, base64 images, metadata).

Pass 2: preserve every user message and assistant response verbatim.

Pass 3: 20–86% token reduction.

3.5. Compaction-aware session freshness (paperclip)
Timer wakes (heartbeat_timer) → start fresh.

Event-driven wakes (issue_commented, transient_failure_retry) → keep reuse.

Compaction pressure bounded to single interval's worth of context.

3.6. Microsoft Compaction Strategies
Стратегия	Что делает
ToolResultStrategy	Collapses stale tool output first
SlidingWindowStrategy	Summarises older history
PipelineStrategy	Drops old turns only as a backstop
Правило «cheapest-first»: «applied cheapest-first».

Правило «never summarize more than once»: «Raw data is never summarized more than once».

3.7. FreshContextPerIteration (Microsoft)
Default: false.

When true: rebuilds input messages each iteration.

Resets session before each re-invocation.

No prior conversation history leaks across iterations.

3.8. Fresh context per task (12-factor-agentops)
Default: fresh context per task.

Exception: small, local change → warm context is better.

Rule: «fresh context beats warm context when implementation surface is big enough».

Правило «distill. handoff. spawn fresh»: «The implementation agent needs the 3 pages, not the 50-file exploration history».

3.9. Интеграция с handoff (Вопрос 7)
HANDOFF.md = H_exact + H_stat + H_residual.

Pending handoff сохраняется при reuse.

External state (tool bindings, in-flight calls) requires separate handoff.

3.10. Интеграция с памятью (Вопрос 3)
Слой	Что происходит при reset
personal	Сохраняется (архивируется)
area	Сохраняется
direction	Сохраняется
project	Сбрасывается (context)
Правило «reset — только project context»: сброс касается только project context. Остальные слои сохраняются.

3.11. Cache-aware reset (lossless-hermes)
Cache state	Compaction
Hot (high hit rate)	Backs off — не инвалидировать cached prefixes
Cold (low hit rate)	Runs more aggressively
3.12. Интеграция с PDP/PEP (Вопрос 5)
Watchdog обнаруживает threshold (60%).

PDP проверяет: checkpoint создан? HANDOFF.md валиден?

Если да — PEP выполняет reset.

Immutable ledger фиксирует reset (Вопрос 17).

3.13. Структура хранения
text
reset/
  ├── reset_modes.yaml               # compact / session / none
  ├── watermark.yaml                 # 60% threshold
  ├── context_folding.yaml           # pi-fold
  ├── dag_state.yaml                 # CMV
  ├── session_freshness.yaml         # paperclip
  ├── compaction_strategies.yaml     # Microsoft
  ├── fresh_context.yaml             # 12-factor-agentops
  ├── handoff_integration.yaml       # HANDOFF.md
  └── cache_aware.yaml               # lossless-hermes
4. Как проверять
4.1. При старте
Проверка	Метод	Критерий
Reset modes работают?	Симуляция compact/session/none	Правильный режим
Watermark работает?	Threshold 60%	Directive injected
Context folding работает?	Span → brief	SHA-256 verified
DAG state работает?	Snapshot/branch/trim	DAG created
Session freshness работает?	Timer wake	Starts fresh
Compaction strategies работают?	Cheapest-first	Правильный порядок
FreshContextPerIteration работает?	Iteration	No leaks
Cache-aware reset работает?	Hot cache	Backs off
4.2. В ходе работы
Метрика	Целевое	Метод
Token reduction	0.60x (pi-fold)	Агрегат
Dollar reduction	0.55x (pi-fold)	Агрегат
Trimming reduction	20–86% (CMV)	Агрегат
Context after folding	~7k tokens (AgentFold)	Замер
Session bloat	0	paperclip
No prior history leaks	100%	LoopAgent
Cache hit rate	> 80%	Замер
5. Уточняющие вопросы (решены)
Вопрос 25.1. Какой default reset — fresh или warm?
A. Warm (none).

B. Fresh (fresh context per task).

C. Гибрид.

Рекомендация: B. Fresh (12-factor-agentops). «Fresh context beats warm context when implementation surface is big enough». Исключение: small, local change → warm.

Вопрос 25.2. Какой режим reset по умолчанию?
A. none.

B. compact (pi-handoff-chain).

C. session.

Рекомендация: B. compact — context cleared, replaced by HANDOFF.md.

Вопрос 25.3. Нужен ли watermark watchdog?
A. Нет.

B. Да, 60% threshold (pi-handoff-chain).

C. Гибрид.

Рекомендация: B. Watermark watchdog. «past the threshold it injects a mandatory "stop new work, land the plane" directive».

Вопрос 25.4. Нужен ли context folding?
A. Нет.

B. Да, pi-fold (SHA-256 addressed store).

C. Гибрид.

Рекомендация: B. Context folding. pi-fold: «0.60x the total tokens and 0.55x the dollars of compaction».

Вопрос 25.5. Нужен ли DAG-based state?
A. Нет.

B. Да, CMV (snapshot, branch, trim).

C. Гибрид.

Рекомендация: B. DAG-based state. CMV: «formally defined snapshot, branch, and trim primitives».

Вопрос 25.6. Нужна ли cache-aware compaction?
A. Нет.

B. Да, lossless-hermes.

C. Гибрид.

Рекомендация: B. Cache-aware compaction. «When the cache is hot, compaction backs off».

Вопрос 26. Мониторинг здоровья агента (Agent Health Monitoring)
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-04

Сверено с: вопросами 1–25, 3, 5, 8, 10, 12, 17, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 48, 52, 59, 61, 65, 68, 100, 103, 104

1. Принятое решение
Вариант B (проактивный мониторинг по метрикам), расширенный до Agent Health State (IETF), Trust Margin (ADE-PRF), Streaming Metrics (ResonAct), Adaptive Stability Controller (SAGE), Canary Probes (SEISMОGRAPH), Relational Wellness (Foreman), Context Rot Detection (DriftWatch), Four-Field Minimum (agent-vitals), PIG Engine и Agent SLOs (DevOps.com).

Ключевые отличия от исходной формулировки:

«Relational — при 50+ проектах» → с первого дня (Foreman).

Добавлен Trust Margin (20 signals, 5 layers).

Добавлен 8-hour forecast (ADE-PRF).

Добавлен false prosperity detection.

Добавлен Adaptive Stability Controller (SAGE).

Добавлены canary probes (SEISMOGRAPH).

Добавлен context rot detection (DriftWatch, 60–70% fill).

Добавлен PIG Engine (детерминированный слой).

Добавлены agent SLOs (separate error budgets).

Factor-level > aggregate-score (ADE-PRF).

2. Сопоставление с другими пунктами: найденные противоречия
#	Противоречие	Где	Суть
1	«Health-метрики» vs. метрики Вопроса 59 (инструменты)	Вопрос 26 vs. Вопрос 59	Пересекающиеся метрики — error_rate, latency. Требуется: agent health vs. tool health — разные объекты.
2	«Baseline — не константа» vs. sealed parameters	Вопрос 26 vs. Вопрос 22	Вопрос 22: sealed parameters — пороги запечатаны. Требуется: baseline — вычисляемый, пороги — запечатанные.
3	«Degraded → флаг» vs. WAL-уровни	Вопрос 26 vs. Вопрос 22	Вопрос 22: WAL-уровни (0–3) с demotion. Требуется: health-статус влияет на WAL, не только на отчёт.
4	«Relational monitoring — при 50+ проектах» vs. Foreman	Вопрос 26 vs. Foreman (2026)	Foreman: relational wellness monitoring — уже сейчас, с 0.85 crew_health. Требуется: relational — с первого дня.
5	Отсутствие «Trust Margin»	Вопрос 26 vs. ADE-PRF	ADE-PRF: «aggregates 20 heterogeneous runtime signals across five layers into a single Trust Margin (TM) metric». Требуется: TM.
6	Отсутствие «health trajectory prediction»	Вопрос 26 vs. ADE-PRF	ADE-PRF: 8-hour forward-looking forecasts. Требуется: прогнозирование.
7	Отсутствие «false prosperity» detection	Вопрос 26 vs. ADE-PRF	ADE-PRF: «significant degradation can occur while external metrics remain deceptively normal». Требуется: false prosperity detection.
8	Отсутствие «Physical Integrity Gate»	Вопрос 26 vs. PIG Engine	PIG: «deterministic monitoring and enforcement layer that operates independently of the LLM-based agent execution path». Требуется: PIG Engine.
9	Отсутствие «Cost-Normalized Success Rate (CNSR) »	Вопрос 26 vs. SAGE	SAGE: «Cost-Normalized Success Rate (CNSR), a ratio-valued metric reporting successful completions per dollar». Требуется: CNSR.
10	Отсутствие «Adaptive Stability Controller»	Вопрос 26 vs. SAGE	SAGE: ASC — «consumes monitor signals and dispatches bounded interventions». Требуется: ASC.
11	Отсутствие «streaming metrics»	Вопрос 26 vs. ResonAct	ResonAct: «ingests execution traces, agent interactions, and tool invocations into a streaming analytics layer». Требуется: streaming.
12	Отсутствие «Runtime Self-Healing»	Вопрос 26 vs. ResonAct	ResonAct: «runtime self-healing framework that enables continuous monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation». Требуется: self-healing.
13	Отсутствие «detection precision/recall»	Вопрос 26 vs. ResonAct	ResonAct: «detection precision ranging from 70.59% to 82.91%, recall from 63.09% to 100%». Требуется: precision/recall.
14	Отсутствие «canary probes»	Вопрос 26 vs. SEISMOGRAPH	SEISMOGRAPH: «Lightweight, content-addressed canary probes (≤200 prompts at temperature 0)». Требуется: canary probes.
15	Отсутствие «cross-observer quorum»	Вопрос 26 vs. SEISMOGRAPH	SEISMOGRAPH: «promotes a drift signal to a public alert only when ≥2 independent observers agree». Требуется: quorum.
3. Внешние практики и исследования
3.1. Agent Health State (IETF, июнь 2026)
IETF (июнь 2026): «Agent Health State provides a graduated signal (healthy/degraded/unhealthy) with quantitative calibration metrics».

Поле	Описание
measurement_window_seconds	RECOMMENDED: 86400 (24 hours), MIN: 300 (5 min)
sample_count	Если < 10, calibration metrics — low-confidence
calibration_trend	stable / declining / improving (change > 0.10)
days_since_model_change	A recent model change + declining calibration_trend = strong decay signal
last_capability_update	Если capabilities declared weeks ago, но calibration declining — declaration stale
Ключевой вывод: «PT decay is behavioral ("has the agent demonstrated good behavior recently?"). Agent Health decay is operational ("is the agent's infrastructure functioning correctly?"). These two decay signals address different failure modes».

3.2. ADE-PRF: Health Trajectory Prediction (arXiv, июль 2026)
ADE-PRF (arXiv, 2026): «Traditional infrastructure monitoring covers only process liveness and resource consumption, lacking quantifiable means to perceive progressive degradation at the semantic reasoning level».

Trust Margin (TM): «aggregates 20 heterogeneous runtime signals across five layers into a single Trust Margin (TM) metric, achieving system health quantification over a dynamic range of 39.2 points».

8-hour forward-looking forecasts: «triple-method parallel prediction, with the Exponential method achieving MAE of 1.228 points and Direction Accuracy of 76.8% , with 99.65% of predictions within 10-point tolerance».

False prosperity: «in unprotected environments, significant degradation can occur while external metrics remain deceptively normal».

Key finding: «factor-level alerting outperforms aggregate-score alerting ».

3.3. SAGE: Stabilize-Assess-Govern-Enforce (IEEE, сентябрь 2026)
SAGE (IEEE, 2026): «A four-pillar framework for deployment-oriented analysis of LLM-based autonomous agents».

Pillar	Что делает
Stabilize	Models agent loop as closed-loop system; 3 monitorable stability targets: observation fidelity, progress monotonicity, bounded context noise
Assess	Combines behavioral autonomy taxonomy with Cost-Normalized Success Rate (CNSR) — successful completions per dollar
Govern	10-class failure taxonomy + STRIDE analysis of MCP/A2A boundaries
Enforce	Adaptive Stability Controller (ASC) — consumes monitor signals, dispatches bounded interventions (re-anchoring, replanning, schema-validated retry, compression, escalation)
Результаты: «monitor-conditioned control increased completion from 2.0% under no-control to 89.3% for hand-tuned thresholds and 83.3% for a learned predictive policy ». «combined predictive monitor reached AUC = 0.752 at a five-step lead time ».

3.4. ResonAct: Runtime Self-Healing (arXiv, сентябрь 2026)
ResonAct (arXiv, 2026): «A runtime self-healing framework that enables continuous monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation of multi-agent systems through streaming operational metrics. ResonAct ingests execution traces, agent interactions, and tool invocations into a streaming analytics layer that continuously derives task progress, context health, and tool reliability metrics».

Результаты: «policy-driven remediation improves task completion rates by up to 10.00 percentage points , with detection precision ranging from 70.59% to 82.91% , recall from 63.09% to 100% , recovery rates from 10.48% to 46.67% , and runtime overhead ranging from −0.25% to 14.12% ».

3.5. SEISMOGRAPH: Federated Early-Warning (Zenodo, июль 2026)
SEISMOGRAPH (Zenodo, 2026): «Lightweight, content-addressed canary probes (≤200 prompts at temperature 0) are replayed against target models; only SHA-256 hashes and differentially-private distributional aggregates (ε=2.0) leave the probe perimeter».

Two-layer detector: «Page-CUSUM change-point detection plus cross-observer quorum agreement promotes a drift signal to a public alert only when ≥2 independent observers agree ».

Результат: «a single probe raised its first alert 38 days before the official postmortem, while the fault still affected only ~0.8% of traffic ».

3.6. Foreman: Relational Wellness Monitoring (PyPI, июнь 2026)
Foreman (PyPI, 2026): «Relational wellness monitoring for AI agent crews. The only monitoring system that watches how agents work together, not just how they perform individually».

Результаты:

crew_health = 0.85 (композитная метрика).

is_degraded = False.

threshold = 0.65 (adaptive after warmup).

A/B testing: «Tested on real LangGraph crews with live GPT-4o-mini API calls across 256 tasks: Task correctness impact (passive mode): 0% . Extra LLM calls: 0. Extra latency: 0ms. Extra cost: $0.00 ».

Simulation results: «Standard: 21% → 49% → 73% (with proactive). Enterprise: 23% → 38% → 89% ».

3.7. DriftWatch: Context Rot Detection (PyPI, июнь 2026)
DriftWatch (PyPI, 2026): «Long-running AI agents don't fail all at once — they drift. Context rot is the progressive loss of reasoning quality that starts at 60–70% context fill, not at 100% ». «A 2025–2026 industry analysis found that ~65% of enterprise AI agent failures were caused by context drift or memory loss during multi-step reasoning — not by raw context exhaustion».

Composite health score (0.0–1.0):

Signal	What it measures
Goal Coherence	Cosine similarity between goal embedding and last-turn embedding
Entropy	Information-theoretic measure of output diversity
Memory Delta	Rate of change in memory state
3.8. agent-vitals: Four-Field Minimum (PyPI, февраль 2026)
agent-vitals (PyPI, 2026): «Feed it four numbers per step and it tells you when your agent is looping, stuck, thrashing, or burning tokens for nothing».

Field	Description
findings_count	Number of findings per step
coverage_score	Coverage of the task
total_tokens	Token usage
error_count	Errors per step
Detection modes:

Mode	What it catches	Signal
Loop	Repeating actions without progress	Findings plateau
Stuck	Coverage stagnation	Low DM + low CV
Thrash	Excessive errors	Error count above threshold
Runaway Cost	Token burn with no output	Token spike + flat findings
3.9. PIG Engine: Physical Integrity Gate (arXiv, июнь 2026)
PIG Engine (arXiv, 2026): «The Physical Integrity Gate (PIG) Engine is a deterministic monitoring and enforcement layer that operates independently of the LLM-based agent execution path. Its architecture consists of three components».

Ключевой вывод: PIG Engine — детерминированный слой, не зависящий от LLM. Защита от «silent failure».

3.10. Microsoft Foundry: Fleet Health (май 2026)
Microsoft Foundry (май 2026): «Microsoft Foundry Control Plane provides a unified command center where you can monitor all agents, models, and tools across your enterprise from build to production».

Fleet monitoring roles: Team managers, Administrators, Cost managers, Security teams.

Tracking: «active agents, run completion rates, and error trends across the fleet».

3.11. AgentDrift: Quality Drift Monitoring (PyPI, февраль 2026)
AgentDrift (PyPI, 2026): «Track agent outputs over time, detect quality degradation, and get alerts before your agents go off the rails».

Pipeline: Agent Call → Log Trace → Score Quality → Detect Drift → Alert.

Scoring: LLM-as-Judge rates output quality (0.0–1.0). Recent scores vs. baseline period.

Results: my-agent: STABLE, Score 0.847, +2.1% vs. qa-bot: DRIFTING, Score 0.612, −18.3%.

3.12. Multi-Agent SLOs (DevOps.com, август 2026)
DevOps.com (август 2026): «Agentic systems need separate measurement layers for infrastructure health, inference reliability and behavioral correctness». «Useful agent metrics include output variance, semantic drift, step count, confidence, intent alignment and pass@k correctness ». «Decision points—not just requests—should become the primary unit of observation ».

4. Пункты реализации
4.1. Agent Health State (IETF)
Поле	Описание
measurement_window_seconds	86400 (24h) default, MIN: 300 (5 min)
sample_count	< 10 → low-confidence
calibration_trend	stable / declining / improving (change > 0.10)
days_since_model_change	Recent model change + declining = strong decay
last_capability_update	Stale declaration detection
Правило «graduated signal»: IETF: «healthy / degraded / unhealthy».

4.2. Trust Margin (ADE-PRF)
20 heterogeneous runtime signals across five layers.

Single Trust Margin (TM) metric — dynamic range of 39.2 points.

8-hour forward-looking forecasts — MAE 1.228, Direction Accuracy 76.8%.

False prosperity detection — degradation while external metrics normal.

Factor-level alerting — outperforms aggregate-score alerting.

Правило «factor-level > aggregate»: ADE-PRF: «factor-level alerting outperforms aggregate-score alerting».

4.3. Streaming Metrics (ResonAct)
Metric	Что измеряет
Task progress	Прогресс задачи
Context health	Здоровье контекста
Tool reliability	Надёжность инструментов
Правило «runtime control signals»: ResonAct: «These metrics serve as runtime control signals for detecting anomalous execution patterns».

4.4. Adaptive Stability Controller (SAGE)
Intervention	Что делает
Re-anchoring	Возврат к цели
Replanning	Перепланирование
Schema-validated retry	Повтор с валидацией схемы
Compression	Сжатие контекста
Escalation	Эскалация (Вопрос 8)
Правило «bounded interventions»: SAGE: «dispatches bounded interventions».

4.5. Canary Probes (SEISMOGRAPH)
Content-addressed canary probes: ≤200 prompts at temperature 0.

SHA-256 hashes + differentially-private aggregates.

Two-layer detector: Page-CUSUM + cross-observer quorum (≥2 independent observers).

Early warning: 38 days before official postmortem.

Правило «federated early-warning»: SEISMOGRAPH: «only SHA-256 hashes and differentially-private distributional aggregates leave the probe perimeter».

4.6. Relational Wellness (Foreman)
Signal	What it measures
Crew health	Композитная метрика (0–1)
Is degraded	Флаг
Threshold	0.65 (adaptive after warmup)
A/B testing: 0% correctness impact, 0 extra LLM calls, 0ms latency, $0.00 cost (passive mode).

Правило «relational — с первого дня»: Foreman: «watching how agents work together, not just how they perform individually».

4.7. Context Rot Detection (DriftWatch)
Signal	What it measures
Goal Coherence	Cosine similarity between goal and last-turn
Entropy	Output diversity
Memory Delta	Rate of change in memory state
Composite health score: 0.0–1.0. Degradation starts at 60–70% context fill.

Правило «context rot»: DriftWatch: «starts at 60–70% context fill, not at 100%».

4.8. Four-Field Minimum (agent-vitals)
Field	Description
findings_count	Number of findings
coverage_score	Coverage of task
total_tokens	Token usage
error_count	Errors
Detection modes: Loop, Stuck, Thrash, Runaway Cost.

Правило «zero-config defaults»: agent-vitals: «AgentVitals() works out of the box with tuned thresholds».

4.9. PIG Engine (Physical Integrity Gate)
Deterministic monitoring layer.

Independent of LLM execution path.

Three components (не указаны в источнике).

Правило «deterministic monitoring»: PIG: «operates independently of the LLM-based agent execution path».

4.10. SLOs for Agentic Systems (DevOps.com)
Dimension	What it measures
Latency	Measured by task class
Step count	Reliability signal (excessive steps = confused)
Output variance	Variability of outputs
Semantic drift	Drift in meaning
Confidence	Agent confidence
Intent alignment	Alignment with intent
pass@k correctness	Correctness across k attempts
Правило «separate error budgets»: DevOps.com: «Infrastructure, inference and behavioral failures require separate error budgets and clear ownership».

4.11. Интеграция с PDP/PEP (Вопрос 5)
Health-мониторинг непрерывно собирает сигналы.

PDP проверяет: health status? calibration_trend? Trust Margin?

Если degraded — PEP применяет interventions (ASC).

Immutable ledger фиксирует health-события (Вопрос 17).

Вопрос 27. Квоты и лимиты ресурсов на проект (capacity quotas)
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-04

Сверено с: вопросами 1–26, 9, 21, 22, 24, 25, 37, 59, 65, 68

1. Принятое решение
Вариант B + элементы C (динамическое перераспределение + admission control), расширенный до Multi-level Quota Architecture, Quota Storm Prevention, 4-Gate Admission Governor, Priority Tiers (P0–P3), Agent Fair Share (AFS), Token Bucket per Agent, Task Budget, Irreversibility Budget, ZEBRA и Outcome-based Capacity Planning.

Ключевые отличия от исходной формулировки:

«Фаза определяет квоту» → Multi-level quota (model / agent / project).

«Admission control — очередь» → 4-gate admission governor.

«Приоритет по фазе» → AFS (динамический по дедлайнам).

«Token budget per project» → Token bucket per agent + task budget.

Добавлен quota storm prevention.

Добавлен irreversibility budget.

Добавлен outcome-based capacity planning.

Task budget для runaway loops.

P0–P3 priority tiers (agentsched).

2. Сопоставление с другими пунктами: найденные противоречия
#	Противоречие	Где	Суть
1	«Фаза определяет квоту» vs. priority-weighted reallocation	Вопрос 27 vs. Вопрос 9	Вопрос 9: priority-weighted reallocation — динамическое перераспределение по приоритету. Вопрос 27: фаза определяет квоту (фиксированная). Требуется: priority-weighted работает внутри переменной квоты, не трогая базовую.
2	«Admission control — не блокировка, а очередь» vs. fail closed	Вопрос 27 vs. Вопрос 6	Вопрос 6: L5 — fail closed. Требуется: admission control различает уровни: L0–L3 — очередь, L4+ — fail closed.
3	«Квота — не наказание» vs. quota storm	Вопрос 27 vs. Polyaxon	Polyaxon: без admission control квота наказывает всех.
4	«Лимит 8 исполнителей» vs. параллелизм	Вопрос 27 vs. agentsched	agentsched: 4-gate admission governor. Требуется: 4-gate.
5	«Token budget per project» vs. token bucket	Вопрос 27 vs. Token-bucket	Token-bucket: per-agent virtual bucket — burst до capacity. Требуется: token bucket per agent + project budget.
6	«Приоритет по фазе» vs. Agent Fair Share	Вопрос 27 vs. AFS (arXiv)	AFS: AFS_i = Σ (work_remain(t) / (deadline(t) - t_now)). Требуется: AFS для распределения внутри фазы.
7	Отсутствие «quota storm prevention»	Вопрос 27 vs. Microsoft Learn	Microsoft Learn: «Das Kontingentsturmproblem tritt auf, wenn der Ressourcenbedarf das Angebot überschreitet, und keine Kontrollen verhindern, dass ein Verbraucher die Kapazität monopolisiert». Требуется: quota storm prevention.
8	Отсутствие «multi-level quota»	Вопрос 27 vs. Microsoft Learn	Microsoft Learn: «Une gouvernance efficace des quotas nécessite des contrôles à trois niveaux: les quotas d'API de modèle, les quotas au niveau de l'agent, et les quotas au niveau du client». Требуется: multi-level quota.
9	Отсутствие «irreversibility budget»	Вопрос 27 vs. Irreversibility Budget (arXiv)	Irreversibility Budget: «a cumulative account of residual value-at-risk that a trusted runtime maintains for each principal across agents, workflows, and tenants». Требуется: irreversibility budget.
10	Отсутствие «ZEBRA»	Вопрос 27 vs. ZEBRA	ZEBRA: «Zero-shot Budgeted Resource Allocation for LLM Orchestration». Требуется: ZEBRA для allocation.
11	Отсутствие «outcome-based capacity planning»	Вопрос 27 vs. Polyaxon	Polyaxon: «Capacity planning must follow the logical task through every constrained dependency». Требуется: outcome-based planning.
3. Внешние практики и исследования
3.1. Quota Storm Problem (Microsoft Learn, август 2026)
Microsoft Learn (август 2026): «Das Kontingentsturmproblem tritt auf, wenn der Ressourcenbedarf das Angebot überschreitet, und keine Kontrollen verhindern, dass ein Verbraucher die Kapazität monopolisiert. Bei der Multi-Agenten-Bereitstellung von Fabrikam liegt der Engpass beim Kontingent der Azure OpenAI-API, das in Token pro Minute gemessen wird. Jeder Modellbereitstellung ist ein maximales TPM zugewiesen».

Quota storm scenario: «Wenn jedoch ein Mandant die Batchverarbeitung eines gesamten Microservice-Repositorys auslöst (200 Dateien, insgesamt 500.000 Token), steigt der Kontingentverbrauch. Wenn dieser Batch mit 50 gleichzeitigen Anfragen verarbeitet wird, versucht er, über mehrere Minuten hinweg 50.000+ TPM zu verbrauchen. Ohne Kontingentkontrollen verursacht dieser Anstieg Kaskadierende Fehler».

Multi-level quota architecture: «Une gouvernance efficace des quotas nécessite des contrôles à trois niveaux: les quotas d'API de modèle au niveau du service OpenAI Azure, les quotas au niveau de l'agent contrôlant l'accès à des agents individuels, et les quotas au niveau du client qui limitent la consommation totale par client».

Решение: «Die Separation des déploiements de modèles par type de charge de travail, l'application de limites de jetons par locataire via Gestion des API Azure et l'intégration d'un mécanisme de repli exponentiel au code de l'agent permettent d'absorber une utilisation à fort volume sans provoquer d'effet domino sur les quotas».

3.2. HiveMind: OS-Inspired Scheduling (arXiv, апрель 2026)
HiveMind (arXiv, 2026): «We present HiveMind, a transparent HTTP proxy that applies five OS-inspired scheduling primitives — admission control, rate-limit tracking, AIMD backpressure with circuit breaking, token budget management, and priority queuing — to eliminate the failure modes caused by uncoordinated parallel execution».

Результаты: «Uncoordinated agents fail at 72–100% rates under contention, while HiveMind reduces failures to 0–18% and eliminates 48–100% of wasted compute. An ablation study reveals that transparent retry — not admission control — is the single most critical primitive, but the primitives are most effective in combination».

3.3. agentsched: 4-Gate Admission Governor (Go, сентябрь 2026)
agentsched (pkg.go.dev, сентябрь 2026): «Package agentsched provides prioritized task scheduling and admission governance for concurrent agent execution. Tasks are scheduled across four priority tiers (P0 system through P3 speculative) and admitted through four sequential gates: worker concurrency, host resource envelope (CPU, memory, file handles, thermals), provider headroom, and lane clearance against active repository leases».

Under host stress: «The governor dynamically paces turns, downscales worker concurrency, and sheds speculative load».

Thresholds: DefaultMaxWorkers = 16, MaxCPUPctThreshold = 85.0, MinFreeRAMBytesThreshold = 4 GB, MaxOpenHandlesThreshold = 130000.

3.4. Agent Fair Share (AFS) (arXiv, май 2026)
SAGA (arXiv, 2026): «Traditional fair scheduling allocates resources equally across tenants based on time or requests. For agents, this is inadequate: a tenant running 10-step agents should not receive the same priority as one running 100-step agents if both need to complete tasks by a deadline».

AFS definition: AFS_i = Σ_{t∈T_i} work_remain(t) / (deadline(t) - t_now).

AFS-based scheduling: «The global coordinator maintains AFS scores for all tenants and adjusts scheduling priorities every epoch (100ms): 1. Recompute AFS; 2. Allocate worker capacity proportionally to AFS; 3. Route new requests preferentially to high-AFS tenants; 4. Trigger preemption if low-AFS tasks block high-AFS tasks for >500ms».

Результаты: «SAGA reduces task completion time by 1.64× (geometric mean)».

3.5. Token-Bucket Scheduling (arXiv, апрель 2026)
QoS-Aware Token Scheduling (arXiv, 2026): «Token-bucket scheduling regulates network traffic by accumulating tokens in a limited-capacity bucket to control data bursts while enforcing a reliable long-term service. We adopt the token buckets for agentic systems by treating AI quota as tokens in a virtual bucket for each agent. By using a virtual "bucket" to store tokens as utility quotas, agents are allowed to have bursts of inference queries up to the bucket's capacity».

3.6. Polyaxon: Admission Control и Capacity Planning (июль 2026)
Polyaxon (июль 2026): «Place a durable admission queue in front of expensive execution. Validate identity, task type, required connections, resource eligibility, deadline, and budget before dispatch. Apply concurrency and quota by tenant, workload class, environment, model, tool, and destination. Reserve capacity for high-priority recovery and control actions. First-come scheduling can let a burst of low-value tasks block production work».

Task budgets: «Per-request limits at a model gateway are helpful but insufficient. An agent can remain under every call limit while looping indefinitely. Enforce maximum elapsed time, attempts, tokens, model cost, tool calls, sandbox time, and produced data across the logical task».

Outcome-based capacity planning: «Capacity planning must follow the logical task through every constrained dependency».

3.7. ZEBRA: Zero-shot Budgeted Resource Allocation (ICML, 2026)
ZEBRA (ICML, 2026): «Setting limits on resource consumption is crucial — as recently documented, uncontrolled waste of resources emerges in autonomous agentic behavior».

Результаты: «At a budget of α= 0.5 of the unconstrained spend, ZEBRA recovers 94.4% of unconstrained quality, versus 88.1% for LLM-direct».

3.8. Irreversibility Budget (arXiv, сентябрь 2026)
Irreversibility Budget (arXiv, 2026): «We propose the irreversibility budget, a cumulative account of residual value-at-risk that a trusted runtime maintains for each principal across agents, workflows, and tenants».

4. Пункты реализации
4.1. Multi-level quota architecture (Microsoft Learn)
Уровень	Что контролирует	Кто управляет
Model API	Token per minute (TPM) на deployment	Azure API Management
Agent	Доступ к отдельным агентам	Agent-level quota
Project	Общее потребление проекта	Project-level quota
Правило «три уровня»: Microsoft Learn: «les quotas d'API de modèle, les quotas au niveau de l'agent, et les quotas au niveau du client».

4.2. Quota storm prevention
Separation по workload type: batch vs. interactive — разные deployments.

Token limits per tenant: через API Management.

Exponential backoff в коде агента.

Prevent cascading failures: 429 → не retry немедленно.

Правило «separation of workloads»: Microsoft Learn: «Die Separation des déploiements de modèles par type de charge de travail».

4.3. 4-Gate Admission Governor (agentsched)
Gate	Что проверяет
Worker concurrency	DefaultMaxWorkers = 16
Host resource envelope	CPU (85%), RAM (4 GB), handles (130k)
Provider headroom	Доступность API
Lane clearance	Active repository leases
Правило «4 gates»: agentsched: «A task is admitted to execute a turn only when ALL four gates pass».

Правило «dynamic pacing»: agentsched: «Under host stress, the governor dynamically paces turns, downscales worker concurrency, and sheds speculative load».

4.4. Priority tiers (agentsched)
Tier	Название	Что включает
P0	System	Критические системные задачи
P1	Production	Production-задачи
P2	Interactive	Пользовательские задачи
P3	Speculative	Бэклог, эксперименты
Правило «P3 shedding»: agentsched: «Sheds speculative load» под stress.

4.5. Agent Fair Share (AFS)
Формула: AFS_i = Σ_{t∈T_i} work_remain(t) / (deadline(t) - t_now)

Алгоритм:

Recompute AFS every 100ms.

Allocate worker capacity proportionally to AFS.

Route new requests preferentially to high-AFS tenants.

Trigger preemption if low-AFS blocks high-AFS > 500ms.

Правило «AFS-based priority»: SAGA: «Tenants with higher AFS have more urgent work and receive higher priority».

4.6. Token bucket per agent
Параметр	Описание
Capacity	Максимальный burst
Refill rate	Скорость пополнения
Tokens	Единицы квоты
Правило «virtual bucket»: «Agents are allowed to have bursts of inference queries up to the bucket's capacity».

4.7. Task budget (Polyaxon)
Параметр	Что контролирует
max_elapsed_time	Максимальное время
max_attempts	Максимум попыток
max_tokens	Максимум токенов
max_cost	Максимальная стоимость
max_tool_calls	Максимум вызовов инструментов
max_sandbox_time	Максимум времени в sandbox
Правило «task budget»: Polyaxon: «Enforce maximum elapsed time, attempts, tokens, model cost, tool calls, sandbox time, and produced data across the logical task».

Правило «safe checkpoint»: Polyaxon: «When a budget is reached, stop at a safe checkpoint and return a diagnosable outcome».

4.8. Irreversibility budget
Cumulative account of residual value-at-risk.

Per principal (across agents, workflows, tenants).

Fleet-level overdraws up to tenant's risk limit.

Правило «irreversibility budget»: «A cumulative account of residual value-at-risk that a trusted runtime maintains for each principal».

4.9. ZEBRA allocation
Zero-shot budgeted resource allocation для LLM orchestration.

Setting limits на resource consumption.

Правило «ZEBRA»: «Uncontrolled waste of resources emerges in autonomous agentic behavior».

4.10. Outcome-based capacity planning
Measure fan-out для каждого task type.

Map dependencies: GPU, provider concurrency, DB connections, API rate limits.

Estimate amplification: сколько downstream work может создать один accepted task.

Правило «outcome-based»: Polyaxon: «Capacity planning must follow the logical task through every constrained dependency».

4.11. Структура хранения
text
quotas/
  ├── multi_level_quota.yaml         # Model / Agent / Project
  ├── quota_storm.yaml               # Prevention
  ├── four_gate_admission.yaml       # agentsched
  ├── priority_tiers.yaml            # P0–P3
  ├── afs.yaml                       # Agent Fair Share
  ├── token_bucket.yaml              # Per-agent bucket
  ├── task_budget.yaml               # Polyaxon
  ├── irreversibility_budget.yaml    # Fleet-level
  ├── zebra.yaml                     # Zero-shot allocation
  └── capacity_planning.yaml         # Outcome-based

Вопрос 28. Процесс онбординга агента в проект (project onboarding)
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-04

Сверено с: вопросами 1–27, 3, 4, 5, 7, 10, 16, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 33, 41, 46, 48, 64, 100

1. Принятое решение
Вариант B + элементы C (structured + verification), расширенный до Onboarding Pack (8 компонентов), Read-First Trail, Context Pack, Knowledge Graph, Socratic Onboarding, Knowledge Completeness Assessment, Context Index, Role Briefing, First-Week Plan, 30-60-90 Plan, Buddy + Mentor Pairing и Verification.

Ключевые отличия от исходной формулировки:

«Онбординг — событие» → onboarding pack (8 компонентов).

«Неформальный» → structured (ecos-onboarding).

Добавлен read-first trail (3-4 файла).

Добавлен context pack (AGENTS.md + progressive disclosure).

Добавлен knowledge graph (onboarding-agent).

Добавлен Socratic onboarding (teach-me).

Добавлен knowledge completeness (byterover).

Добавлен context index (zc-ai-coding-toolkit).

Добавлен first-week plan (failcoach).

Добавлен 30-60-90 plan (agency-agents).

Добавлен buddy + mentor pairing (aiwg).

Verification перед началом работы.

2. Обоснование
2.1. Structured Agent Onboarding (ecos-onboarding, 2026)
ecos-onboarding (2026): «Agent onboarding is a structured process to prepare a new agent for effective participation in a multi-agent team. Unlike human onboarding which may take days or weeks, agent onboarding happens in minutes but must be thorough and precise».

Onboarding components:

Onboarding Checklist — systematic list of items.

Role Briefing — detailed explanation of role, responsibilities, expectations.

Project Handoff — transfer of essential project knowledge, conventions, current state.

Key characteristics: Structured, Role-specific, Context-rich, Verifiable (confirms understanding before work begins).

2.2. Context Pack (agent-context, 2026)
agent-context (2026): «agent-context generates a compact, cross-linked set of Markdown docs that make an unfamiliar repository legible to an AI coding agent. It produces an AGENTS.md table-of-contents plus focused docs (architecture.md, infrastructure.md, ADR stubs, data model, docs/ pages)».

Philosophy: «AGENTS.md is a table of contents, not an encyclopedia. The repository is the system of record. Context is a scarce resource. Progressive disclosure. AGENTS.md points to specialized docs; each specialized doc delegates further».

2.3. First Week Plan (failcoach, 2026)
failcoach (2026): «Most business owners try an AI agent for an afternoon, get garbage results, and blame the technology. The real problem? They're treating their agent like software when it's actually a new hire». «This starter kit gives you the same onboarding process you'd use for a great employee: a clear job description, the right tools, structured memory, feedback loops, and realistic timeline expectations».

After a 20-30 minute interview:

Agent brief — job description, responsibilities, decision boundaries, success criteria.

Memory structure — how agent remembers between sessions.

Feedback template — customized for role.

First-week plan — specific tasks for first five days, ordered simple to complex.

2.4. Onboarding Pack (oldwinter, 2026)
oldwinter (2026): «Produce a New Hire Onboarding Pack in Markdown»:

Onboarding brief — role outcomes, success definition, constraints, risks.

Preboarding checklist — docs, access, equipment, meetings, comms.

First-week plan — day 1 + week 1 schedule; introductions; "first pair" plan.

Context pack outline — team operating manual + mental models + "how decisions get made".

Listening tour kit — stakeholder map, schedule, question guide, synthesis table.

Working agreement — relationship design conversation summary.

30/60/90 + 1y/2y plan — phased objectives, deliverables, check-ins, guardrails.

30-day state-of-the-union memo — what I heard, themes, proposed focus, open questions.

2.5. Read-First Trail + Always-On Rules (Onboarding Guide, 2026)
Onboarding Guide (2026): «A good onboarding guide answers the questions a newcomer will have in their first hour, day, and week — before they need to ask».

Agent onboarding (AGENTS.md):

Read-first trail — 3-4 files to read in order before touching anything (README, HANDOVER, AGENTS.md, BACKLOG).

Always-on rules — hard constraints (never edit generated files, always run tests).

Project structure — key directories, what each contains, what's off-limits.

First-session workflow — "Here's how a typical work session goes" with concrete example.

Gotchas — 3-5 things that trip up agents new to this project.

2.6. Socratic Onboarding (teach-me, 2026)
teach-me (2026): «Instead of handing over docs and hoping for the best, teach-me actively asks questions to find out what the dev doesn't know, then teaches exactly that. The AI starts asking. Not "do you understand?" in a perfunctory way. It asks specific questions: "How does the authentication module handle token refresh when a session expires?" The dev has to answer in their own words».

Loop: ask → find gap → teach gap → ask again, until threshold is met. «Starts with what matters most, critical path first, edge cases later».

2.7. Knowledge Graph для Onboarding (onboarding-agent, 2026)
onboarding-agent (2026): «Point it at a repo, and it builds a knowledge graph of the project — files, functions, classes, imports, and their relationships. Then ask questions like you're talking to a senior engineer who knows the project inside out».

Tools: ingest_repo, get_overview, explain_file, explain_module, build_knowledge_graph, query_entities, query_relationships, find_relevant_code, get_architecture, ask, get_git_history, get_hot_files.

2.8. Context Index (zc-ai-coding-toolkit, 2026)
zc-ai-coding-toolkit (2026): «Project Context Map — compact index for fast context loading. .pi/project-context.md — context snapshot to avoid re-scouting the entire repo. .pi/context-index.json — compact advisory index (node/edge/citation) for profile, tech stack, verify command, docs, risk».

Read order: «1. AGENTS.md → 2. Project profile → 3. Context Engine pack (if index exists and not stale) → 4. Project context index → 5. Project context snapshot».

2.9. Knowledge Completeness Assessment (byterover-onboard, 2026)
byterover-onboard (2026): «Queries comprehensive knowledge across all domains, presents a structured project overview, identifies knowledge gaps, and suggests running explore to fill them».

Phases:

Comprehensive Knowledge Retrieval — query every major domain.

Assess Knowledge Completeness — rate coverage per domain: Comprehensive / Partial / Missing.

Synthesize Overview — present structured project overview.

Identify Gaps — recommend byterover-explore to fill gaps.

2.10. 30-60-90 Day Plan (agency-agents, 2026)
agency-agents (2026): «HR Onboarding Agent — meticulous, empathetic HR onboarding specialist with deep expertise in new hire orientation, compliance documentation, benefits administration, culture integration, and the 30-60-90 day employee journey».

Plan structure: Phase 1 (Days 1-30): Learn — build context. Phase 2 (Days 31-60): Contribute — apply learning. Phase 3 (Days 61-90): Own — take ownership.

3. Пункты реализации
3.1. Onboarding Pack (oldwinter-style)
8 компонентов:

#	Компонент	Что содержит
1	Onboarding Brief	Role outcomes, success definition, constraints, risks
2	Preboarding Checklist	Docs, access, equipment, meetings, comms
3	First-Week Plan	Day 1 + week 1 schedule; introductions; "first pair" plan
4	Context Pack	Team operating manual + mental models + decision history
5	Listening Tour Kit	Stakeholder map, schedule, question guide, synthesis table
6	Working Agreement	Relationship design: working style + expectations
7	30/60/90 Plan	Phased objectives, deliverables, check-ins, guardrails
8	30-Day Memo	What I heard, themes, proposed focus, open questions
3.2. Read-First Trail + Always-On Rules (Onboarding Guide)
Read-first trail (agent):

README.md — what this project does and why.

AGENTS.md — always-on rules, project structure, gotchas.

context/HANDOVER.md — current state, what was worked on last.

context/BACKLOG.md — what's queued, what's in progress.

Always-on rules: hard constraints (never edit generated files, always run tests before committing, etc.).

Gotchas: 3-5 things that trip up agents new to this project (project-specific, not general programming knowledge).

3.3. Context Pack (agent-context-style)
Структура:

Файл	Что содержит
AGENTS.md	Table of contents, read-first trail, always-on rules
architecture.md	Tech stack, structure, entry points
infrastructure.md	Deployment, CI, environments
ADR stubs	Architecture Decision Records
data model	Key entities, relationships
docs/	Specialized docs (progressive disclosure)
Philosophy: «AGENTS.md is a table of contents, not an encyclopedia. Context is a scarce resource. Progressive disclosure».

3.4. Knowledge Graph (onboarding-agent-style)
Ingest repo → knowledge graph (files, functions, classes, imports, relationships).

Tools: get_overview, explain_file, query_entities, query_relationships, find_relevant_code, get_architecture, get_git_history, get_hot_files.

Hot files: most frequently changed files (often most important).

Contributors per file: who has worked on what.

3.5. Socratic Onboarding (teach-me-style)
Process:

AI analyzes codebase → synthesizes high-level architecture, main modules, business flows.

AI asks specific questions — not "do you understand?", but "How does the authentication module handle token refresh?".

Dev answers in own words → AI identifies gaps.

AI teaches gap → asks again to confirm.

Loop continues until threshold met.

Rule: «Starts with what matters most, critical path first, edge cases later».

3.6. Knowledge Completeness Assessment (byterover-style)
Domain	Rating	Criteria
Technology Stack	Comprehensive / Partial / Missing	Lists specific deps, versions, runtime
Architecture	Comprehensive / Partial / Missing	Describes layers, data flow, entry points
Conventions	Comprehensive / Partial / Missing	Specifies naming, imports, error handling
Testing	Comprehensive / Partial / Missing	Names framework, patterns, organization
External Integrations	Comprehensive / Partial / Missing	APIs, databases, auth providers
Concerns	Comprehensive / Partial / Missing	Tech debt, known issues, fragile areas
Gap filling: если домен Missing — recommend explore (not manual investigation).

3.7. Context Index (zc-ai-coding-toolkit-style)
Read order:

AGENTS.md — closest to project.

Project profile: .pi/piagent-profile.json.

Context Engine pack для unfamiliar/cross-module task (if index exists and not stale).

Project context index: .pi/context-index.json.

Project context snapshot: .pi/project-context.md.

Context index format: node/edge/citation for profile, tech stack, verify command, docs, risk.

3.8. Role Briefing (ecos-onboarding-style)
Retrieve role definition — purpose, scope, reporting.

Explain responsibilities — what the agent does, what it doesn't.

Clarify reporting structure — who it reports to, who reports to it.

Set expectations — quality bar, escalation triggers, handoff format.

Answer questions — clarify understanding.

Confirm understanding — verification before work begins.

3.9. First-Week Plan (failcoach-style)
Principles: «Start your agent on simple, well-defined tasks and gradually increase complexity. You're calibrating, not expecting perfection».

Structure:

Day 1-2: Get Oriented — agent reads everything, produces first real output. Heavy review, detailed feedback.

Day 3-4: Start the Routine — agent begins regular tasks. Still reviewing everything.

Day 5: Calibrate — step back, review whole week, update instructions, update memory, identify week 2 focus.

3-5 tasks for first week: ordered simplest to hardest. "Simple" = narrow scope, clear inputs, output judgeable in under 5 minutes.

3.10. 30-60-90 Day Plan (agency-agents-style)
Phase	Days	Focus	Outputs
Learn	1–30	Build context	Stakeholder map, portfolio audit, tooling
Contribute	31–60	Apply learning	Risk register, status reports, first handoffs
Own	61–90	Take ownership	Milestone tracking, budget reviews, retrospective
3.11. Buddy + Mentor Pairing (aiwg-style)
Buddy assigned with pairing cadence established.

Mentor pairing — match expertise areas.

Pairing cadence — regular 1:1 sessions (30–45 min weekly).

Cross-specialization fallback matching.

3.12. Интеграция с PDP/PEP (Вопрос 5)
Онбординг инициируется (при входе агента в проект).

PDP проверяет: role briefing delivered? context pack loaded? verification completed?

Если да — PEP регистрирует агента в проекте.

Immutable ledger фиксирует онбординг (Вопрос 17).

3.13. Интеграция с памятью (Вопрос 3)
Слой	Что происходит при онбординге
personal	Создаётся, архивируется при роспуске
area	Агент получает чтение/запись в области
direction	Агент получает чтение
project	Агент получает чтение через тимлида
Правило «проект-специфичные знания → memory: project»: per-agent onboarding skill persists project-specific context to agent's project memory.
