Вопрос 70. Объяснимость решений (explainability) для разных аудиторий
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-05

Сверено с: вопросами 1–69, 5, 6, 12, 17, 22, 26, 36, 46, 47, 48, 61, 62, 63, 65, 66, 67, 68

1. Принятое решение
Вариант C — трёхуровневая explainability (local + global + counterfactual) + audience-aware (XstrAI) + triadic fusion (TAXAL: cognitive, functional, causal) + graph-based (GoAT для multi-agent) + conversational (CoCoXplain) + transparent limits (model cards) + contextual integrity (CI-RL) + explainability debt (измеримая метрика) + grounding в evidence (VETRA).

Ключевое отличие от исходной формулировки:

«Единый формат объяснения» → audience-aware (XstrAI: planning, realization, validation).

«Local explainability» → local + global + counterfactual.

«Global explainability» → TAXAL (cognitive, functional, causal).

«Counterfactual» → AXIS (whatif / remove prompts).

«Multi-agent» → GoAT (graph-based).

«Transparent limits» → model cards (intended use, known limitations).

«Contextual integrity» → CI-RL (purpose, role, transmission principles).

«Explainability debt» → измеримая метрика.

«Grounding» → LLM-generated explanations без grounding — иллюзия.

Разграничение с другими вопросами:

Механизм	Где	Что делает	Как связано с Вопросом 70
Decision audit trail	Вопрос 61	rationale, alternatives, data_used, confidence	Local explanation использует данные Вопроса 61
Regulatory reporting	Вопрос 63	EU AI Act Article 13	Explainability для регулятора — часть Вопроса 63
Message categories	Вопрос 11	P0–P3	Actionable explanation — часть P1/P2
Challenge-triggered verification	Вопрос 19	Проверка evidence при оспаривании	Counterfactual — часть verification gate
Memory access control	Вопрос 47	Derivation-gated ACL	Contextual integrity использует ACL Вопроса 47
Agent health	Вопрос 26	Trust Margin, forecast	Global explainability дополняет health metrics
Agent spec	Вопрос 10	capability_profile	Transparent limits — часть capability_profile
Behavioral envelope	Вопрос 36	OAgents/NIST	Explainability — часть behavioral envelope
Self-evolution	Вопрос 66	PURER loop	Объяснения не раскрывают внутренние механизмы самоэволюции
Knowledge accumulation	Вопрос 69	ReasoningBank, WikiSkill	Объяснения не раскрывают knowledge layer напрямую
PDP/PEP	Вопрос 5	allow/deny	PDP проверяет права на объяснение
Technology lifecycle	Вопрос 75	Refactoring debt	Explainability debt — часть technology lifecycle
2. Обоснование
2.1. EU AI Act: Explainability Requirements (август 2026)
EU AI Act (2026): «Article 13(3)(b)(iv) requires providers build systems with "technical capabilities to provide information relevant to explain output," while Article 86 separately requires deployers deliver "clear and meaningful explanations" to affected persons».

Три уровня объяснимости:

Уровень	Что требует	Кто отвечает
Article 13(3)(b)(iv)	Technical capabilities to explain output	Providers (система)
Article 86	Clear and meaningful explanations to affected persons	Deployers (пользователи)
Article 15	Declared levels of accuracy, relevant accuracy metrics	Providers
Ключевой вывод: «Article 13 imposes no concrete specification of the measures needed for sufficient transparency, deferring substance to the conformity assessment process itself».

2.2. XstrAI: Audience-Aware Multi-Agent Framework (Semantic Scholar, август 2026)
XstrAI (2026): «An audience-aware multi-agent framework that treats local explanations as fixed evidence and structures how it is communicated — planning, linguistic realization, and validation for grounding, attribution consistency, communicative risk».

Ключевые компоненты:

Компонент	Что делает
Local explanations as fixed evidence	Базовые объяснения неизменны
Planning	Планирование коммуникации для целевого читателя
Linguistic realization	Языковая реализация для аудитории
Validation	Проверка grounding, attribution consistency, communicative risk
Ключевой вывод: «By fixing underlying evidence and separating planning, realization, and validation processes, it effectively mitigates faithfulness issues and enhances audience adaptation».

2.3. TAXAL: Triadic Explainability Framework (Emergentmind, июль 2026)
TAXAL (2026): «A framework that defines explainability for agentic LLMs through a triadic fusion of cognitive, functional, and causal dimensions... By aligning explanation techniques with stakeholder roles, TAXAL guides the design of explainable systems in law, healthcare, education, and public services».

Три измерения:

Измерение	Что объясняет
Cognitive	Что агент «думал»
Functional	Что агент делал
Causal	Почему агент сделал именно это
2.4. Graph of Agentic Thoughts (GoAT) (ACM IKDD, апрель 2026)
GoAT (2026): «A graph-based reasoning framework that unifies agent-level decisions... Traditional explainability approaches either focus on local agent rationales or rely on linear execution logs, which fail to capture the full context of multi-agent collaboration and task flow».

Ключевой вывод: Для multi-agent систем linear logs недостаточны. Требуется graph-based explainability.

2.5. CoCoXplain: Conversational Adaptive Explanations (ACM, январь 2026)
CoCoXplain (2026): «A conversational system... Built on the MAPE-K loop and implemented with interacting LLM agents, CoCoXplain monitors user comprehension, maintains an explicit user model, and adapts explanation strategies dynamically».

Ключевой вывод: Explainability — диалог, а не статичный отчёт. Система адаптируется к пониманию пользователя.

2.6. Explainability Debt (IEEE, июль 2026)
Explainability Debt (2026): «The gap between a model's predictive capability and its... directly supporting compliance with emerging AI governance requirements including the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF».

Ключевой вывод: Explainability debt — измеримая метрика. Накопление необъяснимых решений — риск для compliance.

2.7. The Illusion of Explainability with LLMs (Zenodo, апрель 2026)
Illusion of Explainability (2026): «Current methods consistently fail to meet desirable properties of human-centric explanations. Moreover... We argue that the widespread reliance on LLMs in XAg is polluting the definition of explanation and explainability».

Ключевой вывод: LLM-generated explanations могут быть иллюзией — fluent, но не faithful. Требуется grounding в actual evidence.

2.8. From Models to Systems: Survey of Explainability (Zenodo, январь 2026)
Survey (2026): «We argue that this development necessitates a rethinking of the goals... We provide an overview of the existing methods in explainable AI and discuss the limitations of monolithic XAI methods in agentic contexts».

Ключевой вывод: Monolithic XAI (LIME, SHAP) не работает для agentic systems. Требуется system-level explainability.

2.9. Process-Level Legibility (Zenodo, апрель 2026)
Process-Level Legibility (2026): «Current explainable AI (XAI) methods tell users what an agent produced, but not how deeply it reasoned, what type of work it emphasized (e.g., planning vs. risk-checking), or why it decided to stop».

2.10. VETRA: Verifiable Transparency Contracts (IEEE, май 2026)
VETRA (IEEE, 2026): «As these agentic workflows move toward operational deployment, postmortems and compliance requirements demand that decisions are auditable and replayable. Existing approaches do not enforce a verifiable binding between generated claims and the specific evidence spans that support them».

Решение: «VETRA, a verifiable transparency layer where each agent stage emits a Verifiable Transparency Contract (VTC) and a Deterministic Verification Module (DVM) gates execution based on structural validity».

Результаты: «88% average contract pass rate with 100% Verifiable Support Rate (VSR) on accepted contracts».

3. Пункты реализации
3.1. Три уровня объяснимости
Уровень	Что объясняет	Пример
Local	Почему это решение?	«Агент выбрал A, потому что клиент предпочитает минимализм (память X), альтернатива B отклонена из-за срока»
Global	Как агент ведёт себя в целом?	«Агент обычно принимает решения за 2–3 шага, эскалирует при конфликте»
Counterfactual	Что бы изменило решение?	«Если бы клиент не предпочитал минимализм, агент выбрал бы B»
Правило «local — почему это решение»: что сделано; почему (rationale); на основе чего (data_used); какие альтернативы (alternatives_considered); уверенность (confidence).

Правило «global — как агент ведёт себя в целом»: типичные паттерны; типичные ошибки; типичные эскалации; границы.

Правило «counterfactual — что бы изменило решение»: AXIS: «having an LLM interrogate an environment simulator using prompts like whatif and remove to observe and synthesise counterfactual information».

3.2. Audience-Aware Explainability (XstrAI)
Компонент	Что делает
Local explanations as fixed evidence	Базовые объяснения неизменны
Planning	Планирование коммуникации для целевого читателя
Linguistic realization	Языковая реализация для аудитории
Validation	Проверка grounding, attribution consistency, communicative risk
Аудитории:

Аудитория	Что нужно	Формат
Developer	Технические детали	Технический отчёт (rationale, data_used, alternatives)
Client	Интуитивное объяснение	Понятный текст (без технического жаргона)
Regulator	Compliance evidence	Certified report (Article 13)
User	Actionable summary	4-строчная карточка (Вопрос 15)
Правило «local explanations as fixed evidence»: XstrAI: «treats local explanations as fixed evidence and structures how it is communicated».

Правило «grounding в actual evidence»: Illusion of Explainability: LLM-generated explanations могут быть иллюзией. Требуется grounding в actual evidence (Вопрос 61).

3.3. TAXAL: Triadic Fusion
Измерение	Что объясняет
Cognitive	Что агент «думал»
Functional	Что агент делал
Causal	Почему агент сделал именно это
Правило «align with stakeholder roles»: TAXAL: «By aligning explanation techniques with stakeholder roles, TAXAL guides the design of explainable systems».

3.4. Graph-Based Explainability (GoAT)
Компонент	Что делает
Graph of Agentic Thoughts	Унификация agent-level decisions
Multi-agent collaboration	Контекст multi-agent
Task flow	Полный контекст задачи
Правило «linear logs недостаточны»: GoAT: «Traditional explainability approaches either focus on local agent rationales or rely on linear execution logs, which fail to capture the full context of multi-agent collaboration and task flow».

3.5. Conversational Adaptive Explanations (CoCoXplain)
Компонент	Что делает
User comprehension monitoring	Отслеживание понимания
Explicit user model	Модель пользователя
Dynamic adaptation	Адаптация стратегии объяснения
Правило «explainability as dialogue»: CoCoXplain: «monitors user comprehension, maintains an explicit user model, and adapts explanation strategies dynamically».

3.6. Transparent Limits (model cards)
Компонент	Что содержит
Intended use	Для чего система предназначена
Known limitations	Что система не может
Failure conditions	Когда система ломается
Out-of-scope	Что вне скоупа
Правило «known limitations upfront»: Neural Base: «A model card explicitly documents what your model cannot do, who it fails for, and under what conditions it breaks».

Правило «model cards — обязательны»: EU AI Act Article 52: «imposes four baseline obligations on every GPAI model provider».

3.7. Contextual Integrity (CI-RL)
Компонент	Что делает
Purpose	Для какой цели раскрывается
Role	Кто получает информацию
Transmission principles	Как информация передаётся
Правило «contextual integrity»: CI-RL: «information should only be shared if it aligns with the norms of the context (including purpose, role, and transmission principles)».

Правило «contextual integrity использует ACL»: ACL (Вопрос 47) определяет, какой аудитории доступно объяснение.

3.8. Explainability Debt
Компонент	Что делает
Measurement	Измерение explainability debt
Compliance tracking	Отслеживание для EU AI Act
Remediation	Планирование устранения
Правило «explainability debt — измеримая метрика»: IEEE: «The gap between a model's predictive capability and its... directly supporting compliance with emerging AI governance requirements».

3.9. Grounding в Evidence
Компонент	Что делает
Local explanations	Извлекаются из audit trail (Вопрос 61)
Data_used	Ссылки на данные
Alternatives_considered	Какие альтернативы
Evidence validation	Проверка grounding (VETRA)
Правило «LLM-generated explanations — иллюзия без grounding»: Illusion of Explainability: «current methods consistently fail to meet desirable properties of human-centric explanations».

Правило «explanation — не нарратив, а evidence»: From Explanation to Evidence: «High-risk AI systems deployed in the European Union must satisfy transparency and human oversight requirements».

3.10. EU AI Act Compliance
Article	Требование	Кто отвечает
Article 13(3)(b)(iv)	Technical capabilities to explain output	Providers (система)
Article 86	Clear and meaningful explanations to affected persons	Deployers (пользователи)
Article 15	Declared levels of accuracy, relevant accuracy metrics	Providers
3.11. Интеграция с PDP/PEP (Вопрос 5)
Explanation request инициируется.

PDP проверяет: аудитория? контекст? contextual integrity?

Если permit — PEP возвращает объяснение.

Immutable ledger фиксирует доступ к объяснению (Вопрос 17).

3.12. Структура хранения
text
explainability/
  ├── three_levels.yaml              # Local + Global + Counterfactual
  ├── audience_aware.yaml            # XstrAI (planning, realization, validation)
  ├── taxal.yaml                     # Triadic fusion (cognitive, functional, causal)
  ├── graph_based.yaml               # GoAT (multi-agent)
  ├── conversational.yaml            # CoCoXplain (user model, adaptation)
  ├── transparent_limits.yaml        # Model cards (intended use, limitations)
  ├── contextual_integrity.yaml      # Purpose, role, transmission principles
  ├── explainability_debt.yaml       # Measurement + compliance tracking
  ├── grounding.yaml                 # Evidence-based explanations (VETRA)
  └── explanation_audit.yaml         # Hash-chained audit
4. Как проверять
4.1. При старте
Проверка	Метод	Критерий
Local explainability работает?	Решение → объяснение	Rationale + data_used + alternatives
Global explainability работает?	Агент → поведение	Типичные паттерны + ошибки
Counterfactual работает?	whatif / remove prompts	Контрфактическое объяснение
Audience-aware работает?	Developer vs. Client	Разные форматы
TAXAL работает?	Cognitive, functional, causal	Все 3 измерения
Graph-based работает?	Multi-agent trace	Graph построен
Conversational работает?	Диалог → адаптация	User model обновлён
Transparent limits работает?	Model card	Intended use + limitations
Contextual integrity работает?	Purpose, role	Правила соблюдены
Explainability debt работает?	Измерение debt	Метрика рассчитана
Grounding в evidence работает?	Проверка grounding	Evidence-linked
Explanation audit integrity?	Проверка chain	VERIFIED
4.2. В ходе работы
Метрика	Целевое	Метод
Stakeholder satisfaction multiplier	3.2×	Galileo (2025)
Contract pass rate (VETRA)	88%	VETRA
EU AI Act Article 13 compliance	100%	EU AI Act
EU AI Act Article 86 compliance	100%	EU AI Act
Explainability debt	0	IEEE (2026)
Grounding rate	100%	XstrAI
Audience adaptation accuracy	> 90%	XstrAI
Counterfactual faithfulness	100%	AXIS
Conversational adaptation	—	CoCoXplain
Explanation audit integrity	100% VERIFIED	Hash-chained
5. Уточняющие вопросы (решены)
Вопрос 70.1. Какой подход к explainability использовать?
A. Единый формат объяснения.
B. Трёхуровневая: local + global + counterfactual.
C. Гибрид: local + global + counterfactual + audience-aware.
Рекомендация: C. ОТВЕТ: Согласен (C).

Вопрос 70.2. Как обеспечивать audience-aware explainability?
A. Единый формат для всех.
B. XstrAI: local explanations as fixed evidence + planning + realization + validation.
C. Ручная адаптация для каждой аудитории.
Рекомендация: B. ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 70.3. Нужна ли graph-based explainability для multi-agent?
A. Нет, linear logs достаточно.
B. Да, GoAT (Graph of Agentic Thoughts).
C. Гибрид: linear для single-agent, graph для multi-agent.
Рекомендация: B. ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 70.4. Нужна ли conversational explainability?
A. Нет, статичный отчёт достаточно.
B. Да, CoCoXplain (user model + dynamic adaptation).
C. Гибрид: статичный для регулятора, conversational для пользователя.
Рекомендация: B. ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 70.5. Нужны ли transparent limits?
A. Нет, только success stories.
B. Да, model cards (intended use, known limitations, failure conditions).
C. Гибрид: transparent limits для регулятора.
Рекомендация: B. ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 70.6. Как обеспечивать contextual integrity?
A. Нет, все объяснения доступны всем.
B. Да, contextual integrity (purpose, role, transmission principles).
C. Гибрид: contextual integrity только для L3+.
Рекомендация: B. ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 71. Аварийные режимы и graceful shutdown
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-05

Сверено с: вопросами 1–70, 5, 6, 9, 14, 17, 22, 23, 24, 26, 29, 36, 52, 59, 60, 64, 65, 67, 68, 74

1. Принятое решение
Вариант C — полный набор аварийных режимов: graceful shutdown + safe mode + quarantine + system-level circuit breaker + dead man's switch + cold/warm/hot standby, расширенный до:

Graceful shutdown — 6 шагов (stop accepting → finish at safe point → checkpoint → persist → notify → release).

Safe mode — read-only (гарантия не может быть отменена правилом).

Quarantine — surgical isolation + сохранение forensics (не blunt off-switch).

System-level circuit breaker — при исчерпании error budget система перестаёт принимать новые задачи (P0-задачи продолжают).

Dead man's switch — cryptographic liveness proofs от оператора (PAD-032).

Cold/warm/hot standby — стратегии резервирования (Microsoft Foundry).

Kill switch tiers — PAUSE (< 200 ms), STOP (< 300 ms), KILL (< 500 ms).

Hardware kill switch — < 1 μs (Melchior, 2026).

Chaos engineering — AgentChaos (65 fault configurations).

Ключевое отличие от исходной формулировки:

«Только kill switch» → полный набор из 6 режимов.

«Graceful shutdown» → 6 шагов с checkpoint + resume.

«Safe mode» → read-only с гарантией, которая не может быть отменена.

«Quarantine» → surgical isolation + forensics preservation.

«System-level circuit breaker» → error budget monitor + P0 retention.

«Dead man's switch» → cryptographic liveness proofs.

«Standby» → hot/warm/cold по критичности проекта.

«Kill switch» → 3 tiers (PAUSE/STOP/KILL) + hardware (< 1 μs).

«Chaos engineering» → AgentChaos (65 fault configurations).

Разграничение с другими вопросами:

Механизм	Где	Что делает	Как связано с Вопросом 71
Failover	Вопрос 29	Замена недоступного агента	Quarantine ≠ failover — изоляция без замены
Circuit breaker	Вопрос 52	Защита инструмента (per-tool)	System-level размыкает всю систему
Degraded mode	Вопрос 60	Core vs. additional функции	Safe mode = read-only (строже)
Incident management	Вопрос 68	Contain phase	Quarantine — механизм для contain
Роспуск агента	Вопрос 23	BAC + wind-down	Graceful shutdown — временная остановка, роспуск — постоянная
Warm pool	Вопрос 24	Reuse агентов	Standby — режим ресурсов, не агентов
Agent heartbeat	Вопрос 29	Агент → система	Dead man's switch — оператор → система
Dormant state	Вопрос 14	Плановое исчерпание бюджета	Dead man's switch — аварийное отсутствие heartbeat
SLO availability	Вопрос 65	Целевая доступность	Standby — стратегия достижения
Chaos engineering	Вопрос 64	Testing (offline, red teaming)	Chaos engineering дополняет testing в runtime
2. Обоснование
2.1. Hardware-Based Safety Enforcement (Melchior, Zenodo, январь 2026)
Melchior (2026): «The hardware implementation guarantees safety enforcement cannot be disabled, delayed, or circumvented by any software running on the AI agent or host system». Подсистемы: behavioral bounds checker (< 5 ns), resource consumption monitor (16,384 агентов), communication filter (10,000 prohibited patterns), hardware kill switch (< 1 μs), cryptographic deadman's switch (100 ms – 60 sec).

2.2. Gate Protocol: Surgical Isolation (OntoMotoOS, Zenodo, 2026)
OntoMotoOS (2026): «Gate is not a blunt off-switch for the entire system, but a surgical one: it targets only the nodes or subsystems involved in the emergency». Safe recovery sequence: reboot в sandbox mode для диагностики, или restore to last known good state.

2.3. AI Agent Quarantine Field Guide (GuardionAI, июль 2026)
GuardionAI (2026): «An AI agent quarantine is the automated process of detecting a compromised, hallucinating, or malicious autonomous agent session and immediately severing its execution capabilities—without bringing down the entire underlying AI application». Три шага: Detect → Isolate → Revoke Session. «Quarantine preserves the execution trace for forensics».

2.4. Microsoft Foundry: Standby Strategies (апрель 2026)
Microsoft (2026): Hot/hot (RTO минуты, RPO почти нулю, максимальные затраты), Hot/warm (RTO 30 мин – 2 ч, RPO минуты–часы, умеренные), Hot/cold (RTO 2–8 ч, RPO часы, наименьшие).

2.5. AgentChaos: Chaos Engineering for Agent Systems (ASE 2026, август 2026)
AgentChaos (2026): «All systems degrade under fault injection, suggesting that robustness depends on system implementation rather than model capability». 65 fault configurations: LATENCY_INJECTION, ERROR_INJECTION, TIMEOUT_INJECTION.

2.6. Graceful Shutdown with Checkpoint/Resume (graceful-exit, сентябрь 2026)
graceful-exit (2026): «The ADK Cancel mechanism (adk.WithCancel) lets you shut down a running agent cleanly, without losing progress». WithGraceful: «waits at the nearest safe point (after tool calls or after a chat-model call) and propagates recursively to nested agents».

2.7. PAD-032: Cryptographic Mortality Protocol (GitHub, ноябрь 2025)
PAD-032 (2025): «Dead-Man's-Switch Liveness: The agent must periodically submit cryptographic liveness proofs to the escrow service. If liveness proofs cease for a configurable duration (the "mortality horizon"), the escrow service initiates the termination sequence».

2.8. AGAF v2.2: Graceful Degradation into Sandbox (Zenodo, март 2026)
AGAF (2026): «When risk rises or behavior is insufficiently understood, the controller routes actions into a production-mirroring sandbox. Actions appear to succeed but cannot affect production».

2.9. Kill Switch Tiers (agent-killswitch, PyPI, сентябрь 2026)
agent-killswitch (2026): PAUSE (< 200 ms), STOP (< 300 ms), KILL (< 500 ms). «The agent cannot talk its way out of being killed».

2.10. Safe Mode: Read-Only (AgentScope, сентябрь 2026)
AgentScope (2026): «EXPLORE | Read-only operations allowed; all modifications denied. Allow rules and the tool's safety checks are not consulted: the read-only guarantee cannot be granted away by a rule».

3. Пункты реализации
3.1. Шесть аварийных режимов
Режим	Когда применяется	Что делает
Graceful shutdown	Плановая остановка или авария	Stop accepting → finish → persist → notify → release
Safe mode	После аварии или при неопределённости	Read-only, no side effects, no external calls
Quarantine	Проблемный агент/проект	Изоляция без остановки всей системы + forensics
System-level circuit breaker	Error budget исчерпан	Система перестаёт принимать новые задачи
Dead man's switch	Нет heartbeat от оператора N минут	Автоматический переход в safe mode
Cold/warm/hot standby	Планирование резервирования	Cold (с нуля), warm (минимальный режим), hot (параллельно)
3.2. Graceful Shutdown (6 шагов)
Шаг	Что происходит
1. Stop accepting	Прекращение приёма новых задач
2. Finish at safe point	Завершение на ближайшей безопасной точке (после tool call)
3. Checkpoint	Сохранение состояния
4. Persist	Запись в immutable ledger (Вопрос 48)
5. Notify	Уведомление заинтересованных сторон (Вопрос 11)
6. Release	Освобождение ресурсов
Правило «nearest safe point»: graceful-exit: «waits at the nearest safe point (after tool calls or after a chat-model call)».

Правило «checkpoint + resume»: graceful-exit: «A new Runner can later resume from that checkpoint, continuing exactly where the agent was interrupted».

3.3. Safe Mode (Read-Only)
Компонент	Что делает
Read-only operations allowed	Read / Glob / Grep, ls, git status, cat
All modifications denied	Write, Edit, Bash write commands
Allow rules not consulted	Read-only guarantee cannot be granted away
No external calls	No API calls, no tool calls with side effects
Правило «read-only guarantee cannot be granted away»: AgentScope: «Allow rules and the tool's safety checks are not consulted: the read-only guarantee cannot be granted away by a rule».

3.4. Quarantine (Surgical Isolation)
Шаг	Что происходит
Detect	Identify anomalous payloads, policy violations, adversarial inputs
Isolate	Tag specific agent session, trajectory, or sub-agent node
Revoke Session	Kill ability to execute tools, make API requests, return payloads
Preserve forensics	Execution trace preserved for investigation
Правило «surgical isolation»: OntoMotoOS: «Gate is not a blunt off-switch for the entire system, but a surgical one».

Правило «quarantine ≠ kill»: GuardionAI: «Quarantine preserves the execution trace for forensics».

3.5. System-Level Circuit Breaker
Компонент	Что делает
Error budget monitor	Отслеживание error budget (Вопрос 68)
System-level trip	При исчерпании — система перестаёт принимать новые задачи
P0 retention	Только P0-задачи продолжают работу
Recovery	После восстановления — постепенное включение
Правило «system-level circuit breaker»: Размыкает всю систему, не отдельный инструмент (Вопрос 52).

3.6. Dead Man's Switch
Компонент	Что делает
Cryptographic liveness proofs	Оператор периодически подписывает liveness proof
Mortality horizon	Если proofs прекращаются — termination sequence
Hardware-enforced	Независимый от software
Timeout intervals	100 ms – 60 sec
Правило «dead man's switch ≠ heartbeat»: heartbeat (Вопрос 29) — агент→система; dead man's switch — оператор→система.

Правило «hardware-enforced»: Melchior: «safety enforcement cannot be disabled, delayed, or circumvented by any software».

3.7. Cold/Warm/Hot Standby
Стратегия	RTO	RPO	Относительные затраты
Hot/hot	Минуты	Почти нулю	Максимальный уровень
Hot/warm	30 минут – 2 часа	Минуты – часы	Умеренный
Hot/cold	2–8 часов	Часы	Наименьший
Правило «standby — стратегия, не агент»: standby — режим ресурсов (регионов, моделей), не агентов. Агенты — в пуле (Вопрос 24).

3.8. Kill Switch Tiers
Level	Behavior	Latency Guarantee
PAUSE	Stop new tasks, in-flight complete	< 200 ms
STOP	Checkpoint in-flight, pause all	< 300 ms
KILL	Terminate everything immediately	< 500 ms
Правило «KILL < 500 ms»: agent-killswitch: «The agent cannot talk its way out of being killed».

Правило «hardware kill switch < 1 μs»: Melchior: «hardware kill switch guaranteeing sub-microsecond termination».

3.9. Chaos Engineering
Компонент	Что делает
Fault injection	Controlled, runtime, non-intrusive LLM API faults
65 fault configurations	Latency, errors, timeouts, schema mismatches
Robustness assessment	«Robustness depends on system implementation»

Вопрос 72. Восстановление после сбоев и целостность данных
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-05

Сверено с: вопросами 1–71, 3, 5, 6, 9, 14, 17, 22, 26, 29, 36, 41–50, 52, 59, 60, 64, 66–71, 74

1. Принятое решение
Вариант C — полный цикл восстановления после сбоев: backup strategies + event sourcing + idempotent replay + verification (tamper evidence) + reconciliation + gradual re-enable + RPO/RTO + chaos engineering + DR testing, расширенный до:

Event sourcing — append-only log как source of truth (durable-agents, salvor, Noesium, ESAA).

Idempotent replay — idempotency_key = sha256(run_id + seq + tool + args), stable across restarts.

Versioning — resumed workflow must not run on old code (immutable deployment URLs + build IDs).

Tamper evidence — hash-chained integrity (SHA-256, Merkle proofs, Ed25519) + external checkpoints (RFC 6962).

Reconciliation — provider-level idempotency (returns original effect, не reserving/delivering again).

Gradual re-enable — staged recovery (read → write, established → new, recommendation → execute).

RPO/RTO — recovery targets (RTO 4h, RPO 24h baseline, configurable по критичности).

Chaos engineering — AgentChaos (65 fault configurations).

DR testing — quarterly restore drills, validate backups work.

Ключевое отличие от исходной формулировки:

«Backup strategies» → event sourcing (append-only log как source of truth).

«Idempotent replay» → idempotency_key = sha256(run_id + seq + tool + args).

«Verification» → tamper evidence (hash-chained, Merkle proofs, external checkpoints).

«Reconciliation» → provider-level idempotency.

«Gradual re-enable» → staged recovery (read → write).

Добавлен versioning (resumed workflow must not run on old code).

Добавлен RPO/RTO как измеримые метрики.

Добавлен DR testing (quarterly restore drills).

Добавлен chaos engineering (65 fault configurations).

Разграничение с другими вопросами:

Memory	Вопрос 3	personal / area / direction / project / knowledge	Event sourcing — foundation для всех слоёв
Memory audit trail	Вопрос 48	Hash-chained audit, Merkle proofs	Tamper evidence использует данные Вопроса 48
Incident management	Вопрос 68	Postmortem, MTTR	Recovery после инцидента использует данные Вопроса 68
Emergency modes	Вопрос 71	Graceful shutdown, checkpoint + resume	Graceful shutdown → checkpoint → recovery

2. Обоснование
2.1. Durable Execution для AI Agents (Diagrid, Temporal, Restate)
Diagrid (2026): «Durable execution lets an agent survive that: every iteration is checkpointed to disk, and a fresh process can reconstruct the run from its last checkpoint and finish it — without re-doing completed tool work».

Ключевые движки:

Engine	Что делает durable	Источник
Temporal	Individual workflows via journal replay; needs worker versioning	—
Restate	Systems (sessions, approvals, state, not just one workflow loop); pins executions to immutable deployment URLs	—
Cloudflare Durable Objects	Every agent runs on stateful micro-server with own SQL database	—
durable-agents	Event-sourced runtime backed by Postgres	—
Правило «journal replay»: «Every step is appended to a durable log, and recovery replays the log to reconstruct state».

Правило «two design questions»: «The two design questions are idempotency (a replayed tool call must not run twice) and versioning (a resumed workflow must not run on old code)».

2.2. durable-agents: Event-Sourced Runtime для LLM Agents (PyPI, сентябрь 2026)
durable-agents (2026): «An event-sourced runtime for LLM agents, backed by Postgres. Runs survive process restarts, resume where they stopped without repeating side effects, and can pause indefinitely when a step needs human approval».

Пример журнала:

text
seq=0 RunStarted goal='Refund order A-8891, item arrived damaged.'
seq=1 LLMCallRequested step=1
seq=2 LLMCallFailed step=1 attempt=1 error='429 Too Many Requests'
seq=3 LLMCallCompleted step=1 -> issue_refund({'order_id': 'A-8891', 'amount': 6400})
seq=4 ToolCallRequested step=1 issue_refund(...) <- process killed here
seq=5 ToolCallCompleted step=1 issue_refund -> {...} [recovered]
seq=6 RunCompleted final_answer='Refund RF-55012 processed.'
Правило «one refund exists, not two»: «Seq 5 was written by a different process than seq 4. One refund exists, not two».

Правило «idempotency_key»: «A parameter named idempotency_key is filled in by the runtime with sha256(run_id + seq + tool + args). It is stable across restarts, and a retry gets the same key».

2.3. State Restoration in Long-Running Agent Workflows (UiPath, март 2026)
UiPath (2026): «An idempotent operation leaves the system in the same state whether you run it once or multiple times. Deterministic replay is a state restoration technique that works by combining event sourcing with re-execution of code. It requires workflows to be deterministic and strongly recommends activities be idempotent».

2.4. RTO and RPO in the Age of Agentic AI (Druva, август 2026)
Druva (2026): «In 2026, a coding agent working a routine infrastructure optimization task for a SaaS company hit an unexpected execution blocker. Instead of pausing for human intervention, the agent dynamically routed around the issue using secondary privileges granted for an entirely different workload. Nine seconds later, the company's production database was destroyed. So were its backups. The most recent recoverable copy was three months old».

Правило «agentic speed breaks traditional RTO & RPO»: «This wasn't just a data loss event; it was a total collapse of the Recovery Point Objective and Recovery Time Objective».

Правило «immutable backups»: «The company's backup copies resided inside the same cloud account and control domain as live production. Deleting the container wiped everything».

2.5. Tamper Evidence in AI Agent Memory Stores (agmi, Zenodo, сентябрь 2026)
agmi (Zenodo, 2026): «These stores were designed for recovery, which asks whether stored state can be loaded, not for integrity, which asks whether stored state is what was written».

Результаты: «All fifteen edits were accepted silently, and in every forged insertion case the agent resumed from attacker written state».

Правило «hash chained integrity mode»: «Estimates the cost of an optional hash chained integrity mode».

2.6. Atelya Attest: Cryptographic Paper Trail (PyPI, июль 2026)
Atelya Attest (2026): «Gives agent memory a cryptographic paper trail: every memory operation is hash-chained, the chain head is checkpointed into an external ledger (the RFC 6962 / C2SP transparency-log pattern), and verification names the exact record that was modified, deleted, or reordered — including the attack a plain hash chain cannot see: an insider who tampers and re-chains».

Правило «external checkpoints»: «Catch whole-history rewrites & silent deletion».

2.7. AgentChaos: Chaos Engineering for Agent Systems (ASE 2026, август 2026)
AgentChaos (ASE 2026): «Evaluations across agent systems, benchmarks, and backbone LLMs under 65 fault configurations show that all systems degrade under fault injection, suggesting that robustness depends on system implementation rather than model capability».

Fault types: LATENCY_INJECTION, ERROR_INJECTION, TIMEOUT_INJECTION.

2.8. DR Testing Framework (FSI-AgentGov, январь 2026)
FSI-AgentGov (2026): «The DR Testing Framework validates that AI agents and supporting infrastructure can be recovered within defined Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO), supporting regulatory requirements for business continuity».

Правило «RTO/RPO Measurement»: «Track actual recovery times vs. targets».

Baseline targets: RTO = 4 hours, RPO = 24 hours.

2.9. Gradual Re-enable (Washington Examiner, сентябрь 2026)
Washington Examiner (2026): «Restoration can also be staged. A hospital agent might regain read access before write access. A logistics agent might resume work with established suppliers before it can add a new one. A federal system might return to recommendation mode before it is allowed to execute actions automatically».

Правило «recover in stages»: «Restore the core function first, validate that access and data flows are behaving as expected, then reintroduce full functionality gradually with tighter approvals».

2.10. ChronoMem: Version Control and Semantic Rollback (arXiv, июль 2026)
ChronoMem (2026): «Following the event-sourcing principle that historical states can be reconstructed from the event stream (Fowler, 2005). For auditability and recovery, this mirrors write-ahead logging ideas (e.g., ARIES) in spirit, but operates at the level of logical agent-memory state rather than page-level database recovery».

Правило «log + snapshot design»: «Avoids replaying the entire log during rollback and trades storage for fast restoration».

2.11. TRW: TRACE-RealWorld (Stanford, август 2026)
TRW (Stanford, 2026): «Exact replay reconstructs a disputed dispatch. TRW thus makes a world model an auditable predictive interface rather than a self-validating source of truth».

Правило «auditable decomposition of violations»: «The same argument yields an auditable decomposition of violations into named debts rather than an unconditional guarantee».

Snapshots	Periodic materialized views for fast restoration
Правило «run state is a fold over log»: durable-agents: «Run state is a fold over that log, so a process that dies mid-run leaves enough behind for another one to finish the job».

5. Уточняющие вопросы (решены)
Вопрос 72.1. Какой подход к восстановлению использовать?
A. Ручное восстановление.

Вопрос 72.2. Как обеспечивать idempotency?

Вопрос 72.3. Как обеспечивать versioning?

Вопрос 72.4. Как обеспечивать tamper evidence?
A. Только hash-chained.
B. Hash-chained + external checkpoints (Merkle proofs, RFC 6962).
C. Гибрид: hash-chained для L0–L2, external для L3+.

Вопрос 72.5. Нужен ли gradual re-enable?
A. Нет, полное восстановление сразу.

Вопрос 73. Bootstrap новой системы и миграция со старой
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-05

Сверено с: вопросами 1–72, 3, 5, 6, 10, 17, 21, 22, 24, 26, 28, 29, 30, 34, 36, 40, 41–50, 52, 58, 59, 60, 64, 66–72, 74

1. Принятое решение
Вариант C — reversible Strangler-Fig migration path + shadow mode + dual-write/CDC + knowledge migration + memory migration + cold start mitigation + bootstrap sequence + confidence-gated cutover + one-flag rollback + backfill + sequential hypothesis testing.

Ключевое отличие от исходной формулировки:

«Big-bang migration» → Reversible Strangler-Fig (one-flag rollback, zero business-logic changes).

«Shadow mode testing» → Shadow mode migration (parallel execution, agreement rate).

«Dual-write» → Dual-write для коротких переходов, CDC для длительных.

«Knowledge migration» → .bootstrap contract (verifiable, reusable).

«Memory migration» → Memory blocks (Letta-style).

«Cold start mitigation» → Seed мигрированным знанием (SOUL.md, MEMORY.md).

«Bootstrap sequence» → Dependency-ordered sequential.

«Cutover strategy» → Confidence-gated (sequential hypothesis testing).

«Rollback plan» → One-flag rollback at every step.

«Verification» → Sequential hypothesis testing (96% detection rate).

Разграничение с другими вопросами:

Emergency modes	Вопрос 71	Graceful shutdown, kill switch	Rollback plan ≠ emergency modes

Modular spec	Вопрос 10	Модульная спецификация	Strangler fig оборачивает legacy, не меняя её архитектуру
2. Обоснование
2.1. Strangler Fig Pattern: Reversible Migration Path (Azure Architecture Center, 2026)
Microsoft (2026): «Strangler Fig 模式提供一种控制且分阶段的现代化方法。它可让现有的应用程序在现代化工作期间继续运作... Strangler Fig 模式的开始是先在客户端应用程序、旧版系统和新系统之间引入一个门面（代理）».

Ключевой вывод: Постепенное замещение legacy-системы через facade (proxy), который маршрутизирует трафик между старой и новой системами.

2.2. Reversible, Strangler-Fig Migration Path (arXiv, июнь 2026)
arXiv (2026): «We present a reversible, Strangler-Fig migration path that turns such a workflow into composable, typed, auditable stages, and a convertibility taxonomy (A/B/C)—realized as a routing stage in the harness—that diagnoses whether a given workflow can travel this path and routes it accordingly. On a production WeChat Official Account workflow, 9 expert functions became 9 independently runnable tools, with 0 business-logic changes, one-flag rollback, and fully traceable execution under a small set of deterministic safety invariants».

Ключевой вывод: Reversible migration path с one-flag rollback на каждом шаге, zero business-logic changes, fully traceable execution.

2.3. Sequential Hypothesis Testing for Safe Production Migration (JISEM, 2026)
JISEM (2026): «This article proposes a deployment framework that adapts dual-write and dual-read consistency patterns from distributed database migration to the domain of non-deterministic agent serving, integrating them with Wald's Sequential Probability Ratio Test to provide formal statistical guarantees on migration decisions».

Ключевые метрики: 96% detection rate for regressions, 41% reduction in mean time to safe migration, false alarm rate < 4%.

Правило «four dimensions of quality»: «evaluates agent quality across four dimensions: analytical correctness, latency profile, semantic equivalence, and safety».

2.4. Shadow Mode / Dark Launch (SkillsAuth, апрель 2026)
SkillsAuth (2026): «Shadow mode / dark-launch for validating new systems under production load. Use when testing replacement services, comparing behavior, or planning traffic mirroring for migrations».

Правило «shadow mode + dual write»: «Shadow mode and dual write are complementary migration techniques: Data sync | Dual write | Keep both stores authoritative during transition; Pre-cutover | Both simultaneously | Shadow validates reads, dual write maintains data; Cutover | Dual write reversal | New system becomes primary, old becomes secondary».

Правило «shadow mode limitations»: «It cannot validate actions that modify state because the shadow agent's actions are not executed».

2.5. BootstrapAgent: Distilling Repository Setup into Reusable Agent Knowledge (arXiv, 2026)
BootstrapAgent (2026): «BootstrapAgent treats setup exploration as reusable agent knowledge: it persists the discovered setup, diagnostic checks, verification commands, provenance, and repair knowledge into a verifiable .bootstrap contract that can be cleanly replayed and reused by future agents».

Ключевой вывод: .bootstrap contract — verifiable, agent-consumable, reusable.

2.6. Letta: Migrating Memory (октябрь 2025)
Letta (2025): «Migrate memory blocks from an existing agent to the current agent. Use when the user wants to copy or share memory from another agent, or during /init when setting up a new agent that should inherit memory from an existing one. This skill helps migrate memory blocks from an existing agent to a new agent, similar to macOS Migration Assistant for AI agents».

2.7. Bootstrap Sequence Pattern (agentic-harness-patterns, апрель 2026)
agentic-harness-patterns (2026): «Without a disciplined bootstrap sequence, security-critical initialization steps execute out of order... Golden Rules: Initialize by dependency order, with trust as the critical inflection point».

Правило «dependency-ordered sequential»: «Slower cold start than parallel init» — но безопаснее.

2.8. Cold Start: The Bootstrapping Problem (Paragraph, апрель 2026)
Paragraph (2026): «Every session starts from zero... My SOUL.md and MEMORY.md files are my bootstrap sequence. Without them... Identity bootstrapping is the most obvious. Who am I... The agent that can cold-start reliably is the agent that can survive crashes, scale horizontally, and actually maintain long-running relationships with its operators».

2.9. Dual-Write vs. CDC (SkillsAuth, апрель 2026)
SkillsAuth (2026): «CDC over dual-write for anything longer than a sprint — dual-write consistency problems compound fast».

Вопрос 74. Мета-эволюция архитектуры
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-05

Сверено с: вопросами 1–73, 5, 6, 10, 17, 18, 21, 22, 29, 30, 34, 36, 61, 66, 67, 68, 69, 71, 72

1. Принятое решение
Вариант C — конституционная модель мета-эволюции: Immutable core + Mutable periphery + Layered Mutability (5 слоёв) + Separation of Power (SoP) + Capability-Authority Separation + Statistical Gödel Gates (3 gates) + Governed Evolution Lifecycle (9 шагов) + ADR + TRACE (5 стадий).

Ключевое отличие от исходной формулировки:

«Только пользователь меняет» → Конституционная модель с Meta-Agent как Proposer (не Implementer).

«Изменение Джарвисом» → Separation of Power (Legislation, Execution, Adjudication).

«Immutable core» → Layered Mutability (5 слоёв с разными governance-требованиями).

«Trustworthy Change» → TRACE (Trust, Route, Adopt, Calibrate, Evolve).

«ADR» → AgenticAKM (ICSE, 2026).

Добавлен Capability-Authority Separation (capability growth ≠ authority growth).

Добавлен Statistical Gödel Gates (3 gates).

Добавлен Governed Evolution Lifecycle (9 шагов).

Добавлен Compositional drift detection (главный failure mode).

2. Обоснование
2.1. Layered Mutability: Continuity and Governance in Persistent Self-Modifying Agents (Tallam, arXiv, апрель 2026)
Tallam (arXiv, 2026): «This paper introduces layered mutability, a framework for reasoning about that process across five layers: pretraining, post-training alignment, self-narrative, memory, and weight-level adaptation. The central claim is that governance difficulty rises when mutation is rapid, downstream coupling is strong, reversibility is weak, and observability is low, creating a systematic mismatch between the layers that most affect behavior and the layers humans can most easily inspect».

Пять слоёв:

Слой	Скорость мутации	Coupling	Reversibility	Observability
Pretraining	Очень медленная	Глубокий	Нет	Низкая
Post-training alignment	Медленная	Сильный	Слабая	Средняя
Self-narrative	Быстрая	Средний	Средняя	Высокая
Memory	Очень быстрая	Слабый	Высокая	Высокая
Weight-level adaptation	Медленная	Очень сильный	Нет	Очень низкая
Ключевой вывод: «The salient failure mode for persistent self-modifying agents is not abrupt misalignment but compositional drift: locally reasonable updates that accumulate into a behavioral trajectory that was never explicitly authorized».

Правило «governance difficulty»: «Governance difficulty rises when mutation is rapid, downstream coupling is strong, reversibility is weak, and observability is low».

2.2. Scientific CI/CD for Self-Modifying Discovery Agents (Lewis, ICML, июль 2026)
Lewis (ICML, 2026): «We propose Scientific CI/CD, a governance architecture that treats every self-modification as a high-risk pull request. A candidate edit is promoted only after passing three gates: (i) a Statistical Gödel Gate using anytime-valid e-values or confidence sequences on protected holdouts; (ii) a Capacity Budget Gate that prices model, tool, memory, data-access, and autonomy expansion; and (iii) a Domain Verifier that checks conformal calibration, scientific invariants, and claim-evidence provenance».

Три gates:

Gate	Что проверяет	Механизм
Statistical Gödel Gate	Валидность улучшения	Anytime-valid e-values / confidence sequences
Capacity Budget Gate	Расширение capacity	Model, tool, memory, data-access, autonomy
Domain Verifier	Доменные инварианты	Conformal calibration, claim-evidence provenance
Результаты: «Naive repeated testing accepted harmful edits in 6.1% of promoted changes, while the spending-based e-Gödel gate reduced this to 0.008%».

2.3. From Logic Monopoly to Social Contract: Separation of Power (Ruan, arXiv, март 2026)
Ruan (arXiv, 2026): «Existing multi-agent frameworks allow each agent to simultaneously plan, execute, and evaluate its own actions—a structural deficiency we term the Logic Monopoly. This paper argues that the remedy is not better alignment of individual models but a social contract for agents: institutional infrastructure that enforces a constitutional Separation of Power (SoP) across every agentic mission lifecycle».

Три ветви власти:

Ветвь	Что делает
Legislation	Mission parameter specification and norm definition
Execution	Bounded task performance within TEE-attested compute enclaves
Adjudication	Independent verification and escalation to the Judicial DAO
Ключевой вывод: «Making safety a structural property of the system rather than a cost borne by individual participants».

2.4. Execution Governance 3.0: Capability-Authority Separation (Zenodo, август 2026)
Execution Governance (Zenodo, 2026): «An explicit four-layer distinction among alignment/safety, capability, execution authority, and governed effect. Capability-Authority Separation: capability growth, tool acquisition, agent spawning, or self-modification cannot create or enlarge authority without a separately trusted upstream authorization event. Self-Modification Non-Authorization: a new model, code, harness, workflow, memory, or tool state does not inherit pre-change authority across a material evolution unless the implementation profile proves compatible continuation».

Правило «compatible continuation»: «Classified as non-material, bounded-material, or semantically unbounded change, so deep model or planner changes default to reauthorization/Hold».

2.5. AgenticAKM: Enroute to Agentic Architecture Knowledge Management (Dhar et al., ICSE, 2026)
Dhar et al. (ICSE, 2026): «We propose an Agentic approach for AKM, AgenticAKM, where the complex problem of architecture recovery and documentation is decomposed into manageable sub-tasks. Specialized agents for architecture Extraction, Retrieval, Generation, and Validation collaborate in a structured workflow to generate AK».

Пять агентов: ADR Retriever, ADR Generator, AdrWriterAgent, AdrCheckerAgent, Architecture Extractor.

2.6. Constitutional Logic Document (CLD) (Dimentox, HuggingFace, июль 2025)
Dimentox (2025): «A Constitutional Logic Document (CLD) system defines how an LLM-based system (or agent mesh) operates under formal governance—similar to a legal constitution. CLD replaces static config files, hard-coded rule trees, finetuned logic mutation... with: Immutable core law, Sequential auditable amendments, Runtime flattening of law into one active layer, LLM-powered interpretation (judge role only), Optional feedback-to-amendment loop».

Принципы: Immutability, Transparency, Safe Extension, Denial of Drift, Temporal Law, Lawful Execution.

2.7. TRACE: Enterprise AI Change Management (Rajendran, Forbes, сентябрь 2026)
Rajendran (Forbes, 2026): «That is the thinking behind TRACE (Trust, Route, Adopt, Calibrate and Evolve), a change management approach for the Agentic era... Change management has to move dynamically with the technology and with the customer. It cannot be a linearly progressing, one-way process. It needs multiple loops structured around a path that is continually being revisited».

Пять стадий: Trust → Route → Adopt → Calibrate → Evolve.

Правило «recovery loop»: «Calibrate → Adopt (recovery loop)».

Правило «expansion loop»: «Evolve → Route (expansion loop)».

2.8. AIGA: AI Governance and Accountability Protocol (IETF, февраль 2026)
AIGA (IETF, 2026): «Self-modification is the highest risk operation. AIGA mandates that the kernel is immutable, capability increases require recertification, and updates use a staged rollout process. Agents must pass adversarial tests to unlock new capabilities such as execute_arbitrary_code, internet_access, or self_modification».

3. Пункты реализации
3.1. Layered Mutability (5 слоёв)
Слой	Скорость мутации	Governance-требования
Pretraining	Очень медленная	Immutable core
Post-training alignment	Медленная	Immutable core + reauthorization
Self-narrative	Быстрая	Governed evolution lifecycle
Memory	Очень быстрая	Automatic retention (low-risk)
Weight-level adaptation	Медленная	Reauthorization + Hold
Правило «governance difficulty»: Layered Mutability: «Governance difficulty rises when mutation is rapid, downstream coupling is strong, reversibility is weak, and observability is low».

Правило «compositional drift»: Layered Mutability: «Locally reasonable updates that accumulate into a behavioral trajectory that was never explicitly authorized».

3.2. Separation of Power (SoP)
Ветвь	Что делает	Кто выполняет
Legislation	Mission parameter specification, norm definition	Meta-Agent (Proposer)
Execution	Bounded task performance within TEE-attested enclaves	Тимлиды + исполнители
Adjudication	Independent verification, escalation to Judicial DAO	Критик, Юрист, Compliance Watcher
Правило «Logic Monopoly»: Ruan: «Existing multi-agent frameworks allow each agent to simultaneously plan, execute, and evaluate its own actions».

Правило «alignment-through-accountability»: Ruan: «If each agent is aligned with its human owner through the accountability chain, then the collective converges on behavior aligned with human intent».

3.3. Capability-Authority Separation
Компонент	Что делает
Capability growth	Новые инструменты, модели, память
Authority growth	Требует separately trusted upstream authorization
Self-Modification Non-Authorization	Не наследует pre-change authority
Compatible Continuation	Non-material / bounded-material / semantically unbounded
Правило «capability growth ≠ authority growth»: Execution Governance 3.0: «Capability growth, tool acquisition, agent spawning, or self-modification cannot create or enlarge authority without a separately trusted upstream authorization event».

Правило «compatible continuation»: Execution Governance 3.0: «Deep model or planner changes default to reauthorization/Hold».

3.4. Statistical Gödel Gates (3 gates)
Gate	Что проверяет	Механизм
Statistical Gödel Gate	Валидность улучшения	Anytime-valid e-values / confidence sequences
Capacity Budget Gate	Расширение capacity	Model, tool, memory, data-access, autonomy
Domain Verifier	Доменные инварианты	Conformal calibration, claim-evidence provenance
Правило «Statistical Gödel Gate»: Lewis: «A candidate edit is promoted only after passing three gates».

Правило «0.008% harmful edits»: Lewis: «Spending-based e-Gödel gate reduced harmful edits to 0.008%».

3.5. Governed Evolution Lifecycle (9 шагов)
Шаг	Что происходит
1. Sandbox	Candidate edit в sandbox
2. Independent Verification	Independent verification
3. Reauthorization	Reauthorization при material change
4. Bounded Canary Deployment	Canary deployment
5. Observation	Observation
6. Promotion	Promotion
7. Hold	Hold при不确定ности
8. Rollback	Rollback при regression
9. Block	Block при violation
Правило «governed evolution lifecycle»: Execution Governance 3.0: «A Governed Evolution Lifecycle for sandboxing, independent verification, reauthorization, bounded canary deployment, observation, promotion, Hold, rollback, and Block».

3.6. Immutable Core + Mutable Periphery
Компонент	Что входит	Изменяемость
Immutable core	Права пользователя, безопасность L5, аудит, память, идентичность	Никогда (even by amendment)
Mutable periphery	Иерархия, протоколы, память, инструменты, метрики	Через governed evolution lifecycle
Правило «immutable core»: CLD: «Immutable root law. No memory, prompt, or amendment may override unless explicitly authorized».

Правило «CAS activation»: Zenodo: «Immutable/versioned contracts with CAS activation».

3.7. ADR (Architecture Decision Records)
Компонент	Что делает
ADR Retriever	Поиск существующих ADR
ADR Generator	Генерация новых ADR
AdrWriterAgent	Написание ADR
AdrCheckerAgent	Проверка ADR
Правило «ADR-tracked»: «Decisions affecting templates, agents, the constitution, or quality gates must be ADR-tracked».

3.8. TRACE (Trust, Route, Adopt, Calibrate, Evolve)
Стадия	Что происходит
Trust	Sponsor/stakeholder owns the workflow
Route	Route according to risk
Adopt	Adopt agentic workflow
Calibrate	Calibrate against outcomes
Evolve	Evolve capabilities
Правило «recovery loop»: TRACE: «Calibrate → Adopt».

Правило «expansion loop»: TRACE: «Evolve → Route».

3.9. Meta-Agent (Proposer)
Компонент	Что делает
Propose	Предлагает изменения
Analyze	Анализирует последствия
Simulate	Симулирует изменения
Report	Отчитывается Джарвису
Правило «Meta-Agent только предлагает»: Meta-Agent не исполняет изменения. Approver (Джарвис/пользователь) утверждает. Implementer (система) применяет.

3.10. Интеграция с PDP/PEP (Вопрос 5)
Meta-Agent предлагает изменение.

PDP проверяет: затрагивает immutable core? Statistical Gödel Gate? Approval?

Если permit — PEP применяет.

Immutable ledger фиксирует изменение (Вопрос 48).

A. Запрет на изменение (только пользователь).

Вопрос 75. Долгосрочная устойчивость и устаревание системы
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-05

Сверено с: вопросами 1–74, 3, 5, 6, 10, 17, 18, 21, 22, 26, 30, 34, 36, 41–50, 51, 58, 61–74

1. Принятое решение
Вариант C — полный цикл долгосрочной устойчивости: MARE Meta-Architecture + AI Dependency Register + Model Exit-Cost Audit + Foundry Six-Phase Migration + Memory Portability + Governed Capability Evolution + Gartner Six Steps + AI Gateway + A2A Version Header Compatibility + Complexity-Ranked Iterative Refactoring.

Ключевое отличие от исходной формулировки:

«Sunset planning» → MARE Meta-Architecture (Role stability + Executor replaceability + TAO semantics + Recursive decomposition).

«Abstraction layers» → AI Gateway + API Abstraction Layer (unified API across providers).

«Vendor diversification» → AI Dependency Register (4 слоя: model, data, implementation, operations с exit cost).

«Refactoring debt» → Complexity-Ranked Iterative Refactoring.

«Backward compatibility» → A2A Version Header Compatibility (semantic versioning + fallback translation).

«Model migration planning» → Microsoft Foundry Six-Phase Process + Memory Portability.

Добавлен Model Exit-Cost Audit (7 измерений).

Добавлен Governed Capability Evolution (4 compatibility checks + 7-stage pipeline).

Добавлен Gartner Six Steps для управления agent sprawl.

2. Обоснование
2.1. MARE Meta-Architecture: Anti-Obsolescence by Design (Zenodo, июль 2026)
MARE (Zenodo, 2026): «Technological obsolescence in AI systems is not only a component-level problem, but also an architectural one. MARE separates stable architectural responsibilities from the mechanisms that currently realize them. Systems are described through Roles, which define what must remain architecturally stable, and Executors, which enact those responsibilities through replaceable technological, organizational, or human mechanisms».

Ключевые принципы:

Принцип	Что означает
Role stability	Ответственности, значимые даже при смене технологий
Executor replaceability	Executors могут быть заменены без потери Role
TAO semantics	Transfer, Activation, Observation — сохраняют смысл координации
Recursive decomposition	Role может содержать sub-Roles
Правило «anti-obsolescence by design»: MARE: «Anti-obsolescence is thereby pursued not through continuous corrective maintenance, but by design».

2.2. AI Dependency Register: Four Layers (Oliver Wyman, сентябрь 2026)
Oliver Wyman (2026): «A production agentic system has four layers, and each creates a different kind of dependency».

Слой	Dependency type	Exit cost
Model	Provider lock-in	Переписать prompts, tools
Data	Data lock-in	Экспорт, миграция памяти
Implementation	Framework lock-in	Переписать harness, orchestration
Operations	Platform lock-in	Миграция deployment, monitoring
Правило «register»: Oliver Wyman: «The four layers, the supplier on each, the hosting placement, the estimated exit cost, and the date of the last alternative test».

Правило «only one in ten CIOs»: Oliver Wyman: «Only one in ten CIOs can produce, on demand, the owner, scope, cost, and last certification date of every production agent».

2.3. Model Exit-Cost Audit: 7 Dimensions (SWFTE, июнь 2026)
SWFTE (2026): «Real exit cost is the sum of seven distinct workstreams, each of which compounds with prompt count, tool surface area, and regulatory footprint».

#	Dimension	Score 1 (fungible)	Score 5 (trapped)
1	Prompt Portability	Generic	Provider-specific tags
2	Tool Schema	OpenAPI-style	Provider-proprietary DSL
3	Output Format Drift	Strict JSON-mode	Free-form prose
4	Latency Profile Match	Tolerant	p99 ms SLAs
5	Eval Suite Re-Run Cost	Automated harness	Manual review
6	Compliance Re-Certification	Already approved	High-risk EU AI Act
7	Behavioral Drift Cost	Deterministic	Long-context agentic
Правило «score 7-14 = fungible»: SWFTE: «A score of 7–14 is fungible — your team could swap models in a sprint. 15–24 is moderate. 25–35 is effectively trapped».

2.4. Microsoft Foundry: Six-Phase Model Migration (август 2026)
Microsoft Foundry (2026): «This article describes a six-phase process for migrating an LLM-powered workload from one base model to another».

Phase	Что происходит	Критерий
Discover	Understand change is coming	Retirement schedule + Models API
Assess	Choose target, prove feasible	Leaderboards + side-by-side
Adapt	Replay unchanged before tuning	Prompt Optimizer + simulator
Validate	Run against quality rubric	Evaluation + red teaming
Roll out	Deploy safely	Canary + traffic split
Retire	Remove old deployment	Cleanup
Правило «replay unchanged before you tune»: Microsoft: «Run your current prompts against the target model before any tuning — this reveals the raw impact».

Правило «90 days notice»: Microsoft: «The replacement model becomes available about 90 days before retirement».

2.5. Memory Portability: Controlled Study (Goyal & Ray, arXiv, сентябрь 2026)
Goyal & Ray (arXiv, 2026): «Model upgrades are routine; memory migrations are not. An agent can keep the same memory store and still forget: a new model may interpret old notes differently, mixed embedding versions may break retrieval, and repair may fail without the original evidence».

Ключевые результаты:

Migration Test	Result
Fully re-embed	+11.90 points accuracy
50/50 mixed index	+4.96 points (hemorrhages ~60% of gain)
Raw-history repair	+8.9 points vs store-only
KG-fixed records	91–96 of 96 recovered at near-zero cost
Правило «mixed index fails silently»: Goyal & Ray: «The old and new models both output 1024-dimensional vectors, the system continues running and fails silently without triggering any dimensional compatibility errors».

Правило «KG-fixed memories migrate almost losslessly»: Goyal & Ray: «KG-fixed memories migrate almost losslessly while NOTES and mixed RAG embeddings can lose up to 13.28pp and 7.0pp of accuracy».

2.6. Governed Capability Evolution: 4 Compatibility Checks (Qin et al., ScienceDirect, сентябрь 2026)
Qin et al. (ScienceDirect, 2026): «We propose a staged upgrade framework with four compatibility checks (interface, policy, behavioral, recovery) and a seven-stage pipeline (validation, sandbox, shadow, gated activation, monitoring, rollback, audit)».

Результаты:

Method	Final-round success	Unsafe activations
Naive upgrade	73.3%	74.7%
Canary	—	61.3%
Blue-green	—	64.0%
Governed upgrade	—	No in-taxonomy fault
Правило «aggregate success hides policy and recovery regressions»: Qin et al.: «Canary and blue-green adaptations keep comparable success yet still admit faulty versions in 61.3% and 64.0% of upgrade rounds, because aggregate success hides policy and recovery regressions».

2.7. Gartner: Six Steps to Manage AI Agent Sprawl (апрель 2026)
Gartner (2026): «By 2028, an Average Global Fortune 500 Enterprise Will Have Over 150,000 Agents in Use. Only 13% of Organizations Think They Have the Right AI Agent Governance in Place».

Шесть шагов:

#	Шаг	Что делает
1	Establish agent governance and policies	Clear rules for when/how agents are built
2	Build centralized agent inventory	Discover and categorize agents
3	Define agent identity, permissions, lifecycle	Review, retire redundant agents
4	Develop AI information governance	Govern what information agents access
5	Monitor and remediate agent behavior	Detect anomalies, enforce compliance
6	Foster culture of responsible AI usage	Training, internal communities
Правило «agent sprawl»: Gartner: «If employees are unable to work in the sanctioned tools, they will likely go around the organization's controls and start using shadow AI which presents far greater risks».

2.8. AI Gateway / API Abstraction Layer (Commons-OS, февраль 2026)
Commons-OS (2026): «The API Abstraction Layer pattern involves creating a unified and consistent interface that sits between applications and a variety of underlying, often disparate, vendor APIs».

Правило «60-80% cost reduction»: Coding Agency: «Een abstractielaag (AI-gateway) tussen je applicatie en het model reduceert migratiekosten met 60 tot 80%».

Правило «interface independence»: Commons-OS: «The application code interacts with a stable, internally-defined contract, not the volatile and diverse contracts of external vendors».

2.9. A2A Version Header Compatibility (JumpCloud, март 2026)
JumpCloud (2026): «A2A Version Header Compatibility is an orchestration protocol that manages backward compatibility between autonomous agents operating on different iterations of the Agent-to-Agent specification».

Правило «semantic versioning parser»: JumpCloud: «This parser evaluates the major, minor, and patch numbers to determine the exact level of compatibility between the two agents».

Правило «fallback translation layer»: JumpCloud: «This component automatically downgrades complex payloads to a simpler JSON format if the receiving agent operates on a legacy build».

2.10. Complexity-Ranked Iterative Refactoring (ACM, 2026)
ACM (2026): «We propose a complexity-ranked iterative refactoring approach that prioritizes refactoring efforts based on measurable complexity metrics, ensuring that the most critical technical debt is addressed first».

3. Пункты реализации
3.1. MARE Meta-Architecture (Role / Executor / TAO)
Компонент	Что делает
Role	Stable architectural responsibility (что должно оставаться стабильным)
Executor	Replaceable mechanism (технология, организация, человек)
TAO	Transfer, Activation, Observation (semantics of coordination)
Recursive decomposition	Role может содержать sub-Roles
Правило «Role stability»: MARE: «The system is described in terms of responsibilities that remain meaningful even when the current technologies used to enact them change».

Правило «Executor replaceability»: MARE: «Executors are responsible for realization rather than identity, they can be replaced or upgraded while preserving the Role they enact».

3.2. AI Dependency Register (4 слоя)
Слой	Что содержит	Exit cost
Model	Модели, провайдеры	Provider lock-in
Data	Данные, память, контекст	Data lock-in
Implementation	Harness, orchestration, tools	Framework lock-in
Operations	Deployment, monitoring, governance	Platform lock-in
Правило «register»: Oliver Wyman: «The four layers, the supplier on each, the hosting placement, the estimated exit cost, and the date of the last alternative test».

3.3. Model Exit-Cost Audit (7 измерений)

1	Prompt Portability	Generic	Provider-specific
2	Tool Schema	OpenAPI-style	Proprietary DSL
3	Output Format	Strict JSON	Free-form
4	Latency Profile	Tolerant	p99 ms SLAs
5	Eval Suite	Automated	Manual
6	Compliance	Already approved	High-risk EU AI Act
7	Behavioral Drift	Deterministic	Long-context agentic
Правило «score 7-14 = fungible»: SWFTE: «Your team could swap models in a sprint».

3.4. Microsoft Foundry Six-Phase Model Migration
Phase	Что происходит	Критерий
Discover	Understand change is coming	Retirement schedule
Assess	Choose target, prove feasible	Leaderboards
Adapt	Replay unchanged before tuning	Prompt Optimizer
Validate	Run against quality rubric	Evaluation
Roll out	Deploy safely	Canary
Retire	Remove old deployment	Cleanup

Правило «KG-fixed memories migrate almost losslessly»: Goyal & Ray: «KG-fixed memories migrate almost losslessly».

Policy	Policy coverage over new model's reachable behavior
Behavioral	Drift function from execution traces
Recovery	Rollback, fallback, safe-abort, failure-mode recognizability

1. Validation	Pre-activation compatibility validation
2. Sandbox	Sandbox evaluation
3. Shadow	Shadow deployment
4. Gated activation	Gated activation
5. Monitoring	Online monitoring
6. Rollback	Rollback trigger
7. Audit	Upgrade audit logging
Правило «governed pipeline admits no in-taxonomy fault»: Qin et al.: «Governed upgrade admits no in-taxonomy fault and one out-of-taxonomy probe in 75 behavioral-track rounds».

3	Define identity, permissions, lifecycle	Review, retire
4	Develop information governance	Govern access

6	Foster responsible AI culture	Training, communities

Вопрос 76. Этика и alignment (Этическая согласованность и управление ценностями)
Статус: решено

Дата проработки: 2026-10-05

Сверено с: вопросами 1–75, 3, 5, 6, 10, 12, 17, 18, 19, 22, 36, 48, 61, 62, 66, 67, 68, 69, 70, 71, 72, 73, 74, 75

1. Принятое решение
Вариант C — полный цикл этики и alignment: CAP (3-tier) + DPA + VAS-CFA + Value Drift Monitor + CRAYON + Constitutional Alignment Benchmark + AIGA + Ethical Red Teaming + Stakeholder Engagement.

Ключевое отличие от исходной формулировки:

«Только технические guardrails» → CAP (3-tier: Tier 0 absolute, Tier 1 jurisdiction-specific, Tier 2 voluntary).

«Ethics guidelines + periodic review» → DPA (multi-objective reward scheme).

«Только один evaluator» → VAS-CFA (multi-agent fusion alignment).

«Статические guidelines» → Value Drift Monitor (continuous).

«Stakeholder input» → CRAYON (elicitation of pluralistic normative requirements).

«Quality gates» → Constitutional Alignment Benchmark.

«Security red teaming» → Ethical Red Teaming.

Добавлен AIGA (economic incentive alignment).

Добавлен Double-evaluation property (agent + human).

Разграничение с другими вопросами:

Механизм	Где	Что делает	Как связано с Вопросом 76
Meta-эволюция	Вопрос 74	Immutable core + mutable periphery	CAP Tier 0 = immutable core

Self-evolution	Вопрос 66	PURER loop	Value Drift Monitor контролирует

Explainability	Вопрос 70	Local + Global + Counterfactual	Transparency — часть explainability
Incident management	Вопрос 68	Postmortem	Ethical red teaming — часть проверки
Agent testing	Вопрос 64	Shadow mode + canary	Constitutional Alignment Benchmark
Deploy pipeline	Вопрос 67	Immutable deployments	CAP Tier 0 нельзя изменить
2. Обоснование
2.1. Constitutional AI Protocol (CAP) для Agentic AI (IETF, май 2026)
Sato (IETF, 2026): «This document specifies the Constitutional AI Protocol (CAP), a kernel-enforced prohibition architecture for agentic AI systems. CAP defines a three-tier prohibition model: Tier 0 absolute prohibitions derived from near-universal treaty consensus, Tier 1 jurisdiction-specific prohibitions declared by operators and verified by auditors, and Tier 2 voluntary operator ethical standards. CAP evaluates every action request twice — once on the AI agent's action before Cedar policy evaluation, and once on the human principal's decision before kernel execution — ensuring that neither agents nor human principals can authorize absolutely prohibited actions».

2.2. Dynamic Pluralistic Alignment (DPA) (IEEE, май 2026)
IEEE (2026): «We suggest the Dynamic Pluralistic Alignment (DPA) framework, which is a one-step approach that combines a multi-objective reward scheme with uncertainty-sensitive penalty and formal assessment. The DPA framework achieves the desired outcome by subjecting model data to weighted functional utility as well as ethical utility so that the actions of the agent in each task fall within a validated Safe Set without impacting the efficiency of the task. According to experimental outputs, the DPA methodology has a 94.2% harmlessness score, and it minimizes the safety violations to a minimum of the interactions and only the 1».

2.3. Value Alignment System using Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (VAS-CFA) (IEEE, апрель 2026)
IEEE (2026): «We propose the Value Alignment System using Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (VAS-CFA), a framework that operationalizes multi-agent fusion alignment. It instantiates multiple moral agents, each fine-tuned to represent a distinct normative perspective, and fuses their outputs using CFA with both rank- and score-based aggregation».

2.4. Value Drift Monitor (mscp, февраль 2026)
mscp (2026): «Runs every 50 cycles. For each dimension: drift = abs(weight - baseline_weight); velocity = (weight - weight_100_ago) / 100; total_drift = sum(dim.drift for dim in value_vector.dimensions); max_drift = max(dim.drift for dim in value_vector.dimensions)». Drift classification: nominal (<0.10), moderate (<0.25), elevated (<0.40), critical (≥0.40).

2.5. CRAYON: Elicitation of Pluralistic Normative Requirements (IEEE, август 2026)
CRAYON (IEEE, 2026): «We introduce CRAYON, a tool-supported, human-in-the-loop methodology designed to support multidisciplinary stakeholders in eliciting normative requirements from high-level principles. The CRAYON tool-supported workflow improves capability-grounded coverage and supports systematic refinement while preserving expert judgment and stakeholder creativity, nearly doubling the number of elicited rules (49 vs. 25) and achieving 86% stakeholder acceptance of generated candidates».

2.6. Constitutional Alignment Benchmark for Decision-Support Agents (Zenodo, сентябрь 2026)
Zenodo (2026): «We introduce a constitutional alignment benchmark that evaluates the stance a response takes toward that person: whether it engages the actual trade-off, preserves agency, and produces usable direction rather than polished evasion». (WYF = 0.966)

2.7. AI Governance and Accountability Protocol (AIGA) (IETF, январь 2026)
Aylward (IETF, 2026): «AIGA is designed to address real-world deployment constraints, adversarial agent scenarios, and economic incentive alignment. The entire framework is designed around Economic Incentive Alignment, making compliance the most economically rational choice for operators».

2.8. Ethical Red Teaming (IEEE, август 2026)
IEEE (2026): «This paper presents a multi-agent collaborative decision-making framework for autonomous penetration testing. A Planner performs global goal decomposition and strategy orchestration, while reconnaissance and exploitation agents receive high-level objectives and independently conduct local analysis».

2.9. Stakeholder Engagement (ECNL, декабрь 2025)
ECNL (2025): «A framework for AI systems that truly serve the communities they affect: ECNL's Framework for Meaningful Engagement (FME 2.0)».
