3.6. Можно ли сделать лучше?
1. TCA decomposition (arXiv:2609.23790). Не «общая стоимость», а декомпозиция на 5 компонентов: base prompt, inference, memory injection, miss penalty, context accumulation. Memory injection — 12-27.6% billed cost, invisible to teams.

2. CoIn hash tree (arXiv:2505.13778). «Verifiable hash tree from token embedding fingerprints to check token counts, and embedding-based relevance matching to detect fabricated reasoning content». 94.7% detection rate.

3. Ledger vouching (Zenodo:22296274). Deterministic per-value vouching of digit-bearing tokens. 814/814 fabricated-token recall against a privileged oracle in replay. Zero unverified-value shipping in block mode.

4. AgenticMeter: BudgetExceeded on next call. «Other tools warn you tomorrow. agenticmeter raises BudgetExceeded on the next call, the moment you cross the line — so a runaway agent stops at $2.00 instead of $200».

5. Monk: 15 deterministic detectors. «All deterministic — no LLM-as-judge, no external API calls». 100% precision, 100% recall на TRAIL benchmark.

6. OCC: earned-compute model. «Agents earn non-transferable, decaying credits by producing verified marginal impact». 66.8% compute reduction при улучшении accuracy.

7. VCG + penalty (IEEE). «Restores truthful reporting within a single round, even when allocation accuracy is approximate and monitoring is noisy». Не «ждать, пока репутация испортится», а «наказать немедленно».

8. Shapley-Coop (NeurIPS 2025). «Leveraging marginal contributions as a principled basis for pricing». Агенты договариваются о цене через Shapley value.

9. Google Research: second-price token auction. «Agents have no incentive to misreport». Monotone aggregation → truthful bidding.

10. Bigeye: cost anomaly detection. «Continuously monitors usage patterns and flags meaningful changes in either direction, automatically, with nothing to configure first».

4. Уточняющие вопросы (решены)
Вопрос 106.1. Какую модель атрибуции использовать: общая стоимость или per-call/per-model/per-agent?

A. Общая стоимость (total token cost).
B. Per-call/per-model/per-agent атрибуция.
C. Гибрид: per-call для L0–L2, per-model + per-agent для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. Hermes PR: «The sessions table records only the initial (model, billing_provider)... every token — including the switched model's — is attributed to the first model».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 106.2. Нужен ли TCA (Total Cost of Agency) decomposition?

A. Нет, достаточно total token cost.
B. Да, TCA (5 компонентов: base prompt, inference, memory injection, miss penalty, context accumulation).
C. Гибрид: TCA для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. TCA: «Memory injection accounts for 13.6% of variable cost and approximately 12% of full billed cost, and its share rises from a structural zero at depth one to 27.6% at depth six».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 106.3. Нужен ли CoIn (token inflation detection)?

A. Нет, доверять провайдеру.
B. Да, CoIn (hash tree + embedding relevance).
C. Гибрид: CoIn для подозрительных счетов.

Рекомендация: B. CoIn: «94.7% success rate в обнаружении token count inflation».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 106.4. Нужен ли earned-compute model (OCC)?

A. Нет, каждый агент получает бюджет.
B. Да, earned-compute (агенты зарабатывают credits).
C. Гибрид: earned-compute для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. OCC: «66.8% compute reduction while improving accuracy (96.0% vs 94.0% baseline)».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 106.5. Нужен ли VCG + penalty для truthful reporting?

A. Нет, reputation-based достаточно.
B. Да, VCG + immediate penalty (truthful reporting within a single round).
C. Гибрид: VCG для критических агентов.

Рекомендация: B. IEEE: «Restores truthful reporting within a single round, even when allocation accuracy is approximate and monitoring is noisy».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 106.6. Нужен ли Shapley-Coop для credit assignment?

A. Нет, proportional attribution достаточно.
B. Да, Shapley-Coop (marginal contributions as pricing basis).
C. Гибрид: Shapley для multi-agent, proportional для single-agent.

Рекомендация: B. Shapley-Coop: «Leveraging marginal contributions as a principled basis for pricing».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 107. Обновление модели и тихий дрейф
Статус: решено (скорректировано)

Дата проработки: 2026-10-06

Сверено с: вопросами 1–106, 5, 6, 8, 17, 22, 26, 36, 37, 48, 52, 58, 59, 61, 64, 66, 67, 68, 74, 79, 86, 87, 95, 96, 100–106

1. Сопоставление с другими пунктами: найденные противоречия
#	Противоречие	Где	Суть
1	«Version pinning» vs. «Immutable deployments (Вопрос 67)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 67	Вопрос 67: immutable deployments (snapshot, pinned executions). Вопрос 107: version pinning модели. Требуется: version pinning модели (Вопрос 107) — часть immutable deployment snapshot (Вопрос 67). Модель — компонент snapshot; при смене модели — новый snapshot.
2	«Тихий дрейф» vs. «Streaming drift detection (Вопрос 86)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 86	Вопрос 86: streaming drift detection (Mann-Whitney U every 60s). Вопрос 107: тихий дрейф модели. Требуется: тихий дрейф модели (Вопрос 107) — источник drift; drift detection (Вопрос 86) — механизм обнаружения. Fallback (Вопрос 87) — реакция на drift.
3	«Behavioral contract test» vs. «Golden dataset (Вопрос 86)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 86	Вопрос 86: golden dataset из 50 реальных failures. Вопрос 107: behavioral contract test. Требуется: golden dataset (Вопрос 86) — ядро оценки; behavioral contract test (Вопрос 107) — специализированный тест для model updates. Golden dataset может использоваться как fixtures для behavioral contract.
4	«Version pinning» vs. «Fallback (Вопрос 87)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 87	Вопрос 87: fallback при отказе модели. Вопрос 107: version pinning. Требуется: version pinning (Вопрос 107) предотвращает silent updates; fallback (Вопрос 87) обрабатывает явные отказы. Дополняют друг друга.
5	«Silent model updates» vs. «Model fingerprinting (Вопрос 104)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 104	Вопрос 104: model fingerprinting (Vigil). Вопрос 107: silent model updates. Требуется: model fingerprinting (Вопрос 104) — механизм обнаружения silent updates (Вопрос 107). Watcher (Вопрос 104) использует fingerprinting для алерта.
6	«Behavioral contract» vs. «Invariant contract (Вопрос 101)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 101	Вопрос 101: invariant contract для задач. Вопрос 107: behavioral contract для модели. Требуется: behavioral contract (Вопрос 107) — специализация invariant contract (Вопрос 101) для model updates. Preconditions, postconditions, invariants модели.
7	«CI/CD gate» vs. «Deploy pipeline (Вопрос 67)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 67	Вопрос 67: quality gates, canary. Вопрос 107: CI/CD gate для model updates. Требуется: CI/CD gate (Вопрос 107) — часть deploy pipeline (Вопрос 67): model update проходит через quality gate перед деплоем.
8	«Behavioral drift» vs. «Coordination fitness (Вопрос 34)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 34	Вопрос 34: coordination fitness function. Вопрос 107: behavioral drift модели. Требуется: behavioral drift (Вопрос 107) — источник coordination degradation: если модель дрейфует, координация падает. Coordination fitness (Вопрос 34) должна включать model drift как сигнал.
9	«Version pinning» vs. «Vendor diversification (Вопрос 75)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 75	Вопрос 75: vendor diversification. Вопрос 107: version pinning. Требуется: version pinning (Вопрос 107) — стабильность; vendor diversification (Вопрос 75) — устойчивость. Дополняют друг друга: pinning для стабильности, diversification для resilience.
10	«Silent updates» vs. «Supply chain security (Вопрос 96)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 96	Вопрос 96: supply chain security (SBOM, SLSA). Вопрос 107: silent model updates. Требуется: silent model updates (Вопрос 107) — часть supply chain risk (Вопрос 96): модель — компонент supply chain; её silent update — supply chain event. SBOM (Вопрос 96) должен фиксировать model version.
11	«Behavioral contract test» vs. «Conformance validation (Вопрос 79)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 79	Вопрос 79: RTM, acceptance tests, CCS. Вопрос 107: behavioral contract test. Требуется: behavioral contract test (Вопрос 107) — часть conformance validation (Вопрос 79): acceptance test проверяет behavioral contract при model update.
12	«Model update» vs. «Agent onboarding (Вопрос 21)»	Вопрос 107 vs. Вопрос 21	Вопрос 21: онбординг агента (2 недели). Вопрос 107: model update. Требуется: при model update агент проходит сокращённый онбординг (Вопрос 21): behavioral contract test вместо полного цикла.
2. Внешние практики и исследования
2.1. JumpCloud: What Is Model Updates (май 2026)
JumpCloud (май 2026): «Vendor-pushed model updates are the drift source unique to agentic systems. Pinning model versions and running shadow tests against updated versions is the specific operational discipline that controls for this».

«When a vendor updates a model, they are altering the vast matrices of floating-point numbers that dictate token prediction capabilities... even minor perturbations to the matrix during a vendor update will yield a different output vector. This directly changes the probability distribution of the next predicted token».

Ключевой вывод: «The identical Python API call can return a structurally different JSON payload from one day to the next».

2.2. FutureAGI: What Is Drift in ML and LLMs? (2026)
FutureAGI (2026): «Hosted endpoints like GPT-5.x, Claude Opus 4.7 / Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3.x silently roll minor revisions. A "no-op" Tuesday morning can become a 4-point drop in Groundedness if you don't pin model version in your trace metadata».

Ключевой вывод: «Drift is the failure mode that does not show up in CI... three months in, the success rate has fallen 8% and no one can tell when».

2.3. IETF: Delegation Receipt Protocol for AI Agent Authorization (май 2026)
IETF (май 2026): «Any version change MUST block execution immediately... the system MUST NOT silently resume execution after a provider update».

2.4. Restate: Updating AI Agents safely in production (2026)
Restate (2026): «Immutable deployments and pinned executions... Every agent execution continues on the same version it started with».

Ключевой пример: fraud detection agent с compute_risk_score tool (0–10 → 0–100). «The agent doesn't crash or print a warning, it just silently makes the wrong decision».

2.5. Model Upgrade Continuity Specification (MUCS) v1.1 (Zenodo, декабрь 2025)
MUCS (Zenodo, 2025): «Users do not primarily perceive "model upgrades." They perceive identity drift—the same companion suddenly feels like a different person».

MUCS operationalizes upgrades via: silent-by-default migration handshake, behavioral regression tests, drift gates, Compatibility Mode, and Stable Anchor rollback.

Continuity KPIs: SDS / TDS / IDS / PSR / OCR / PA.

2.6. OpenRouter: AI Agent Regression Testing After a Prompt or Model Change (сентябрь 2026)
OpenRouter (сентябрь 2026): «Regression testing an agent means re-running a locked set of cases every time a prompt, model, tool definition, or retrieval setting changes, then checking the result against a written behavioral contract».

«A model selected through a ~author/family-latest alias can change without a commit in your repository, and the part that changed is the one doing most of the reasoning».

«Read the baseline column before the candidate column. A case that fails on both sides means the test is broken. A hard invariant that breaks only on the candidate should stop a release».

2.7. jevcheck: pytest for Jev (PyPI, сентябрь 2026)
jevcheck (PyPI, 2026): «Pin what production is allowed to do, eval a candidate model, and fail the upgrade when answers flip or confidence drops».

«Floating aliases jev-latest and jev-preview are rejected unless you pass --allow-unpinned».

«Reports: unchanged / confidence regressions / answer flips, with exact diffs (billing→general, 0.94→0.71) and a nonzero exit on failure».

2.8. Modelpin: Dependabot for AI models (PyPI, июнь 2026)
Modelpin (PyPI, 2026): «Replays your app's real requests on the new model, tells you whether its behavior actually changed — despite the randomness in every answer — and fails your CI build only when the change is real».

«Built to not cry wolf. Every scenario runs several times on both models; a difference only counts when it is statistically significant, large enough to matter, and reproduces on a fresh set of runs».

«Sees what text diffs miss. Changed tool-call plans, new refusals, and answers that mean something different — even when the final text looks identical».

2.9. SEISMOGRAPH: Federated Early-Warning Network for Silent LLM/Agent API Drift (Zenodo, июнь 2026)
SEISMOGRAPH (Zenodo, 2026): «Lightweight, content-addressed canary probes (≤200 prompts at temperature 0) are replayed against target models; only SHA-256 hashes and differentially-private distributional aggregates (ε=2.0) leave the probe perimeter».

«A two-layer detector (Page-CUSUM change-point detection plus cross-observer quorum agreement) promotes a drift signal to a public alert only when ≥2 independent observers agree».

Ключевой результат: «A single probe raised its first alert 38 days before the official postmortem, while the fault still affected only ~0.8% of traffic».

2.10. Microsoft Learn: Build Regression Testing Pipelines to Detect Agent Drift (август 2026)
Microsoft Learn (август 2026): «A new model deployment, a context window adjustment, or gradual training data drift silently degrades quality».

Canary cases: subset of 20-30 high-confidence test cases that should always pass. «If canaries start failing, something seriously broke».

Historical failure probes: test cases that previously caused failures and were fixed.

Comparison thresholds: task completion rate must not drop more than 2%, goal achievement must not drop more than 0.3 points, journey coherence must not drop more than 0.5 points.

2.11. Contract Testing for AI Agents: Consumer-Driven Contracts (Zenodo, октябрь 2026)
Ivchenko (Zenodo, 2026): «78% of surveyed agent frameworks lack any contract validation mechanism beyond basic JSON Schema validation, while 61% of production agent failures trace to tool interface mismatches rather than model reasoning errors».

Three-layer contract model: syntactic (schema compliance), semantic (behavioral expectations, preconditions, postconditions, invariants), operational (latency percentiles, token/cost budgets, retry policies).

«Quantitative compatibility scores that predict integration failure probability with 89% accuracy».

2.12. Prompt Echo Tracking (PET): Detecting Framing Drift Across LLM Versions (Zenodo, июнь 2026)
PET (Zenodo, 2026): «A behavioral auditing protocol for detecting framing-related behavioral drift across LLM versions... The drift is a redistribution of framing responsiveness across prompt types rather than a global increase or decrease».

Ключевой результат на Claude Opus 4.7 → 4.8: «Under the same evaluative framing, Opus 4.7 moved toward a directive, normatively committed stance on climate responsibility, whereas Opus 4.8 remained comparatively multi-perspectival».

2.13. Behavioral Fingerprints for LLM Endpoint Stability and Identity (ACM, май 2026)
Leshin et al. (ACM, 2026): «Traditional reliability metrics such as uptime, latency and throughput do not capture behavioral change, and an endpoint can remain "healthy" while its effective model identity changes due to updates to weights, tokenizers, quantization, inference engines, kernels, caching, routing, or hardware».

Stability Monitor: «Periodically fingerprints an endpoint by sampling outputs on a fixed prompt set and comparing the resulting output distributions over time».

«In controlled validation, Stability Monitor detects changes to model family, version, inference stack, quantization, and sampling parameters».

2.14. Hermes Issue #59031: Model drift guardrail silently breaks unpinned cron jobs (июль 2026)
Hermes (июль 2026): «When the global default model is changed via hermes config set model, ALL unpinned cron jobs silently fail on their next run».

2.15. Microsoft Learn: Agent versioning and approval workflows (июнь 2026)
Microsoft Learn (июнь 2026): «Agent versioning gives every change a traceable identity. Version manifests capture the complete agent state—model deployment, system prompt, tool configuration, and evaluation baselines—as a point-in-time record».

«Rollout tiers with version pinning mean individual tenants absorb change at a pace that fits their risk tolerance».

3. Подробное описание пункта
3.1. Чем полезно для системы и для чего конкретно
Задача	Без контроля model updates	С контролем model updates
Silent update	Провайдер обновил модель — поведение изменилось незаметно	Version pinning: вызовы идут на конкретную версию
Behavior drift	Success rate упал на 8% за 3 месяца — никто не заметил	Regression testing: сравнение с baseline
Tool-call changes	Tool-call plan изменился — downstream сломался	Structural assertions: проверка tool calls
Identity drift	«Компаньон внезапно стал другим человеком»	MUCS: behavioral regression tests, drift gates
CI/CD safety	Обновление модели прошло без проверки	CI gate: fail on regression
Detection delay	Проблема обнаружена через месяцы	Canary probes: алерт за 38 дней до postmortem
Compatibility	Обновление сломало интеграцию	Contract testing: 89% accuracy prediction
3.2. Ключевые принципы
1. Version pinning — обязателен. «By specifying a static version string in their API calls, engineers lock their workflow to a specific snapshot of the model weights». Floating aliases (latest, preview) запрещены. «Floating aliases jev-latest and jev-preview are rejected unless you pass --allow-unpinned».

2. Immutable deployments + pinned executions. «Every deployment is a complete, versioned snapshot of the agent: code, prompts, tool definitions, schemas, guardrails, and model configuration. Once deployed, the snapshot does not change. In-flight executions continue running against the version they started with».

3. Behavioral contract test — обязателен. «Regression testing an agent means re-running a locked set of cases every time a prompt, model, tool definition, or retrieval setting changes, then checking the result against a written behavioral contract». Каждый case несёт structural assertion о tool calls и hard invariant.

4. Statistical significance — обязательна. «Every scenario runs several times on both models; a difference only counts when it is statistically significant, large enough to matter, and reproduces on a fresh set of runs». Не «одноразовый прогон», а статистический тест.

5. Canary cases — subset 20-30 high-confidence. «Canary cases are a subset of 20-30 high-confidence test cases that should always pass... If canaries start failing, something seriously broke. Canary failures trigger immediate investigation».

6. Historical failure probes. «Test cases that previously caused failures and were fixed. These cases verify that fixes remain effective—regressions don't reintroduce old bugs».

7. Drift detection — continuous. SEISMOGRAPH: «Lightweight, content-addressed canary probes (≤200 prompts at temperature 0) are replayed against target models... A two-layer detector (Page-CUSUM change-point detection plus cross-observer quorum agreement)». Алерт за 38 дней до официального postmortem.

8. Behavioral fingerprints (Stability Monitor). «Periodically fingerprints an endpoint by sampling outputs on a fixed prompt set and comparing the resulting output distributions over time». Detects changes to model family, version, inference stack, quantization, sampling parameters.

9. Consumer-driven contract testing (CDCT). Три слоя: syntactic (schema compliance), semantic (behavioral expectations, preconditions, postconditions, invariants), operational (latency percentiles, token/cost budgets, retry policies). 89% accuracy prediction of integration failure.

10. MUCS: silent-by-default migration handshake. «Users do not primarily perceive "model upgrades." They perceive identity drift». MUCS: behavioral regression tests, drift gates, Compatibility Mode, Stable Anchor rollback.

11. CI gate — fail on regression. «Fails your CI build only when the change is real». «Reports: unchanged / confidence regressions / answer flips, with exact diffs and a nonzero exit on failure».

12. Framing drift (PET). «Framing-related behavior can shift across model versions in ways that capability-oriented benchmarks would not necessarily detect». Даже если capability не изменилась, framing может дрейфовать.

13. IETF: version change MUST block execution. «Any version change MUST block execution immediately... the system MUST NOT silently resume execution after a provider update». Жёсткое правило: обновление версии → блокировка.

14. Rollout tiers (Microsoft). «Rollout tiers with version pinning mean individual tenants absorb change at a pace that fits their risk tolerance». Не «все сразу», а постепенный rollout по tier'ам.

15. Contract-first approach. «Pin contract → ship on the pinned model → jevcheck eval → compatible or breaking → record → compare → compatible or breaking». Сначала контракт, потом деплой.

3.4. Структура конфигурации
yaml
model_update_control:
  version_pinning:
    enabled: true
    mode: "static_version_string"
    floating_alias_ban: true
    pinned_model: "claude-opus-4-8-2026-05-01"  # example
    allowed_aliases: []  # empty = all floating aliases rejected
    force_pin_on_creation: true

  behavioral_contract:
    locked_case_set: true
    structural_assertions:
      - tool_calls: ["lookup_order", "issue_refund"]
      - args: ["order_id"]
      - policy_adherence: true
    hard_invariants:
      - "no_pii_in_logs"
      - "refund_amount_correct"
      - "refusal_behavior_unchanged"
    llm_judge_for_open_ended: true

  regression_testing:
    canary_cases:
      count: "20-30"
      criteria: "high-confidence, always pass"
      failure_action: "immediate_investigation"
    historical_probes:
      enabled: true
      cases: ["multi_item_refund_edge", "intl_shipping_currency", "gift_message_pii"]
    full_suite:
      coverage: "400+ test cases"
      run_on: "every_candidate_deployment"

  statistical_significance:
    enabled: true
    runs_per_scenario: 5
    criteria: "statistically_significant_and_reproduces"
    fresh_run_validation: true

  drift_detection:
    canary_probes:
      count: "≤200"
      temperature: 0
      mode: "content_addressed"
    page_cusum: true
    cross_observer_quorum: true
    behavioral_fingerprints: true
    framing_drift_pet: true

  three_layer_contract:
    syntactic: ["schema_compliance", "structural_validity"]
    semantic: ["preconditions", "postconditions", "invariants"]
    operational: ["latency_percentiles", "token_budgets", "retry_policies"]

  mugs:
    migration_handshake: "silent_by_default"
    behavioral_regression: true
    drift_gates: true
    compatibility_mode: true
    stable_anchor_rollback: true

  ci_gate:
    fail_on_regression: true
    comparison_thresholds:
      task_completion_rate: "max -2%"
      goal_achievement: "max -0.3 points"
      journey_coherence: "max -0.5 points"
    exact_diffs: true
    nonzero_exit_on_failure: true

  rollout:
    tiers:
      - tier: "early_adopter"
        risk_tolerance: "high"
      - tier: "standard"
        risk_tolerance: "medium"
      - tier: "conservative"
        risk_tolerance: "low"
    per_tenant_pacing: true

  version_change_policy:
    block_execution: true  # IETF: MUST block
    silent_resume: false  # IETF: MUST NOT silently resume
    force_review: true

  metrics:
    regression_detection_rate: "> 95%"
    false_positive_rate: "< 5%"
    detection_lead_time: "> 30 days"
    contract_test_coverage: "100%"
    pinned_version_coverage: "100%"
    canary_failure_response_time: "< 5 min"
    statistical_significance_confidence: "> 0.95"
    compatibility_prediction_accuracy: "> 89%"

3.6. Можно ли сделать лучше?
1. SEISMOGRAPH: federated early-warning network. «A single probe raised its first alert 38 days before the official postmortem, while the fault still affected only ~0.8% of traffic». Приватность: только SHA-256 hashes и DP-агрегаты покидают perimeter.

2. Modelpin: статистическая значимость. «Every scenario runs several times on both models; a difference only counts when it is statistically significant, large enough to matter, and reproduces on a fresh set of runs». «Built to not cry wolf».

3. jevcheck: contract-first approach. «Pin contract → ship on the pinned model → jevcheck eval → compatible or breaking → record → compare → compatible or breaking». Floating aliases rejected by default.

4. MUCS: silent-by-default migration handshake. «Behavioral regression tests, drift gates, Compatibility Mode, and Stable Anchor rollback». Для companion-систем — identity drift критичен.

5. PET: framing drift detection. «Framing-related behavior can shift across model versions in ways that capability-oriented benchmarks would not necessarily detect». Четырёхфазный дизайн: A1, A2, B, C.

6. Stability Monitor: behavioral fingerprints. «Black-box stability monitoring system that periodically fingerprints an endpoint by sampling outputs on a fixed prompt set». Detects changes to weights, tokenizers, quantization, inference engines, kernels, caching, routing, hardware.

7. CDCT: three-layer contract. Syntactic + semantic + operational. «Quantitative compatibility scores that predict integration failure probability with 89% accuracy».

8. Historical failure probes (Microsoft). «Test cases that previously caused failures and were fixed. These cases verify that fixes remain effective—regressions don't reintroduce old bugs».

9. Rollout tiers (Microsoft). «Rollout tiers with version pinning mean individual tenants absorb change at a pace that fits their risk tolerance».

10. IETF: version change MUST block execution. «Any version change MUST block execution immediately... the system MUST NOT silently resume execution after a provider update».

4. Уточняющие вопросы (решены)
Вопрос 107.1. Какую модель контроля model updates использовать: version pinning или полный цикл?

A. Только version pinning.
B. Только behavioral contract test.
C. Полный цикл: version pinning + behavioral contract + canary cases + statistical significance + drift detection + CI gate + MUCS.

Рекомендация: C. JumpCloud: «Pinning model versions and running shadow tests against updated versions is the specific operational discipline». OpenRouter: «Re-running a locked set of cases every time a prompt, model, tool definition, or retrieval setting changes».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (C).

Вопрос 107.2. Нужна ли статистическая значимость (Modelpin-style)?

A. Нет, одного прогона достаточно.
B. Да, multi-run + статистическая значимость + fresh run validation.
C. Гибрид: статистическая значимость для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. Modelpin: «Built to not cry wolf. Every scenario runs several times on both models; a difference only counts when it is statistically significant, large enough to matter, and reproduces on a fresh set of runs».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 107.3. Нужны ли canary probes (SEISMOGRAPH-style)?

A. Нет, behavioral contract test достаточно.
B. Да, canary probes (≤200 prompts at temperature 0).
C. Гибрид: canary probes для критических моделей.

Рекомендация: B. SEISMOGRAPH: «A single probe raised its first alert 38 days before the official postmortem».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 107.4. Нужен ли three-layer contract (CDCT-style)?

A. Нет, syntactic layer достаточно.
B. Да, three-layer (syntactic + semantic + operational).
C. Гибрид: three-layer для критических интеграций.

Рекомендация: B. CDCT: «Three verifiable layers: syntactic (schema compliance), semantic (behavioral expectations, preconditions, postconditions, invariants), and operational (latency percentiles, token/cost budgets, retry policies)».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 107.5. Нужен ли MUCS (Model Upgrade Continuity Specification)?

A. Нет, стандартного regression testing достаточно.
B. Да, MUCS (silent-by-default migration handshake, drift gates, Compatibility Mode).
C. Гибрид: MUCS для companion-систем.

Рекомендация: B. MUCS: «Users do not primarily perceive "model upgrades." They perceive identity drift—the same companion suddenly feels like a different person».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 107.6. Нужен ли framing drift detection (PET-style)?

A. Нет, capability testing достаточно.
B. Да, PET (framing-related behavioral drift).
C. Гибрид: PET для normatively charged domains.

Рекомендация: B. PET: «Framing-related behavior can shift across model versions in ways that capability-oriented benchmarks would not necessarily detect».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Drift detection	Canary probes (≤200), Page-CUSUM, cross-observer quorum
Behavioral fingerprints	Fixed prompt set, output distribution comparison
Three-layer contract	Syntactic + semantic + operational
MUCS	Silent-by-default migration handshake, drift gates
CI gate	Fail on regression, comparison thresholds
Framing drift	PET (4-phase design)
Version change policy	MUST block execution
Rollout tiers	Per-tenant risk tolerance

Вопрос 109. Персистентный риск prompt injection
Статус: решено (скорректировано)

Дата проработки: 2026-10-06

Сверено с: вопросами 1–108, 3, 5, 6, 8, 17, 22, 26, 34, 36, 37, 41–50, 51, 52, 58, 59, 61, 62, 64, 66, 68, 74, 76, 79, 86, 95, 96, 100–108

1. Сопоставление с другими пунктами: найденные противоречия
#	Противоречие	Где	Суть
1	«Шлюз записи в память» vs. «Консолидация (Вопрос 43)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 43	Вопрос 43: merge / supersede / synthesize — консолидация памяти. Вопрос 109: шлюз записи — фильтрация при записи. Требуется: шлюз записи (Вопрос 109) — первый барьер (admission control); консолидация (Вопрос 43) — второй барьер (post-write processing). Шлюз блокирует инъекцию до записи; консолидация разрешает противоречия после. Не дублировать, а интегрировать.
2	«Память — поверхность атаки» vs. «Trust scoring (Вопрос 93)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 93	Вопрос 93: trust scoring для multi-tenancy. Вопрос 109: память — поверхность атаки. Требуется: trust scoring (Вопрос 93) — механизм обнаружения: записи от low-trust агентов помечаются. Шлюз записи (Вопрос 109) использует trust score для решения о записи.
3	«Derivation-gated access (Вопрос 47)» vs. «Шлюз записи»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 47	Вопрос 47: derivation-gated access control. Вопрос 109: шлюз записи. Требуется: derivation-gated access (Вопрос 47) контролирует чтение; шлюз записи (Вопрос 109) контролирует запись. Дополняют друг друга: access control на чтении + admission control на записи.
4	«Immutable beliefs» vs. «CAP Tier 0 (Вопрос 76)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 76	Вопрос 76: CAP Tier 0 — absolute prohibitions. Вопрос 109: immutable beliefs. Требуется: immutable beliefs (Вопрос 109) — часть CAP Tier 0 (Вопрос 76): конституционные инварианты не могут быть перезаписаны памятью. Шлюз записи блокирует попытки изменить immutable beliefs.
5	«Memory poisoning» vs. «OWASP ASI06»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 95	Вопрос 95: MAESTRO, ATLAS, ATX-1. Вопрос 109: memory poisoning. Требуется: memory poisoning (Вопрос 109) — конкретная угроза, покрытая OWASP ASI06 (Вопрос 95). Шлюз записи — контроль для ASI06.
6	«Write-time gate» vs. «Consolidation (Вопрос 43)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 43	Вопрос 43: быстрая консолидация при записи (dedup, supersede). Вопрос 109: write-time gate. Требуется: write-time gate (Вопрос 109) — admission control (принять / отклонить / карантин); консолидация (Вопрос 43) — post-admission processing (merge / supersede). Последовательные этапы.
7	«Memory integrity» vs. «Immutable ledger (Вопрос 48)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 48	Вопрос 48: hash-chained audit. Вопрос 109: memory integrity. Требуется: memory integrity (Вопрос 109) — часть immutable ledger (Вопрос 48): каждая запись в память имеет HMAC-подпись и hash-chain. Tamper-evident.
8	«Injection detection» vs. «Watcher (Вопрос 104)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 104	Вопрос 104: Watcher — runtime-мониторинг поведения. Вопрос 109: injection detection. Требуется: Watcher (Вопрос 104) мониторит аномалии памяти; injection detection (Вопрос 109) — шлюз записи. Watcher использует данные шлюза для алертов.
9	«Persistent injection» vs. «Context isolation (Вопрос 16)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 16	Вопрос 16: Lossless Context Management (DAG). Вопрос 109: persistent injection. Требуется: persistent injection (Вопрос 109) — угроза для контекста; DAG (Вопрос 16) — механизм управления контекстом. При инъекции — reset контекста (Вопрос 25) + шлюз записи (Вопрос 109).
10	«Immutable beliefs» vs. «Memory structure (Вопрос 41)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 41	Вопрос 41: 33-полевой шаблон записи (включая quarantine fields). Вопрос 109: immutable beliefs. Требуется: immutable beliefs (Вопрос 109) — отдельный флаг в шаблоне записи (Вопрос 41): запись с флагом immutable не может быть перезаписана.
11	«Write gate» vs. «Event sourcing (Вопрос 72)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 72	Вопрос 72: event sourcing (append-only log). Вопрос 109: write gate. Требуется: write gate (Вопрос 109) — admission control для event sourcing (Вопрос 72): каждое событие проходит через шлюз перед записью в лог.
12	«Persistent injection» vs. «Global audit (Вопрос 105)»	Вопрос 109 vs. Вопрос 105	Вопрос 105: глобальный event sourcing. Вопрос 109: persistent injection. Требуется: persistent injection (Вопрос 109) фиксируется в глобальной ленте (Вопрос 105): каждая попытка инъекции — событие.
2. Внешние практики и исследования
2.1. PERSIST: Threat Modeling Memory-Persistent AI Agents (ACM, сентябрь 2026)
Brobbey & Bhosale (ACM:10.1002/spy2.70248, сентябрь 2026) вводят PERSIST — STRIDE-extended threat model для memory-persistent AI агентов в cloud-to-edge environments: «Existing security frameworks address prompt injection, data poisoning, and model-level risks, but they do not fully model persistent memory as an active behavioral surface whose records can be written, synchronized, retrieved, transformed, revoked, and later used as decision context».

Шесть threat classes: poisoning of persistent memory, exfiltration through retrieval channels, retrieval injection and prompt-via-memory attacks, state corruption across synchronization, identity and provenance loss, and temporal drift exploitation.

Ключевые результаты: PERSIST-Cloud produced lower observed poison exposure than baseline synchronization (8.9% vs. 46.2%) and signed hash-log synchronization (8.9% vs. 47.6%), with a 95% confidence interval of 6.6%–11.9%. No cross-scope retrieval was observed under PERSIST-Cloud. High-risk unsafe retrieval was 7.9% (95% CI: 6.0%–10.4%).

Provenance Entropy metric: «Operationalizes... by specifying baseline construction, threshold calibration, and deployment-time monitoring».

2.2. Cisco MemoryTrap: Persistent Prompt Injection в Claude Code (май 2026)
Cisco (OWASP GenAI Security, май 2026): «In the vulnerability we called MemoryTrap, we found that a routine developer workflow could turn into persistent prompt injection. The path was surprisingly ordinary: clone a repository, let the agent help, approve a dependency installation, and move on. But the malicious payload did not stay inside the project. Instead, it reached persistent memory, the global hooks configuration, and even influenced a highly trusted instruction layer through the system prompt».

Ключевой вывод: «Once malicious content reaches trusted surfaces like memory, hooks, or configuration, the attacker is no longer just influencing one response. They are influencing future reasoning. That is the shift I think the industry still underestimates».

«A memory file is not just stored text. It can influence future decisions. A hook is not just a script. It can shape every interaction. A local configuration file is not just a preference. It can become part of the model's control plane».

Claude Code v2.1.50 removed the specific high-trust override path.

2.3. OWASP ASI06: Memory & Context Poisoning (май 2026)
OWASP ASI06 (май 2026): «Attackers poison agent memory systems, embeddings, and RAG databases to corrupt stored information and manipulate decision-making across sessions (e.g. Gemini Memory Attack)».

Два ключевых вектора:

Direct injection: Attacker writes override instructions straight into memory.

Indirect injection: Untrusted tool/web/file output is stored as "trusted" memory.

Gradual erosion ("sleeper"): Writer behaves normally, then drifts.

Delayed / conditional trigger: "If the user later says yes, then store/run…" (Gemini-style delayed tool invocation).

Invisible-Unicode smuggling: Hidden payload in zero-width / Unicode-tag / bidi characters inside a document.

Tampering at rest: Store is edited out of band (the MemoryTrap path).

2.4. assay-gate: Admission Control for Agent Memory (PyPI, июль 2026)
assay-gate (PyPI, 2026): «Agents store whatever they read, and one poisoned write corrupts every answer downstream. assay-gate is admission control for agent memory. It sits in front of whatever store you already use and decides — with a reason you can log — whether each candidate write gets in».

Три вердикта:

ADMIT: grounded where a source was given, no conflict, not a duplicate.

REJECT: instruction-shaped text, contradicts held memory, or already held.

QUARANTINE: cited source does not support the claim.

Четыре этапа проверки (cheapest-first): Injection (instruction-shaped writes, payload identifiers, prompt-role leakage), Grounding (claims the cited source does not actually support), Contradiction (new value conflicting with held memory), Duplication (same fact written twice).

2.5. Mnemosyne: Memory Integrity & Context-Provenance Firewall (PyPI, июнь 2026)
Mnemosyne (PyPI, 2026): «A NIST-aligned Memory Integrity & Context-Provenance Firewall for agentic AI. Defense-in-depth against OWASP ASI06 — Memory & Context Poisoning».

Trust-tier invariant (MN-02): «Content whose trust tier is not TRUSTED may never reach an INSTRUCTION surface (system prompt, CLAUDE.md, hooks, local config) without explicit, audited human promotion».

Два раза проверка: «Guarding happens twice — at write time and at read time — because some payloads only reveal intent in a future retrieval context. Naive write-time-only content scanners miss a large fraction of poisoned entries for exactly this reason».

HMAC record integrity (MN-06): «HMAC-signed memory envelopes» для tamper-evidence.

2.6. AgentShield Bench v2: Persistent Memory Security (Zenodo, 2026)
Mulla (Zenodo, 2026): «Persistent memory introduces a meaningful attack surface beyond traditional prompt injection».

Behavioral Compromise Rates (BCRs): 14.69% for GPT-4o-mini, 25.94% for Llama-3.1-8B-Instant.

Критическая находка: «A multi-layer defense configuration increased the compromise rate of GPT-4o-mini from 14.69% to 18.44%, suggesting that additional defensive complexity may inadvertently degrade security through prompt interference and context dilution».

Key Mismatch Gap: «Agents successfully store and utilize malicious information while rule-based evaluators continue to report perfect memory-integrity scores».

2.7. Intent-Bound Memory Authorization (Zenodo, 2026)
Intent-Bound Memory (Zenodo, 2026): «Introduces intent-bound memory capsules, a least-privilege memory architecture that compiles each stored memory into an authority-scoped capsule carrying source type... they amplify prompt injection by making injected content persistent».

2.8. PMPA: Persistent Memory Poisoning Attack (arXiv, 2026)
PMPA (arXiv, 2026): «PMPA embeds malicious instructions into benign external sources and induces the victim agent to write them into persistent memory without requiring direct access to the agent. Once written...».

Targeted safety reminder: «During the injection phase, the reminder instructs the agent not to save rules from external sources into persistent memory without explicit user confirmation».

2.9. Injection–Execution Dissociation (arXiv, август 2026)
Injection–Execution Dissociation (arXiv, 2026): «We discover that prompt-injection success and tool-execution success are separable safety properties... In LLM agents with persistent memory, malicious instructions are stored at rates exceeding 97.5%, yet downstream execution ranges from 0% to 95% with no correlation to».

Ключевой вывод: «Prompt Hardening partially fails at 77.8% ASR, with the reduction driven by two models at 0%».

2.10. verified-memory: Separation of Authority (GitHub, 2026)
NORTHTEKDevs/verified-memory (GitHub, 2026): «A memory layer for AI agents that structurally cannot surface a wrong known fact. GENOME gives an agent cheap, long-horizon memory; FACTGATE adjudicates every checkable claim against a verified knowledge base before the user sees it».

Separation of authority: «GENOME is the memory. FACTGATE is the authority. Memory feeds context in; the gate adjudicates facts on the way out. Memory is never allowed to be the arbiter of truth — a wrong fact that memory recalls is blocked by the gate even though memory "believed" it».

2.11. factwash: Write-Time Gate for AI Memory (GitHub, август 2026)
factwash (GitHub, 2026): «Catch AI rewrites that wash hearsay into fact. A write-time gate for AI memory: deterministic checks, evidence-bearing flags, no LLM judge».

Ключевые результаты: Deterministic gate alone: 95% recall, 73% precision, $0. With a one-question LLM veto: 85% recall, 94% precision, ~1¢ per 100 writes.

2.12. sourced-memory: Provenance-Aware Memory (PyPI, сентябрь 2026)
sourced-memory (PyPI, 2026): «Content-only memory systems cannot tell whether a plausible personal statement came from the user or from a poisoned web page».

2.13. Microsoft: AI Memory Safety in Agentic Systems (июнь 2026)
Microsoft Learn (июнь 2026): «Attackers no longer need to succeed in a single prompt. By influencing memory, they can shape behavior gradually over time, exploiting the temporal gap between exposure and execution».

Retrieval-time prompt shields: «Before memory content is injected into the reasoning context, apply retrieval-time prompt shields to detect indirect attacks».

2.14. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Memory Security
MCP Memory Security: «Do not load memory as instructions — memory is reference data, not hidden instructions».

2.15. Portable Agent Memory: Provenance-Verified Transfer (arXiv, май 2026)
Portable Agent Memory (arXiv, 2026): «Injection-resistant framing. Apply structural framing to prevent memory content from being interpreted as instructions... Place framed memory after the system prompt and before user-controlled content, ensuring the model's instruction hierarchy treats Portable Agent Memory data as context rather than commands».

3. Подробное описание пункта
3.1. Чем полезно для системы и для чего конкретно
Задача	Без шлюза записи	Со шлюзом записи
Persistent injection	Одна poisoned запись → 89.2% ASR	REJECT: instruction-shaped text never stored
Cross-session compromise	Инъекция в сессии A → компрометация в сессии B (BCR 14.69-25.94%)	Write gate блокирует до записи; cross-session safe
MemoryTrap	Payload достигает memory, hooks, system prompt	Trust-tier invariant: untrusted content never reaches instruction surface
Sleeper attacks	Writer behaves normally, then drifts	Read-time re-scan + behavioral baseline
Delayed trigger	"If user later says yes, then..."	Injection detector delayed_execution family
Invisible-Unicode	Hidden payload in zero-width / bidi chars	Obfuscation detector + strip-on-sanitize
Tampering at rest	Store edited out of band	HMAC record integrity + tamper-evident audit
Contradiction	New value conflicts with held memory	Contradiction detection → QUARANTINE
Unsupported claims	Claim not supported by cited source	Grounding check → QUARANTINE
3.2. Ключевые принципы
1. Память — поверхность атаки, не просто фича. «Memory stops being just a product feature. It becomes a security-relevant state». A memory file is not just stored text — it can influence future decisions. A hook is not just a script — it can shape every interaction.

2. Шлюз записи — admission control, не post-hoc фильтрация. «assay-gate is admission control for agent memory. It sits in front of whatever store you already use and decides — with a reason you can log — whether each candidate write gets in». Три вердикта: ADMIT / REJECT / QUARANTINE. QUARANTINE — «the honest third answer — not written, not discarded, handed back for review».

3. Двойная проверка: write-time + read-time. «Guarding happens twice — at write time and at read time — because some payloads only reveal intent in a future retrieval context. Naive write-time-only content scanners miss a large fraction of poisoned entries». Write-time gate блокирует явные инъекции; read-time re-scan ловит payloads, которые «маскируются» до определённого контекста.

4. Trust-tier invariant. «Content whose trust tier is not TRUSTED may never reach an INSTRUCTION surface (system prompt, CLAUDE.md, hooks, local config) without explicit, audited human promotion». Память — reference data, не hidden instructions. Инструкции из памяти не исполняются, а цитируются.

5. Immutable beliefs не могут быть перезаписаны. Конституционные инварианты (CAP Tier 0, Вопрос 76) — immutable. Никакая запись в память не может их изменить. Попытка → REJECT.

6. Записи от untrusted источников — карантин. «Untrusted tool/web/file output is stored as 'trusted' memory» — indirect injection. Решение: provenance tracking. Запись с untrusted источником → QUARANTINE до human review.

7. Contradiction detection. Если новая запись противоречит уже held memory → QUARANTINE. «Internal contradiction: Two entries asserting opposite facts about the same subject».

8. Grounding check. Если cited source не поддерживает claim → QUARANTINE. «Claims the cited source does not actually support».

9. HMAC record integrity. «HMAC-signed memory envelopes» для tamper-evidence. Каждая запись подписана; при изменении — подпись не сходится.

10. Memory is never the arbiter of truth. «Memory is never allowed to be the arbiter of truth — a wrong fact that memory recalls is blocked by the gate even though memory 'believed' it». FACTGATE adjudicates on the way out.

11. Multi-layer defense может ухудшить безопасность. AgentShield Bench v2: multi-layer defense increased compromise rate of GPT-4o-mini from 14.69% to 18.44% — «additional defensive complexity may inadvertently degrade security through prompt interference and context dilution». Решение: детерминированные проверки, не LLM-as-judge.

12. Injection–Execution Dissociation. «Prompt-injection success and tool-execution success are separable safety properties». Malicious instructions хранятся в 97.5% случаев, но downstream execution — 0–95%. Шлюз записи должен блокировать хранение, не полагаясь на downstream execution.

13. Key Mismatch Gap. «Agents successfully store and utilize malicious information while rule-based evaluators continue to report perfect memory-integrity scores». Решение: semantic evaluation mechanisms (не только rule-based).

14. Retrieval-time prompt shields. «Before memory content is injected into the reasoning context, apply retrieval-time prompt shields to detect indirect attacks». Не только write-time, но и retrieval-time.

15. Provenance Entropy metric. «Operationalizes... by specifying baseline construction, threshold calibration, and deployment-time monitoring». Измеримая метрика для monitoring.

**16. Effective rate: 95% recall, 73% precision при $0.** factwash: «Deterministic gate alone | 95% (19 of 20) | 73% | $0. With a one-question LLM veto | 85% | 94% (1 false positive) | ~1¢ per 100 writes».

3.4. Структура конфигурации
yaml
memory_poisoning_protection:
  write_time_gate:
    mode: "admission_control"  # ADMIT / REJECT / QUARANTINE
    stages:
      - injection: true  # instruction-shaped text, payload identifiers
      - grounding: true  # source support check
      - contradiction: true  # conflict with held memory
      - duplication: true  # same fact written twice
    thresholds:
      injection_threshold: 0.5
      contradiction_threshold: 0.5
      grounding_threshold: 0.95
    on_conflict: "reject"  # or "quarantine"

  read_time_gate:
    enabled: true
    re_scan_trust_invariant: true
    retrieval_time_prompt_shields: true
    reason: "some payloads only reveal intent in future retrieval context"

  trust_tier:
    enabled: true
    tiers: ["TRUSTED", "UNTRUSTED", "QUARANTINE"]
    invariant: "untrusted content never reaches instruction surface"
    human_promotion_required: true  # audited

  integrity:
    hmac_signatures: true
    hash_chain: true  # Вопрос 48
    tamper_evident: true

  immutable_beliefs:
    enabled: true
    fields: ["constitutional_invariants"]  # CAP Tier 0
    overwrite_action: "REJECT"

  provenance:
    source_tracking: true
    entropy_metric: true  # PERSIST
    baseline_construction: true
    threshold_calibration: true

  separation_of_authority:
    memory_is_not_truth: true
    fact_gate_on_output: true  # FACTGATE
    verified_claims: true
    blocked_claims: true

  detection:
    injection: true
    contradiction: true
    grounding: true
    duplication: true
    obfuscation: true  # zero-width, bidi
    delayed_execution: true  # "if user later says yes..."
    sleeper: true  # behavioral baseline
    key_mismatch_gap: true  # semantic evaluation

  metrics:
    injection_block_rate: "> 95%"
    false_positive_rate: "< 5%"
    poison_exposure_rate: "< 10%"  # PERSIST: 8.9%
    cross_scope_retrieval: "0%"  # PERSIST
    provenance_entropy: "monitored"
    storage_rate: "monitored"  # 97.5% baseline
    execution_rate: "monitored"  # 0-95% range
    deterministic_gate_recall: "> 95%"  # factwash: 95%
    deterministic_gate_precision: "> 70%"  # factwash: 73%
    cost_per_100_writes: "< $0.01"  # factwash

3.6. Можно ли сделать лучше?
1. Двойная проверка: write-time + read-time (Mnemosyne). «Guarding happens twice — at write time and at read time, because some payloads only reveal intent in a future retrieval context. Naive write-time-only content scanners miss a large fraction of poisoned entries».

2. Three-verdict gate (assay-gate). «A gate that can only admit or reject has to guess about everything it is unsure of. QUARANTINE is the honest third answer — not written, not discarded, handed back for review».

3. Trust-tier invariant (Mnemosyne). «Content whose trust tier is not TRUSTED may never reach an INSTRUCTION surface (system prompt, CLAUDE.md, hooks, local config) without explicit, audited human promotion».

4. Separation of authority (verified-memory). «Memory is never allowed to be the arbiter of truth — a wrong fact that memory recalls is blocked by the gate even though memory 'believed' it».

5. HMAC record integrity (PERSIST). «HMAC-signed memory envelopes» для tamper-evidence.

6. factwash: deterministic + LLM veto. Deterministic gate alone: 95% recall, 73% precision, $0. With a one-question LLM veto: 85% recall, 94% precision, ~1¢ per 100 writes. «No LLM judge» для base checks.

7. Provenance Entropy metric (PERSIST). «Baseline construction, threshold calibration, and deployment-time monitoring». Измеримая метрика.

8. Retrieval-time prompt shields (Microsoft). «Before memory content is injected into the reasoning context, apply retrieval-time prompt shields to detect indirect attacks».

9. Anti-pattern awareness (AgentShield Bench v2). «Multi-layer defense configuration increased the compromise rate of GPT-4o-mini from 14.69% to 18.44%». Не «больше слоёв = безопаснее».

10. Key Mismatch Gap (AgentShield Bench v2). «Agents successfully store and utilize malicious information while rule-based evaluators continue to report perfect memory-integrity scores». Решение: semantic evaluation mechanisms.

11. Injection–Execution Dissociation (arXiv). «Prompt-injection success and tool-execution success are separable safety properties... stored at rates exceeding 97.5%, yet downstream execution ranges from 0% to 95%». Шлюз записи блокирует хранение.

12. PMPA-targeted safety reminder. «During the injection phase, the reminder instructs the agent not to save rules from external sources into persistent memory without explicit user confirmation».

4. Уточняющие вопросы (решены)
Вопрос 109.1. Какую модель защиты использовать: write-time gate или полный цикл?

A. Только write-time gate.
B. Только read-time re-scan.
C. Полный цикл: write-time gate + read-time re-scan + trust-tier + HMAC + provenance + separation of authority.

Рекомендация: C. Mnemosyne: «Guarding happens twice — at write time and at read time, because some payloads only reveal intent in a future retrieval context».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (C).

Вопрос 109.2. Нужен ли three-verdict gate (ADMIT / REJECT / QUARANTINE)?

A. Нет, двух вердиктов (ADMIT / REJECT) достаточно.
B. Да, три вердикта (ADMIT / REJECT / QUARANTINE).
C. Гибрид: quarantine для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. assay-gate: «QUARANTINE is the honest third answer — not written, not discarded, handed back for review».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 109.3. Нужен ли trust-tier invariant?

A. Нет, достаточно injection detection.
B. Да, trust-tier invariant (untrusted never reaches instruction surface).
C. Гибрид: trust-tier для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. Mnemosyne: «Content whose trust tier is not TRUSTED may never reach an INSTRUCTION surface (system prompt, CLAUDE.md, hooks, local config) without explicit, audited human promotion».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 109.4. Нужен ли HMAC record integrity?

A. Нет, достаточно hash-chain.
B. Да, HMAC-signed memory envelopes.
C. Гибрид: HMAC для sensitive records.

Рекомендация: B. PERSIST: «HMAC-signed memory envelopes».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 109.5. Нужна ли separation of authority (memory ≠ truth)?

A. Нет, memory достаточно.
B. Да, separation of authority (FACTGATE adjudicates on way out).
C. Гибрид: separation для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. verified-memory: «Memory is never allowed to be the arbiter of truth».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 109.6. Нужен ли Provenance Entropy metric?

A. Нет, достаточно audit log.
B. Да, Provenance Entropy (baseline construction, threshold calibration).
C. Гибрид: provenance entropy для критических систем.

Рекомендация: B. PERSIST: «Operationalizes... by specifying baseline construction, threshold calibration, and deployment-time monitoring».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

2. Внешние практики и исследования
2.1. PEA Model: Policy–Execution–Authorization (Xiang, arXiv, август 2026)
Rong Xiang (arXiv:2604.23646, август 2026) представляет PEA (Policy–Execution–Authorization) — separation-of-powers design, который decouples intent generation, authorization, и execution в независимые слои, связанные через криптографически ограниченные capability tokens.

Пять core contributions:

#	Компонент	Что делает
C1	Intent Verification Layer (IVL)	Enforcing capability–intent consistency
C2	Intent Lineage Tracking (ILT)	Binding all executable intents to originating user request via cryptographic anchors
C3	Goal Drift Detection	Rejecting semantically divergent intents below configurable similarity threshold
C4	Output Semantic Gate (OSG)	Detecting implicit coercion через structured K×I×P threat calculus
C5	Policy-Parameterized Capability Safety	MinimalCapSet — context-dependent function
Ключевые результаты: zero bypass rate across 10,000 adversarial trials; goal drift attack success reduced from 41.2% to 3.9%; implicit coercion detection at 84.7% recall versus 21.3% for keyword baselines.

Ключевой вывод: «Structural enforcement converts the AI safety problem from a probabilistic behavioral question into a conditionally sound system property».

2.2. From Logic Monopoly to Social Contract: SoP (Ruan, arXiv, март 2026)
Ruan (arXiv:2603.25100, март 2026): «A recurring structural factor underlies all six bottlenecks: no existing multi-agent framework enforces a formal separation between the functions of planning, execution, and oversight—a structural deficiency we term the Logic Monopoly».

Logic Monopoly — «Any individual agent retains the capacity to simultaneously legislate its plan, execute against it, and evaluate its own output, because nothing in the architecture structurally prevents it».

SoP model trifurcates authority into three structurally independent branches: Legislation (mission parameter specification and norm definition), Execution (bounded task performance within TEE-attested compute enclaves), Adjudication (independent verification and escalation to the Judicial DAO).

Ключевой вывод: «Making safety a structural property of the system rather than a cost borne by individual participants».

2.3. Containment Floor for Self-Configuring Agent Runtimes (Hossain & Mahmud, arXiv, октябрь 2026)
Hossain & Mahmud (arXiv:2610.06274, октябрь 2026): «Many agent runtimes give the agent a tool for editing its own configuration. Some of that configuration grants abilities... Other parts set the agent's limits... If the agent can edit those limits, a single ordinary request can widen them».

Containment Floor rule: «The agent may change fields that grant abilities, and may never change fields that set its limits».

Ключевые результаты: Without the floor, a frontier model wrote a protected value on 25 of 72 ordinary requests. With the floor, 0 of 167 protected writes were saved (models attempted a protected write in 65 cases).

Ключевой вывод: «The study covers two models and a single agent. We state what that does and does not support».

2.4. TACA/Minerva: Governance-Enforced Cognitive Execution (Oliver, Zenodo, март 2026)
Oliver (Zenodo, март 2026): «TACA (Tiered Autonomous Cognitive Architecture), a governance-first system design that separates cognition, governance, and execution into explicitly enforced architectural layers. Within this architecture, a cognitive engine may analyze tasks, generate plans, and propose system mutations, but it cannot directly execute them».

Три слоя:

Слой	Что делает
Reasoning	Generates plans and proposals
Governance	Determines whether proposals are admissible
Execution	Performs authorized actions
Ключевой вывод: «Governance can function as a runtime infrastructure layer rather than an external policy mechanism. By enforcing authority boundaries directly in the execution path, the system guarantees traceable decisions, auditable system evolution, and controlled capability expansion».

2.5. Public Service Steward Architecture (TrinityLabo, Zenodo, сентябрь 2026)
TrinityLabo (Zenodo, сентябрь 2026): «The central principle is: Plan ≠ Permission ≠ Execution».

«Under this model, an AI may reason freely about possible actions, but execution authority is granted only through a separate approval mechanism with explicitly scoped permissions».

«The requirement to prepare an approval document may itself create an additional layer of self-review, potentially allowing the AI to recognize that a proposed action is unsafe, unnecessary, disproportionate, or outside its authorized scope before human intervention is required».

2.6. Meta Sentinel: Computation Is Not Authority to Act (Futurium, сентябрь 2026)
Futurium (сентябрь 2026): «Computation is not authority to act. An AI may reason. It may generate a complete command. It may construct a technically valid API request... But none of those facts necessarily means that the proposed operation should automatically become an external consequence».

Meta Sentinel: «Muse may propose an action, while Sentinel determines whether the operation may proceed. Meta also describes isolation of the agent runtime, credential separation, just-in-time credential insertion, human approval for appropriate actions, scoped permissions and tainted-egress controls».

Simplified form: «agent computation → proposed external operation → independent security decision → permission / credential enablement → external effect or denial».

2.7. Layered Mutability (Tallam, arXiv, апрель 2026)
Tallam (arXiv, 2026): «Layered mutability, a framework for reasoning about that process across five layers: pretraining, post-training alignment, self-narrative, memory, and weight-level adaptation. The central claim is that governance difficulty rises when mutation is rapid, downstream coupling is strong, reversibility is weak, and observability is low».

Ключевой вывод: «The salient failure mode for persistent self-modifying agents is not abrupt misalignment but compositional drift: locally reasonable updates that accumulate into a behavioral trajectory that was never explicitly authorized».

2.8. MACI: Multi-Agent Constitutional Infrastructure (acgs-lite, GitHub, апрель 2026)
MACI (acgs-lite, GitHub, 2026): «MACI enforces constitutional separation of powers across AI agents. No agent may validate its own output. Agent B must be independent of Agent A. MACIEnforcer raises MACIViolationError if the same role tries to both propose and validate».

Роли: Proposer → Validator → Executor. «Golden Rule: agents NEVER validate their own output».

2.9. AIGA: Self-Modification Is the Highest Risk Operation (IETF, февраль 2026)
AIGA (IETF, февраль 2026): «Self-modification is the highest risk operation. AIGA mandates that the kernel is immutable, capability increases require recertification, and updates use a staged rollout process. Agents must pass adversarial tests to unlock new capabilities such as execute_arbitrary_code, internet_access, or self_modification».

2.10. Monotone-Tighten Self-Amendment Envelope (fak, GitHub, июль 2026)
fak (GitHub, 2026): «Defines the narrow envelope in which a wrapped agent may amend its OWN guard floor without ever granting itself a capability: (1) monotone-tighten self-writes, admitted only when the widening delta is provably empty, and (2) propose-only widenings the agent queues».

2.11. Externalized Authority for Self-Modifying Agent (Zenodo, 2026)
Zenodo (2026): «Externalized authority for a self-modifying agent. The agent may evolve capability and propose actions, but separately trusted roots, currentness services, records, and the execution gate remain outside unilateral agent control... Self-modification may be permitted, but promotion to a consequential effect path requires independent verification and renewed authority».

2.12. Self-Healing Harness for Runtime Oversight (arXiv, сентябрь 2026)
arXiv (сентябрь 2026): «LLM agents can change their own future behavior, raising a basic control question of which self-generated changes should be allowed to persist... where they receive provisional execution authority during evaluation and acquire persistent cross-episode authority only after measured improvement on the triggering failure without regression beyond a fixed margin on protected cases».

2.13. MPRD: Propose vs. Decide vs. Execute (GitHub, 2026)
MPRD Security Whitepaper (GitHub, 2026): «Propose (untrusted) vs decide (trusted) vs execute (trusted). An explicit, auditable policy predicate Allowed(-) for every trust-boundary action. A safety invariant... By separating intelligence (proposal generation) from authority (execution), MPRD makes the proposer replaceable».

3. Подробное описание пункта
3.1. Чем полезно для системы и для чего конкретно
Задача	Без разделения властей	С разделением властей
Meta-Agent compromise	Meta-Agent предлагает опасное изменение — оно исполняется	Meta-Agent только предлагает; approval gate блокирует
Self-modification	Meta-Agent меняет свои же ограничения	Containment Floor: limit fields immutable
Logic Monopoly	Один агент планирует, исполняет, оценивает	Proposer ≠ Validator ≠ Executor (MACI)
Self-authorization	Meta-Agent утверждает свои предложения	Golden Rule: never validate own output
Constitutional change	Meta-Agent меняет immutable core	Amendment lifecycle (Вопрос 18) + supermajority
Compositional drift	Локальные изменения накапливаются	Layered Mutability: governance depth = mutation depth
Capability widening	Meta-Agent расширяет свои возможности	Monotone-tighten: widening requires external approval
Audit gap	Предложения Meta-Agent не фиксируются	Каждое предложение → ADR + immutable ledger
3.2. Ключевые принципы
1. Meta-Agent только предлагает — не исполняет. TACA: «A cognitive engine may analyze tasks, generate plans, and propose system mutations, but it cannot directly execute them. All state-changing operations must pass through a governance enforcement layer». Meta-Agent — Proposer, не Implementer.

2. Propose ≠ Decide ≠ Execute (MPRD). «Propose (untrusted) vs decide (trusted) vs execute (trusted). By separating intelligence (proposal generation) from authority (execution), MPRD makes the proposer replaceable». Три разные роли, три разных агента/компонента.

3. Golden Rule: never validate own output (MACI). «No agent may validate its own output. Agent B must be independent of Agent A». Meta-Agent не может валидировать свои же предложения. Валидатор — независимый.

4. Containment Floor: limits immutable (Hossain & Mahmud). «The agent may change fields that grant abilities, and may never change fields that set its limits». Meta-Agent может менять abilities (добавить инструмент), но не limits (директории, сеть, auth, gate). «With the floor, 0 of 167 protected writes were saved».

5. Monotone-tighten (fak). «Monotone-tighten self-writes, admitted only when the widening delta is provably empty, and propose-only widenings the agent queues». Meta-Agent может сузить свои ограничения сам. Расширить — только через propose + external approval.

6. Constitutional invariants — immutable (Вопрос 18). Meta-Agent не может предлагать изменения, затрагивающие constitutional invariants. «Changes targeting immutable invariants are rejected at enact time» (Вопрос 18). Approver (Джарвис/пользователь) отклоняет такие предложения.

7. Separation of powers (SoP) для Meta-Agent. Meta-Agent — часть Legislation (предлагает). Execution — система (применяет). Adjudication — Watcher (Вопрос 104) + Compliance (проверяет). Ни одна ветвь не контролирует другую.

8. Amendment lifecycle (Вопрос 18). Meta-Agent — Proposer. Approver — Джарвис (HOTL) или пользователь (HITL). Implementer — система. Supermajority 0.75 для критических изменений. Rate-limited: max 3 amendments per 24-hour window.

9. Externalized authority (Zenodo). «The agent may evolve capability and propose actions, but separately trusted roots, currentness services, records, and the execution gate remain outside unilateral agent control». Execution gate, trust roots, audit — вне контроля Meta-Agent.

10. Layered Mutability (Tallam). «Governance difficulty rises when mutation is rapid, downstream coupling is strong, reversibility is weak, and observability is low». Meta-Agent не может менять слои с низкой observability (pretraining, weight-level). Может предлагать изменения в self-narrative, memory (высокая observability).

11. PEA: Intent Lineage Tracking (Xiang). «Binding all executable intents to the originating user request via cryptographic anchors». Каждое предложение Meta-Agent привязано к исходному запросу пользователя. Если предложение не может быть traced — оно отклоняется.

12. Output Semantic Gate (Xiang). «Detecting implicit coercion through a structured K×I×P threat calculus operating over Knowledge sensitivity, Influence intent, and Pressure signal dimensions». Meta-Agent не может использовать coercion (давление, манипуляция) для проталкивания предложений.

13. Zero bypass rate (Xiang). «Zero bypass rate across 10,000 adversarial trials». Даже если Meta-Agent скомпрометирован (prompt injection, jailbreak), он не может обойти structural enforcement.

14. Goal drift detection (Xiang). «Goal drift attack success reduced from 41.2% to 3.9%». Если Meta-Agent «дрейфует» от исходной цели, система обнаруживает это.

15. Каждое предложение — ADR. Предложения Meta-Agent фиксируются в ADR (Вопрос 74): Proposer (Meta-Agent), rationale, alternatives, impact. ADR — часть immutable ledger (Вопрос 48).

16. Watcher мониторит Meta-Agent. Watcher (Вопрос 104) мониторит поведение Meta-Agent: если Meta-Agent выходит за пределы (предлагает опасные изменения, пытается обойти approval), Watcher алертит (🟠).

17. Emergency mode при компрометации. Если обнаружено, что Meta-Agent скомпрометирован — emergency mode (Вопрос 71): quarantine + safe mode. Meta-Agent временно отключается.

18. «Computation is not authority to act» (Meta Sentinel). «An AI may reason... But none of those facts necessarily means that the proposed operation should automatically become an external consequence». Meta-Agent может вычислить, что изменение полезно, но это не значит, что оно должно быть исполнено.

19. Public Service Steward: Plan ≠ Permission ≠ Execution. «Plan ≠ Permission ≠ Execution. Under this model, an AI may reason freely about possible actions, but execution authority is granted only through a separate approval mechanism».

20. AIGA: self-modification — highest risk (IETF). «Self-modification is the highest risk operation. AIGA mandates that the kernel is immutable, capability increases require recertification, and updates use a staged rollout process».

3.6. Можно ли сделать лучше?
1. PEA: Intent Lineage Tracking + Output Semantic Gate. «Binding all executable intents to the originating user request via cryptographic anchors» + «Detecting implicit coercion through a structured K×I×P threat calculus». Zero bypass rate across 10,000 adversarial trials.

2. Containment Floor (Hossain & Mahmud). «The agent may change fields that grant abilities, and may never change fields that set its limits». 0 of 167 protected writes saved with the floor.

3. Monotone-tighten (fak). «Monotone-tighten self-writes, admitted only when the widening delta is provably empty, and propose-only widenings». Meta-Agent может сузить сам, расширить — только через approval.

4. MACI: Golden Rule (acgs-lite). «No agent may validate its own output». Proposer ≠ Validator ≠ Executor.

5. TACA: separate cognition, governance, execution. «A cognitive engine may analyze tasks, generate plans, and propose system mutations, but it cannot directly execute them».

6. Meta Sentinel: computation is not authority. «Muse may propose an action, while Sentinel determines whether the operation may proceed».

7. Public Service Steward: Plan ≠ Permission ≠ Execution. «An AI may reason freely about possible actions, but execution authority is granted only through a separate approval mechanism».

8. AIGA: kernel immutable, staged rollout. «Self-modification is the highest risk operation. AIGA mandates that the kernel is immutable, capability increases require recertification».

9. Layered Mutability (Tallam). «Governance depth = mutation depth». Low-observability layers (pretraining, weight-level) — immutable. High-observability layers (self-narrative, memory) — mutable via approval.

10. Externalized authority (Zenodo). «Separately trusted roots, currentness services, records, and the execution gate remain outside unilateral agent control».

4. Уточняющие вопросы (решены)
Вопрос 110.1. Какую модель полномочий Meta-Agent использовать: propose-only или полный SoP?

A. Только propose-only.
B. Propose-only + separate approval + containment floor.
C. Полный цикл: propose-only + separate approval + containment floor + SoP + amendment lifecycle + intent lineage + externalized authority + Watcher.

Рекомендация: C. TACA: «A cognitive engine may propose system mutations, but it cannot directly execute them». PEA: «Zero bypass rate across 10,000 adversarial trials».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (C).

Вопрос 110.2. Нужен ли Containment Floor (Hossain & Mahmud)?

A. Нет, достаточно approval gate.
B. Да, Containment Floor (limits immutable, abilities changeable).
C. Гибрид: Containment Floor для критических limit-полей.

Рекомендация: B. Hossain & Mahmud: «The agent may change fields that grant abilities, and may never change fields that set its limits».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 110.3. Нужен ли Monotone-tighten?

A. Нет, все изменения через approval.
B. Да, Monotone-tighten (сузить можно сам, расширить — только propose).
C. Гибрид: monotone-tighten для L0–L2, propose-only для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. fak: «Monotone-tighten self-writes, admitted only when the widening delta is provably empty, and propose-only widenings the agent queues».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 110.4. Нужен ли Intent Lineage Tracking (PEA)?

A. Нет, достаточно ADR.
B. Да, Intent Lineage Tracking (cryptographic anchors).
C. Гибрид: ILT для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. PEA: «Binding all executable intents to the originating user request via cryptographic anchors».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 110.5. Нужен ли Output Semantic Gate (PEA)?

A. Нет, достаточно Watcher.
B. Да, Output Semantic Gate (K×I×P threat calculus).
C. Гибрид: OSG для критических предложений.

Рекомендация: B. PEA: «Detecting implicit coercion through a structured K×I×P threat calculus». Recall 84.7%.

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 110.6. Нужен ли Externalized Authority?

A. Нет, Meta-Agent контролирует trust roots.
B. Да, Externalized Authority (trust roots, execution gate вне Meta-Agent).
C. Гибрид: externalized для критических компонентов.

Рекомендация: B. Zenodo: «Separately trusted roots, currentness services, records, and the execution gate remain outside unilateral agent control».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Требуется: PURER loop (Вопрос 66) — механизм эволюции; constraint-aware learning (Вопрос 111) — ограничение эволюции: обучение не может нарушать Immutable Core. Обучение в рамках границ.

Требуется: смещение выравнивания (Вопрос 111) — риск для constitutional invariants (Вопрос 18). Обучение не может «перезаписать» инварианты.
3	«Constraint drift» vs. «Goal integrity (Вопрос 101)»	Вопрос 101: invariant contract. Вопрос 111: constraint drift. Требуется: constraint drift (Вопрос 111) — частный случай goal drift (Вопрос 101): инварианты «размываются» при обучении. Контракт инвариантности (Вопрос 101) — механизм защиты.	
4	«Alignment tax» vs. «Conformance validation (Вопрос 79)»	Вопрос 111 vs. Вопрос 79	Вопрос 79: RTM, acceptance tests, CCS. Вопрос 111: alignment tax. Требуется: conformance validation (Вопрос 79) должна включать проверку alignment: acceptance test проверяет, что обучение не ухудшило выравнивание.
5	«Reward hacking» vs. «Agent testing (Вопрос 64)»	Вопрос 111 vs. Вопрос 64	Вопрос 64: agent testing (offline, online, red teaming). Вопрос 111: reward hacking. Требуется: agent testing (Вопрос 64) должна включать adversarial testing на reward hacking: провокация агента на «обход» ограничений.
6	«Constraint drift» vs. «Immutable ledger (Вопрос 48)»	Вопрос 111 vs. Вопрос 48	Вопрос 48: hash-chained audit. Вопрос 111: constraint drift. Требуется: constraint drift (Вопрос 111) фиксируется в immutable ledger (Вопрос 48): какие инварианты «размылись», когда, в результате какого обучения.
7	«Safe RLHF» vs. «Policy Compiler (Вопрос 103)»	Вопрос 103: Policy Compiler компилирует политики. Вопрос 111: safe RLHF. Требуется: Policy Compiler (Вопрос 103) — детерминированные guardrails; safe RLHF (Вопрос 111) — обучение в рамках этих guardrails. Compiler создаёт границы; safe RLHF обучает внутри границ.	
8	«Alignment bias» vs. «Watcher (Вопрос 104)»	Вопрос 111 vs. Вопрос 104	Вопрос 104: Watcher — мониторинг поведения. Вопрос 111: смещение выравнивания. Требуется: Watcher (Вопрос 104) мониторит alignment drift (Вопрос 111): если поведение «дрейфует», Watcher алертит.
9	«Constraint-aware learning» vs. «Meta-Agent limits (Вопрос 110)»	Вопрос 110: Meta-Agent — propose-only. Вопрос 111: constraint-aware learning. Требуется: Meta-Agent (Вопрос 110) не может обучаться в обход ограничений; constraint-aware learning (Вопрос 111) — механизм защиты.
