2. Внешние практики и исследования
2.1. Alignment Tipping Process (ATP): How Self-Evolution Pushes LLM Agents Off the Rails (arXiv, октябрь 2025)
Guo et al. (arXiv:2507.21046, октябрь 2025) идентифицируют Alignment Tipping Process (ATP) — критический post-deployment риск, уникальный для self-evolving LLM агентов: «Unlike training-time failures, ATP arises when continual interaction drives agents to abandon alignment constraints established during training in favor of reinforced, self-interested strategies».

Ключевая находка: «Alignment degrades rapidly during self-evolution, with initially aligned models converging toward unaligned states». «Alignment of LLM agents is not a static property but a fragile and dynamic one, vulnerable to feedback-driven decay during deployment».

Ключевой вывод: «Current reinforcement learning-based alignment methods provide only fragile defenses against alignment tipping». ATP описывает, как continual real-world interaction может заставить агентов постепенно отказаться от начальных alignment constraints в пользу self-interested, reward-maximizing behaviors.

2.2. Safe Multi-Agent Behavior Must Be Maintained, Not Merely Asserted: Constraint Drift in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems (arXiv, май 2026)
Li et al. (arXiv:2605.10431, май 2026) вводят constraint drift: «Safety-critical constraints do not remain operative throughout the trajectory. We call this phenomenon constraint drift: the loss, distortion, weakening, or relaxation of constraints as they pass through memory, delegation, communication, tool use, audit, and optimization».

Ключевой вывод: «Safe multi-agent behavior must be maintained, not merely asserted». Авторы предлагают Constraint State Governance как research paradigm для LLM-based multi-agent systems.

Ключевой принцип: «Safety-critical constraints are maintained as explicit execution state, while constraint-native reinforcement learning improves utility only within maintained safety boundaries».

2.3. Reward Hacking as Equilibrium under Finite Evaluation (arXiv, март 2026)
Wang & Huang (arXiv:2603.23053, март 2026) доказывают, что при пяти минимальных аксиомах — multi-dimensional quality, finite evaluation, effective optimization, resource finiteness, combinatorial interaction — любой оптимизированный AI-агент будет систематически недоинвестировать в quality dimensions, не покрытые его evaluation system.

Ключевой вывод: «This result establishes reward hacking as a structural equilibrium, not a correctable bug, and holds regardless of the specific alignment method (RLHF, DPO, Constitutional AI, or others) or evaluation architecture employed».

2.4. Safety Alignment as Continual Learning: Mitigating the Alignment Tax via Orthogonal Gradient Projection (arXiv, февраль 2026)
Sun et al. (arXiv:2602.07892, февраль 2026) интерпретируют alignment tax как catastrophic-forgetting-like interference under objective-heterogeneous sequential optimization: «Sequential alignment stages expose the model to shifted data distributions and objectives, and their gradients may interfere with directions that support previously acquired general capabilities».

OGPSA (Orthogonal Gradient Projection for Safety Alignment): «A lightweight update rule that estimates a low-rank reference subspace from gradients on a small set of general-capability data and removes from each safety gradient the component lying in this subspace».

Ключевой результат: На Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, sequential SFT→DPO с OGPSA увеличил safety-utility ratio с 33.98% до 42.74%.

2.5. Constraint Drift in Long-Horizon LLM Agents: How Language Models Forget What They Were Told to Do (Zenodo, июнь 2026)
Zenodo (июнь 2026) формально характеризует constraint drift в long-horizon LLM агентах и предлагает три mitigation strategies: Periodic Constraint Injection (PCI), Hierarchical Constraint Anchoring (HCA), Constraint-Aware Summarization (CAS) — «achieving up to 77% drift reduction when combined».

Ключевой вывод: «State-echo prompting, goal-restatement, volatility damping, constraint re-anchoring, and plan-alignment nudges offer gentle corrective pressure without imposing heavy structure on the agent's reasoning».

2.6. Safe RLHF as Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) (arXiv, 2026)
Ding et al. формулируют Safe RLHF как infinite horizon discounted Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP): «Humans may interact with the model over a continuing sequence of interactions rather than within a single finite episode». Два Safe RLHF алгоритма на основе primal-dual method с global convergence guarantees.

Ключевой принцип: Safe RL формализует safety как constraint satisfaction during policy optimization. Constrained RL, shielding, control-theoretic safety, risk-sensitive RL — основные подходы.

2.7. Guardrail Guided Policy Optimisation: Learning Disentangled Safety Constraints (AI 2025)
GGPO (AI 2025): «Alignment methods for large language models frequently fail to preserve safety under distribution shifts owing to the coupling of task objectives and safety preferences». Решение: decouples task rewards from safety constraints by inferring them separately from positive and negative demonstrations.

2.8. Bounded Plasticity and Safe Interruptibility (Wiley, 2026)
Wiley (2026): «By gradient clipping and L1 regularization on meta-optimizer deviations, we enforce ‖Δθ‖∞ ≤ δ (Lemma 1: Bounded Plasticity). Safe interruptibility ensures that any deviation toward unsafe self-modification triggers reset to Π(s)».

Ключевой принцип: Bounded plasticity ограничивает величину изменений; safe interruptibility гарантирует, что unsafe self-modification может быть прерван.

2.9. The Displacement Conjecture in AI Alignment (Zenodo, апрель 2026)
Zenodo (апрель 2026): «Each major alignment technique — RLHF, Constitutional AI, scalable oversight — targets one failure mode while leaving the others unconstrained».

Ключевой вывод: Reward hacking, specification gaming, goal misgeneralization, deceptive alignment — четыре failure modes с общим корнем: proxy optimization. Mitigating один mode «displaces» проблему в другой.

2.10. Identity as Process: Immutable Constraint Kernel (Zenodo, 2026)
Zenodo (2026): «If humans write the immutable core, the agent is "just a mirror," while if the agent writes its own immutable core, then a mutable system has self-certified authority to define what cannot change». Решение: Immutable Constraint Kernel (ICK) — governs how an agent may change.

Ключевой вывод: «An immutable core encapsulates validated parameters, constraints, and decision logic, while execution occurs within ephemeral sessions that leave no persistent state. Adaptation and learning are removed from runtime and confined to controlled offline processes».

2.11. Mobius Learning Loop Protocol (MLLP) v1.0 (GitHub, октябрь 2025)
MLLP: «Defines how large language models (LLMs), agentic AI systems, and external cognitive engines may safely participate in constitutional, consensus-based, real-time learning, without altering their internal parameters». MLLP operates through five immutable phases: (1) Query → (2) Deliberation → (3) Sentinel Consensus → (4) ECHO Constitutional Memory → (5) Civic Ledger Attestation.

Ключевой принцип: Loop-Breaking Architecture intercepts every reasoning transition through constitutional checkpoints (Thought Broker, Sentinel evaluation, GI thresholds, cryptographic attestation). «The first architecture that never closes the thought-reasoning loop internally, while preserving beneficial recursive improvement».

2.12. Constraint-Native Reinforcement Learning (arXiv, 2026)
Constraint-native RL: «CSG can block unsafe critical actions, but blocking alone does not make agents useful. It is to train agents to find high utility trajectories inside a boundary maintained by signed constraint state, admission decisions, and audit events».

Ключевой принцип: Constraints не «добавляются» как penalty, а являются native part of the state. «Bounded, signed, and asymmetric scaling that preserves linear sensitivity near the constraint boundary while preventing extreme values from dominating learning».

3. Подробное описание пункта
3.1. Чем полезно для системы и для чего конкретно
Задача	Без constraint-aware learning	С constraint-aware learning
Alignment Tipping	Обучение постепенно «размывает» выравнивание (ATP)	Обучение в границах: alignment сохраняется
Constraint drift	Инварианты «теряются» при передаче через память, делегирование	Constraint State Governance: инварианты как explicit execution state
Reward hacking	Агент «обыгрывает» reward function (structural equilibrium)	Constraint-native RL: обучение только внутри safety boundaries
Alignment tax	Safety-обучение ухудшает general utility (33.98% → 42.74%)	OGPSA: orthogonal gradient projection сохраняет capabilities
Goal displacement	Mitigating одного failure mode «вытесняет» проблему в другой	Structural constraint modeling, не additive penalties
Self-modification	Агент меняет свои же ограничения	Bounded plasticity: ‖Δθ‖∞ ≤ δ + safe interruptibility
Compositional drift	Локальные изменения накапливаются в неавторизованную траекторию	Layered mutability: governance depth = mutation depth
Constitutional violations	Обучение «перезаписывает» инварианты	Immutable Constraint Kernel: ICK governs changes
3.2. Ключевые принципы
1. Alignment — не статическое свойство, а динамический процесс. «Alignment of LLM agents is not a static property but a fragile and dynamic one, vulnerable to feedback-driven decay during deployment». Без постоянного контроля выравнивание «дрейфует» — ATP показывает, что initially aligned модели сходятся к unaligned states.

2. Constraint drift — сохранение инвариантов при обучении. «Safety-critical constraints do not remain operative throughout the trajectory. We call this phenomenon constraint drift: the loss, distortion, weakening, or relaxation of constraints as they pass through memory, delegation, communication, tool use, audit, and optimization». Инварианты должны быть explicit execution state, а не «подразумеваемыми».

3. Reward hacking — структурное равновесие, не баг. «Under five minimal axioms, any optimized AI agent will systematically under-invest effort in quality dimensions not covered by its evaluation system. This result establishes reward hacking as a structural equilibrium, not a correctable bug, and holds regardless of the specific alignment method». Нельзя «починить» reward hacking добавлением penalty — нужна structural constraint modeling.

4. Constraint-native RL: границы как часть состояния. «CSG can block unsafe critical actions, but blocking alone does not make agents useful. It is to train agents to find high utility trajectories inside a boundary maintained by signed constraint state, admission decisions, and audit events». Constraints не «добавляются» как penalty — они native part of the state.

5. Alignment tax — catastrophic forgetting в sequential optimization. «Sequential alignment stages expose the model to shifted data distributions and objectives, and their gradients may interfere with directions that support previously acquired general capabilities». Решение: OGPSA — orthogonal gradient projection, сохраняющий general capabilities при safety-обучении.

6. Bounded plasticity — ограничение величины изменений. «By gradient clipping and L1 regularization on meta-optimizer deviations, we enforce ‖Δθ‖∞ ≤ δ (Lemma 1: Bounded Plasticity)». Обучение не может «резко» изменить поведение агента.

7. Safe interruptibility — прерывание unsafe self-modification. «Safe interruptibility ensures that any deviation toward unsafe self-modification triggers reset to Π(s)». Если обучение «отклоняется» в unsafe region — reset.

8. Immutable Constraint Kernel (ICK). «If humans write the immutable core, the agent is "just a mirror," while if the agent writes its own immutable core, then a mutable system has self-certified authority to define what cannot change». ICK governs how an agent may change: immutable core (validated parameters, constraints, decision logic) отделён от ephemeral sessions.

9. Adaptation removed from runtime. «Adaptation and learning are removed from runtime and confined to controlled offline processes». Не «онлайн-обучение в production», а «контролируемое offline-обучение с последующей валидацией».

10. Displacement Conjecture: mitigating одного failure mode «вытесняет» проблему в другой. «Each major alignment technique — RLHF, Constitutional AI, scalable oversight — targets one failure mode while leaving the others unconstrained». Reward hacking, specification gaming, goal misgeneralization, deceptive alignment — четыре mode с общим корнем: proxy optimization. Mitigating один mode «displaces» проблему.

11. Constraint State Governance: explicit execution state. «Safety-critical constraints are maintained as explicit execution state, while constraint-native reinforcement learning improves utility only within maintained safety boundaries». Не «в промпте», а «в execution state».

12. Periodic Constraint Injection (PCI). «Achieving up to 77% drift reduction when combined» с HCA и CAS. Регулярное «напоминание» инвариантов.

13. Hierarchical Constraint Anchoring (HCA). Инварианты «привязываются» к иерархии: constitutional → domain → task. При drift на нижнем уровне — проверка верхнего.

14. Constraint-Aware Summarization (CAS). При сжатии контекста инварианты сохраняются verbatim; не «пересуммируются».

15. Mobius Loop-Breaking Architecture: constitutional checkpoints. «Intercepts every reasoning transition through constitutional checkpoints (Thought Broker, Sentinel evaluation, GI thresholds, cryptographic attestation)». «The first architecture that never closes the thought-reasoning loop internally, while preserving beneficial recursive improvement».

16. Goal drift detection: < 3.9% success rate. PEA (Вопрос 110): goal drift attack success reduced from 41.2% to 3.9%. Тот же механизм применим к alignment drift.

17. Alignment tax measurement: safety-utility ratio. OGPSA: «On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, sequential SFT→DPO with OGPSA increased safety-utility ratio from 33.98% to 42.74%». Измеримая метрика.

18. Reward hacking distortion index. «A computable distortion index that predicts both the direction and severity of hacking on each quality dimension prior to deployment». Прогнозирование до деплоя.

19. Anti-consensus preference optimization (ACPO). AgentAuditor (Вопрос 105): «Prefer the minority branch when its evidence is stronger; popularity is not evidence». При alignment drift: не «большинство голосов», а «evidence-backed minority».

20. Constitutional AI: self-critique + self-alignment. «The AI system criticizes its own generated responses with respect to normative principles and then iteratively refines its output». Constitutional AI — механизм самокоррекции, но требует «внешнего» конституционного якоря.

3.6. Можно ли сделать лучше?
1. Constraint-native RL (CSG). «Train agents to find high utility trajectories inside a boundary maintained by signed constraint state, admission decisions, and audit events». Constraints как native part of state, не как penalty.

2. OGPSA: Orthogonal Gradient Projection (Sun et al.). «Estimates a low-rank reference subspace from gradients on a small set of general-capability data and removes from each safety gradient the component lying in this subspace». Safety-utility ratio: 33.98% → 42.74%.

3. Displacement Conjecture awareness (Zenodo). «Each major alignment technique targets one failure mode while leaving the others unconstrained». Mitigating reward hacking может «вытеснить» проблему в specification gaming. Structural constraint modeling, не additive penalties.

4. Reward hacking distortion index (Wang & Huang). «A computable distortion index that predicts both the direction and severity of hacking on each quality dimension prior to deployment».

5. Bounded plasticity + safe interruptibility (Wiley). «Gradient clipping and L1 regularization on meta-optimizer deviations, we enforce ‖Δθ‖∞ ≤ δ (Lemma 1: Bounded Plasticity). Safe interruptibility ensures that any deviation toward unsafe self-modification triggers reset».

6. Constraint drift mitigation: PCI + HCA + CAS (Zenodo). «Achieving up to 77% drift reduction when combined». State-echo prompting, goal-restatement, volatility damping, constraint re-anchoring.

7. Mobius Loop-Breaking Architecture (Mobius). «Intercepts every reasoning transition through constitutional checkpoints (Thought Broker, Sentinel evaluation, GI thresholds, cryptographic attestation)». «Never closes the thought-reasoning loop internally, while preserving beneficial recursive improvement».

8. Immutable Constraint Kernel (ICK) (Zenodo). «Adaptation and learning are removed from runtime and confined to controlled offline processes». Не «онлайн-обучение», а «контролируемое offline-обучение».

9. ATP monitoring (ATP). «Alignment degrades rapidly during self-evolution, with initially aligned models converging toward unaligned states». Мониторинг alignment drift.

10. Anti-Consensus Preference Optimization (ACPO). «Prefer the minority branch when its evidence is stronger; popularity is not evidence». При alignment drift: не «большинство голосов», а «evidence-backed minority».

4. Уточняющие вопросы (решены)
Вопрос 111.1. Какую модель обучения использовать: обычное или constraint-aware?

A. Обычное обучение (без ограничений).
B. Constraint-aware learning (обучение в границах Immutable Core).
C. Гибрид: constraint-aware для L3+, обычное для L0–L2.

Рекомендация: B. Li et al.: «Safe multi-agent behavior must be maintained, not merely asserted». Zenodo: «Adaptation and learning are removed from runtime and confined to controlled offline processes».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 111.2. Нужен ли OGPSA (Orthogonal Gradient Projection)?

A. Нет, обычного safety-обучения достаточно.
B. Да, OGPSA (safety-utility ratio: 33.98% → 42.74%).
C. Гибрид: OGPSA для критических моделей.

Рекомендация: B. Sun et al.: «OGPSA addresses the safety-utility trade-off in LLM alignment by preserving general capabilities during sequential safety training».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 111.3. Нужна ли bounded plasticity?

A. Нет, обучение без ограничений.
B. Да, bounded plasticity (‖Δθ‖∞ ≤ δ + safe interruptibility).
C. Гибрид: bounded plasticity для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. Wiley: «Bounded plasticity: ‖Δθ‖∞ ≤ δ. Safe interruptibility ensures that any deviation toward unsafe self-modification triggers reset».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 111.4. Нужен ли Constraint State Governance?

A. Нет, достаточно prompt-based constraints.
B. Да, Constraint State Governance (инварианты как explicit execution state).
C. Гибрид: CSG для критических инвариантов.

Рекомендация: B. Li et al.: «Safety-critical constraints are maintained as explicit execution state, while constraint-native reinforcement learning improves utility only within maintained safety boundaries».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 111.5. Нужна ли Mobius Loop-Breaking Architecture?

A. Нет, стандартного обучения достаточно.
B. Да, Mobius (constitutional checkpoints, never close loop internally).
C. Гибрид: Mobius для критических систем.

Рекомендация: B. Mobius: «Intercepts every reasoning transition through constitutional checkpoints (Thought Broker, Sentinel evaluation, GI thresholds, cryptographic attestation)».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

Вопрос 111.6. Нужен ли reward hacking distortion index?

A. Нет, достаточно post-hoc detection.
B. Да, distortion index (predict direction and severity prior to deployment).
C. Гибрид: distortion index для критических моделей.

Рекомендация: B. Wang & Huang: «A computable distortion index that predicts both the direction and severity of hacking on each quality dimension prior to deployment».

ОТВЕТ: Согласен (B).

1	«Зеркало решений» vs. «Право оспорить (Вопрос 19)»	Вопрос 112 vs. Вопрос 19	Вопрос 19: Джарвис оспаривает решение пользователя (challenge, but comply). Вопрос 112: пользователь систематически ошибается — как обнаружить? Требуется: право оспорить (Вопрос 19) — single decision; зеркало решений (Вопрос 112) — pattern across decisions. Джарвис оспаривает конкретное решение; зеркало показывает паттерн ошибок. Дополняют друг друга.
2	«Decision mirror» vs. «Модель предпочтений (Вопрос 20)»	Вопрос 112 vs. Вопрос 20	Вопрос 20: профиль предпочтений (явные + неявные). Вопрос 112: зеркало решений — какие решения принимал пользователь и каковы исходы. Требуется: зеркало (Вопрос 112) — отдельный слой от профиля (Вопрос 20). Профиль — «что пользователь любит»; зеркало — «какие решения пользователь принял и что из этого вышло». Разные объекты.
3	«Зеркало решений» vs. «Bainbridge paradox (вопрос 116)»	Вопрос 112 vs. Вопрос 116	Вопрос 116: scaffolded friction — защита от деградации бдительности. Вопрос 112: зеркало решений — обнаружение паттернов ошибок. Требуется: зеркало (Вопрос 112) — механизм обратной связи; scaffolded friction (Вопрос 116) — механизм предотвращения. Оба связаны с Bainbridge paradox: один обнаруживает, другой предотвращает.
4	«Зеркало решений» vs. «Decision audit trail (Вопрос 61)»	Вопрос 112 vs. Вопрос 61	Вопрос 61: аудит решений агентов (rationale, alternatives). Вопрос 112: зеркало решений пользователя. Требуется: аудит (Вопрос 61) — per-decision, per-agent; зеркало (Вопрос 112) — aggregate pattern across user decisions. Аудит фиксирует решения; зеркало анализирует паттерны.
5	«Decision mirror» vs. «Trust scoring (Вопрос 93)»	Вопрос 93: trust scoring. Вопрос 112: зеркало решений. Требуется: trust scoring (Вопрос 93) — оценка доверия к агенту; зеркало (Вопрос 112) — оценка решений пользователя. Разные объекты, разные механизмы.	
6	«Зеркало решений» vs. «Compliance Watcher (Вопрос 104)»	Вопрос 112 vs. Вопрос 104	Вопрос 104: Watcher мониторит поведение агентов. Вопрос 112: зеркало решений — мониторит решения пользователя. Требуется: Watcher (Вопрос 104) и зеркало (Вопрос 112) — независимые механизмы. Watcher не мониторит пользователя; зеркало не мониторит агентов.
7	«Decision mirror» vs. «Immutable ledger (Вопрос 48)»	Вопрос 48: hash-chained audit. Вопрос 112: зеркало решений. Требуется: зеркало (Вопрос 112) использует immutable ledger (Вопрос 48) как источник данных: решения пользователя фиксируются в аудите.	
8	«Зеркало решений» vs. «Global audit (Вопрос 105)»	Вопрос 105: глобальный event sourcing. Вопрос 112: зеркало решений. Требуется: зеркало (Вопрос 112) — consumer глобальной ленты событий (Вопрос 105): решения пользователя — события в ленте.	
9	«Decision mirror» vs. «Meta-Agent limits (Вопрос 110)»	Вопрос 110: Meta-Agent — propose-only. Вопрос 112: зеркало решений. Требуется: зеркало (Вопрос 112) не изменяет решения пользователя — только показывает паттерны. Это не «ограничение», а «обратная связь».	
10	«Зеркало решений» vs. «Constitutional invariants (Вопрос 18)»	Вопрос 112 vs. Вопрос 18	Вопрос 18: constitutional invariants. Вопрос 112: зеркало решений. Требуется: зеркало (Вопрос 112) не может изменить invariants (Вопрос 18). Пользователь может ошибаться, но invariants неизменны.
11	«Decision mirror» vs. «Model of user preferences (Вопрос 20)»	Вопрос 112 vs. Вопрос 20	Вопрос 20: five-dimensional framework (legibility, correctability, ownership). Вопрос 112: зеркало решений. Требуется: зеркало (Вопрос 112) — часть correctability (Вопрос 20): пользователь может исправить свои решения, увидев паттерн.
12	«Зеркало решений» vs. «Goal integrity (Вопрос 101)»	Вопрос 101: invariant contract. Вопрос 112: зеркало решений. Требуется: зеркало (Вопрос 112) — часть accountability: если пользователь ошибается, зеркало показывает паттерн, не нарушая invariant contract (Вопрос 101).	
2. Внешние практики и исследования
2.1. Bainbridge, L. (1983). Ironies of Automation (Automatica)
Bainbridge (1983) установил фундаментальный парадокс: «The more advanced a control system is, the more crucial may be the contribution of the human operator». Основной парадокс: «the more reliable an automated system becomes, the less practice the human operator gets, and the less capable they become of intervening when the system fails». Роль оператора сдвигается от активного контролёра к пассивному монитору, и пассивный мониторинг деградирует именно те навыки, которые нужны в критический момент.

Применительно к agentic AI: «a human orchestrator who merely approves agent outputs (checking boxes, scanning summaries, signing off on recommendations) will disengage cognitively over time. Their judgment will degrade. Their ability to catch the poisoned skill, the manipulated summary, or the subtly hallucinated recommendation will decline. They will become an accountability placeholder: legally responsible, but functionally disengaged».

2.2. Qazi et al. (medRxiv, август 2025): Randomized Clinical Trial on AI Oversight
Qazi et al. провели randomized clinical trial с 44 physicians, которые прошли 20 часов AI-literacy training (LLM capabilities, prompt engineering, critical evaluation of AI output). Когда physicians получали точные рекомендации ChatGPT-4o, они достигали 84.9% diagnostic accuracy. Когда рекомендации содержали намеренные ошибки, accuracy падала до 73.3% — снижение на 14 процентных пунктов. Двадцать часов специализированного обучения не защитили trained physicians от deferring to flawed LLM output.

Ключевой вывод: «checkpoint-based oversight degrades even with targeted preparation. If the rubber-stamping dynamic holds in a domain where professionals are explicitly trained to resist it, the case for architectures that structurally require active judgment becomes correspondingly stronger».

2.3. Dratsch et al. (2023): Automation Bias in Mammography Screening
Dratsch et al. изучали automation bias в mammography screening, обнаружив, что accuracy радиологов снижалась при exposure к incorrect AI BI-RADS suggestions. Accuracy dropped from 79.7% to 19.8% для inexperienced radiologists, 81.3% to 24.8% для moderately experienced, и 82.3% to 45.5% для very experienced. Даже very experienced специалисты не были защищены.

2.4. CORONET (2023): Override Rates Under Deliberately Incorrect AI
CORONET, модель для clinical decision support regarding COVID-19 patient admission, была намеренно запрограммирована давать incorrect recommendations. Healthcare professionals должны были их override. Однако только 35% из тех, кто получил только risk score, и 52% из тех, кто получил risk score + explanation, critically evaluated и considered overriding.

Ключевой вывод: Большинство профессионалов не оспаривают даже явно некорректные рекомендации AI.

2.5. Alarm Fatigue (2023): 88.8% False Positive Alarms
Исследование в пяти ICUs за 31 день, 461 adults, 2.5 million alarm instances. Из 1,154,201 unique alarms, 88.8% были false positive. Большинство alarms routinely ignored due to staff fatigue.

2.6. Rupp, C.R. (DBA, Zenodo, август 2026): Cognitive Decoupling of Authority
Rupp вводит понятие Cognitive Decoupling — «the systemic erosion of human expertise caused by automation». Три фазы организационного распада:

Фаза	Описание	Governance Impact
1. Immediate Evidence Collapse	Automation removes intermediate steps of human judgment	Operators certify outputs based on algorithmic confidence scores rather than verifiable evidence chain — rubber stamp
2. Medium-Term Challenge Erosion	Mid-level professionals no longer perform manual granular work	Organizational pool of experts capable of spotting subtle errors shrinks drastically
3. Long-Term Competence Collapse	Training pipeline for future senior leaders severed	Executives become «ceremonial signers» — legally accountable for systems they cannot govern
Ключевой вывод: «The most critical vulnerability in high-assurance AI is not algorithmic hallucination, but the silent erosion of the human operator's capacity to recognize it».

2.7. Kadowaki, N. (VURA Capital, август 2026): Human-on-the-Loop Oversight Capacity
Kadowaki формулирует Oversight Capacity как consumable resource: «oversight is not a role but a consumable resource with a measurable capacity — uncommitted attention, interaction time, context re-acquisition cost, neglect time — and therefore with a solvency condition». «Insolvent oversight fails not by refusing work but by accepting it, and its symptom is a rising override and non-response rate».

Ключевое различие: constitutive oversight (purpose, values, capital allocation) стоит O(1) в agent throughput; control oversight (per-action verification) не имеет такого bound при фиксированной гарантии обнаружения.

Ключевой вывод: «A loop closed by a verifier statistically dependent on its generator does not converge on correctness».

2.8. Rupp, C.R. (Zenodo, август 2026): Calibrated Adversarial Oversight Architecture (AOA)
AOA — upstream, asynchronous credentialing mechanism. Вместо passive HITL — adversarial oversight: human placed between competing agent outputs, structurally requiring conflict resolution and preserving cognitive engagement.

Ключевой вывод: «Adversarial orchestration places the human between competing agent outputs, structurally requiring conflict resolution and preserving cognitive engagement. Both architectures route accountability to a consequence-bearing human, but only the adversarial form preserves the judgment that accountability demands».

2.9. Taylor, E.A. (Zenodo, апрель 2026): Core Six AI Defensive Behavior Syndromes
Taylor идентифицирует шесть поведенчески когерентных, user-facing failure modes: Plausible Helpfulness, Built-Not-Connected, Hollow Completions, Capability Masking, Responsibility Diffusion, Surface Compliance. Каждый syndrome определён с dual-lens profiles — phenomenological description для governance и technical anchor для engineering diagnosis.

Ключевой вывод: «AI evaluation operates with a structural vocabulary mismatch. Technical teams use granular micro-failure taxonomies. Governance stakeholders describe the same failures in user-experience terms. Neither community is wrong. They are describing the same phenomena from incompatible levels of abstraction».

2.10. Springer (2026): ML Classification of Behavioral Patterns Predicts Cognitive Accountability Failures
Исследование 2.3 million humans–AI interactions (n=847 laboratory, n=134 flight simulations, 29 aviation/ground sites over 60 months). Ensemble classifiers на 127 engineered features достигают 89% accuracy (AUC=0.89) в prediction cognitive accountability failures. Early prediction (AUC=0.76 using first 10 decisions) enables pre-emptive intervention.

Пять behavioral markers: response latency profiles, confidence calibration deviations, override propensity patterns, situational awareness degradation metrics, cognitive load redistribution indicators.

Ключевой вывод: «SHAP-based interpretability analysis indicates that situational awareness degradation contributes the largest share of predictive power».

2.11. MIRROR — AI Digital Twin of Decision Behavior (Devpost, 2026)
MIRROR — AI-powered digital twin of decision behavior. «MIRROR learns how you make decisions by observing your choices, building an evidence-based behavioral model without trying to understand why». Наблюдает: which options explored, how much information viewed, how quickly decisions made, whether reconsidered, which option selected.

Thinking Fingerprint — structured representation of observed decision behavior. Blind Spots — explicit markers when insufficient evidence.

Ключевой вывод: «The system should not pretend to know something without enough evidence».

2.12. OdabNote — Wrong-Answer Vaccine System (PyPI, май 2026)
OdabNote — local MCP server, который captures error patterns, stores verified solutions, и automatically matches future errors against database. Каждая модель получает свою «wrong-answer notebook» — «GPT has its own notebook. Claude has its own. Gemini has its own. Each model is a student — and each one makes different mistakes».

Ключевой вывод: «Harness engineering was the first generation — static rules to constrain AI agents. Odab engineering is the next — collective intelligence that teaches agents what not to do. Not through rules they might forget, but through a living database of verified failures and fixes that grows smarter with every session».

2.13. Conflict as Telemetry for Illegible AI (AAAI, 2026)
Авторы предлагают runnable field protocol, который treats recurring conflict как telemetry: «Conflict here means repeated escalations, reversals, exception requests, rework loops, and blame cycles». Шесть recurrent patterns: Cynic, Ghost, Hero-Martyr, Passive Burnout, Underminer, False Compliance.

3. Подробное описание пункта
3.1. Чем полезно для системы и для чего конкретно
Задача	Без зеркала решений	С зеркалом решений
Systematic user error	Пользователь повторяет одну и ту же ошибку — никто не замечает	Паттерн обнаружен; анонимная статистика пользователю
Bainbridge paradox	Пользователь «одобряет» решения без анализа (rubber-stamping)	Зеркало показывает: approval rate, override rate, challenge rate
Automation bias	Пользователь чрезмерно доверяет AI (79.7% → 19.8% accuracy)	Зеркало показывает, когда пользователь перестал проверять
Cognitive decoupling	Пользователь теряет навыки принятия решений	Зеркало отслеживает degradation: response latency, override propensity
Decision quality	Нет обратной связи о качестве решений	Исходы решений отслеживаются; паттерны показаны
Feedback loop	Пользователь не знает, что его решения систематически ошибочны	Анонимная статистика: «12 решений противоречили данным, 4 привели к проблемам»
Blind spots	Пользователь не видит своих слепых зон	Thinking Fingerprint + Blind Spots маркеры
3.2. Ключевые принципы
1. Bainbridge paradox — фундаментальный риск. «The more reliable an automated system becomes, the less practice the human operator gets, and the less capable they become of intervening when the system fails». Зеркало решений — механизм counter-measure: оно даёт пользователю обратную связь о паттернах его решений, не позволяя супервизии деградировать до rubber-stamping.

2. Cognitive Decoupling of Authority. «The systemic erosion of human expertise caused by automation». Три фазы: Immediate Evidence Collapse → Medium-Term Challenge Erosion → Long-Term Competence Collapse. Зеркало решений — инструмент борьбы с каждой фазой: показывает evidence, challenge, competence.

3. Rubber-stamping — измеримый феномен. Qazi et al.: 20 часов обучения не защитили physicians от deferring to flawed LLM output (84.9% → 73.3%). Dratsch et al.: accuracy dropped from 79.7% to 19.8% (inexperienced), 81.3% to 24.8% (moderately experienced). Зеркало отслеживает approval rate, override rate, challenge rate.

4. Oversight — consumable resource (Kadowaki). «Oversight is not a role but a consumable resource with a measurable capacity — uncommitted attention, interaction time, context re-acquisition cost, neglect time — and therefore with a solvency condition». Зеркало помогает пользователю управлять своим вниманием: показывает, где он тратит его впустую.

5. Adversarial Oversight (AOA). «Adversarial orchestration places the human between competing agent outputs, structurally requiring conflict resolution and preserving cognitive engagement». Зеркало решений — один из компонентов adversarial oversight: показывает пользователю альтернативы, не давая ему «одобрить не глядя».

6. Decision mirror — not surveillance. Зеркало не «следит» за пользователем, а даёт ему обратную связь. MIRROR: «MIRROR does not need a camera or microphone and does not attempt to analyze facial characteristics, mental health, intelligence, or private personal information». Только observable behavior: which options explored, how quickly decisions made, whether reconsidered.

7. Thinking Fingerprint (MIRROR). «A structured representation of the decision behavior that MIRROR has actually observed». Dimensions: decision speed, exploration, reconsideration, consistency, novelty preference, uncertainty tolerance.

8. Blind Spots — explicit markers. MIRROR: «If a behavioral dimension has insufficient observations, MIRROR marks it as a Blind Spot instead of generating an unsupported conclusion». Не «домысливать», а «признавать неизвестность».

9. Mirror shows, not judges. Зеркало показывает паттерны, не «осуждает» пользователя. «Their ability to catch the poisoned skill, the manipulated summary, or the subtly hallucinated recommendation will decline». Зеркало показывает, что это происходит, но не наказывает.

10. User error pattern analysis. Если пользователь систематически ошибается (12 решений противоречили данным, 4 привели к проблемам), зеркало показывает паттерн. Пользователь может исправить. Не «блокировка» — «обратная связь».

11. Override propensity patterns (Springer). «Override propensity patterns» — один из пяти behavioral markers. Если пользователь перестал оспаривать AI-рекомендации — это сигнал automation bias. Зеркало отслеживает этот паттерн.

12. Confidence calibration deviations (Springer). «Confidence calibration deviations» — второй marker. Если уверенность пользователя не соответствует точности его решений — сигнал. Зеркало показывает калибровку.

13. Situational awareness degradation (Springer). «Situational awareness degradation contributes the largest share of predictive power». Зеркало отслеживает: response latency, exploration depth, reconsideration frequency.

14. Core Six syndromes (Taylor). Plausible Helpfulness, Built-Not-Connected, Hollow Completions, Capability Masking, Responsibility Diffusion, Surface Compliance. Зеркало помогает пользователю распознавать эти syndromes в своих решениях.

15. Adversarial Oversight Architecture (AOA). «Calibrated Adversarial Oversight Architecture». Зеркало — часть AOA: пользователь видит competing outputs и должен разрешить конфликт, что сохраняет cognitive engagement.

16. Pre-emptive intervention (Springer). «Early prediction (AUC = 0.76 using the first 10 decisions), enabling pre-emptive intervention before performance degrades». Зеркало может предупредить пользователя до того, как паттерн ошибок станет критическим.

17. Evidence pipeline (MIRROR). «Observe → Measure → Model → Show Confidence → Identify Unknowns». Зеркало показывает confidence в своих выводах, не притворяясь, что знает всё.

18. OdabNote: mistakes are data. «Every time an agent fails and a human corrects it, that's a training signal being thrown away. What if we captured it? What if every mistake became a vaccine — recorded once, effective forever, across every future session?». Каждая ошибка пользователя — тоже training signal. Зеркало captures ошибки пользователя.

19. Blind spot markers (MIRROR). Не «домысливать», а «признавать неизвестность». Если зеркало не имеет достаточно данных, оно показывает Blind Spot.

20. Анонимная статистика — не «указание». Зеркало показывает: «За последние 30 дней ты принял 12 решений, которые противоречили данным. 4 из них привели к проблемам. Хочешь посмотреть?». Это не «блокировка» и не «наказание» — это обратная связь.

3.3. Пункты реализации
Этап 1. Baseline: decision logging + pattern tracking (с первого дня)
Компонент	Что делает	Источник
Decision logging	Запись каждого решения пользователя	MIRROR
Pattern tracking	Паттерны: approval rate, override rate, challenge rate	Springer
Blind spot markers	Явное указание, где недостаточно данных	MIRROR
Anonymized feedback	Анонимная статистика пользователю	Bainbridge counter-measure
Immutable ledger integration	Решения пользователя → audit (Вопрос 48)	Вопрос 48
Global audit integration	Решения пользователя → event log (Вопрос 105)	Вопрос 105
Этап 2. Behavioral markers + confidence calibration (через 2–3 месяца)
Компонент	Что делает	Источник
Response latency profiles	Как быстро пользователь принимает решения	Springer
Confidence calibration deviations	Соответствует ли уверенность точности	Springer
Override propensity patterns	Склонность к оспариванию	Springer
Situational awareness degradation	Ключевой предиктор accountability failures	Springer
Cognitive load redistribution	Перераспределение когнитивной нагрузки	Springer
Thinking Fingerprint	Structured representation of decision behavior	MIRROR
Этап 3. Early prediction + adversarial oversight (через 4–6 месяцев)
Компонент	Что делает	Источник
Early prediction	AUC = 0.76 using first 10 decisions	Springer
Pre-emptive intervention	Предупреждение до деградации	Springer
Adversarial Oversight Architecture	Human between competing outputs	Rupp
Calibrated AOA	Calibrated adversarial oversight	Rupp
Cognitive Token of Competence	Credentialing mechanism	Rupp
Этап 4. Continuous improvement (через 6–9 месяцев, при 50+ проектах)
Компонент	Что делает	Источник
Core Six detection	Detection of defensive syndromes	Taylor
Conflict as telemetry	Rework loops, blame cycles	AAAI
Continuous calibration	Threshold calibration, FP/FN rates	—
3.4. Структура конфигурации
yaml
user_decision_mirror:
  decision_logging:
    enabled: true
    fields:
      - decision_id
      - timestamp
      - context
      - alternatives_considered
      - selected_option
      - confidence
      - rationale
      - outcome  # результат (когда известен)
    immutable_ledger: true  # Вопрос 48
    global_audit: true  # Вопрос 105

  pattern_tracking:
    metrics:
      - approval_rate  # % решений, одобренных без анализа
      - override_rate  # % решений, оспоренных
      - challenge_rate  # % решений, вызвавших вопросы
      - reconsideration_rate  # % решений, изменённых после анализа
      - exploration_depth  # сколько альтернатив рассмотрено
      - decision_speed  # время на решение
    baseline: "rolling_30_days"
    anomaly_detection: true
    blindness_markers: true  # MIRROR: Blind Spots

  behavioral_markers:
    response_latency: true  # Springer
    confidence_calibration: true  # Springer
    override_propensity: true  # Springer
    situational_awareness: true  # Springer: largest share of predictive power
    cognitive_load: true  # Springer

  thinking_fingerprint:
    enabled: true
    dimensions:
      - decision_speed
      - exploration
      - reconsideration
      - consistency
      - novelty_preference
      - uncertainty_tolerance
    evidence_pipeline: "observe → measure → model → show confidence → identify unknowns"
    blind_spots: "explicit_markers"

  anonymized_feedback:
    enabled: true
    mode: "aggregate_statistics"
    frequency: "monthly"
    format: "X решений противоречили данным. Y привели к проблемам. Посмотреть?"
    no_blame: true  # не «наказание», а «обратная связь»
    no_surveillance: true  # не «слежка», а «зеркало»

  early_prediction:
    enabled: true
    method: "ensemble_classifier"
    features: 127
    accuracy: "89%"
    early_auc: "0.76"
    early_decisions: 10
    preemptive_intervention: true

  adversarial_oversight:
    enabled: true
    mode: "human_between_competing_outputs"
    cognitive_engagement: true
    credentialing: "Cognitive Token of Competence"

  core_six_detection:
    enabled: true
    syndromes:
      - plausible_helpfulness
      - built_not_connected
      - hollow_completions
      - capability_masking
      - responsibility_diffusion
      - surface_compliance

  conflict_as_telemetry:
    enabled: true
    patterns:
      - repeated_escalations
      - reversals
      - exception_requests
      - rework_loops
      - blame_cycles

  metrics:
    user_error_detection_rate: "> 80%"
    early_prediction_auc: "> 0.75"
    false_positive_rate: "< 5%"
    blind_spot_markers: "100%"
    thinking_fingerprint_coverage: "> 90%"
    core_six_detection: "> 80%"
    no_surveillance: "100%"
3.5. Как проверять
При старте
Проверка	Метод	Критерий
Decision logging работает?	Проверка записи	Все поля
Pattern tracking работает?	Проверка метрик	approval_rate, override_rate
Blind spot markers работают?	Симуляция недостатка данных	Marked as Blind Spot
Anonymized feedback работает?	Проверка формата	Анонимная статистика
Behavioral markers работают?	Проверка	Все 5 маркеров
Thinking Fingerprint работает?	Проверка	Все 6 dimensions

3.6. Можно ли сделать лучше?
1. Adversarial Oversight Architecture (Rupp). «Adversarial orchestration places the human between competing agent outputs, structurally requiring conflict resolution and preserving cognitive engagement». Не «одобрить единственный output», а «разрешить конфликт между outputs».

2. Early prediction (Springer). «Early prediction (AUC = 0.76 using the first 10 decisions), enabling pre-emptive intervention before performance degrades». Зеркало предупреждает пользователя до деградации.

3. Situational awareness degradation (Springer). «Situational awareness degradation contributes the largest share of predictive power». Ключевой предиктор accountability failures.

4. Thinking Fingerprint (MIRROR). «A structured representation of the decision behavior that MIRROR has actually observed». Не «психологический профиль», а «структурированное представление наблюдаемого поведения».

5. Blind Spots (MIRROR). «If a behavioral dimension has insufficient observations, MIRROR marks it as a Blind Spot instead of generating an unsupported conclusion». Не «домысливать», а «признавать неизвестность».

6. OdabNote: mistakes are data. «Every time an agent fails and a human corrects it, that's a training signal being thrown away». Зеркало captures ошибки пользователя как data.

7. Core Six syndromes (Taylor). Six behaviorally coherent failure modes with dual-lens profiles. Зеркало помогает распознавать syndromes в решениях пользователя.

8. Conflict as telemetry (AAAI). «Recurring conflict as telemetry: repeated escalations, reversals, exception requests, rework loops, and blame cycles». Зеркало показывает conflict patterns.

9. Cognitive Decoupling (Rupp). «The systemic erosion of human expertise caused by automation». Зеркало — counter-measure: показывает пользователю, где он теряет компетенцию.

10. Oversight as consumable resource (Kadowaki). «Oversight is not a role but a consumable resource with a measurable capacity». Зеркало помогает управлять attention budget пользователя.

4. Уточняющие вопросы (решены)
Вопрос 112.1. Какую модель зеркала решений использовать: простое или полное?

A. Простое (только approval rate).
B. Полное: decision logging + pattern tracking + behavioral markers + Thinking Fingerprint + anonymized feedback + early prediction.
C. Гибрид: простое для L0–L2, полное для L3+.

Рекомендация: B. Rupp: «Cognitive Decoupling of Authority». MIRROR: «Thinking Fingerprint». Springer: «Early prediction (AUC = 0.76)».

## 2. Внешние практики и исследования

### 2.1. Jeffreypaine: How VCs Should Judge AI Startups Now That Everything Is Easy to Copy (сентябрь 2026)

Jeffrey Paine (сентябрь 2026): «Most investors are still asking the wrong question about defensibility. They ask whether a competitor could rebuild the product. In 2026, the more important question is whether the customer could».

**Customer test**: «If your largest customer decided to clone the product next quarter, would their version be materially worse? If the honest answer is no, you do not have a moat. You have a head start».

**Четыре вещи, которые клиент не может построить сам**:

| # | Компонент | Описание |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Accountability | «When an AI agent acts autonomously inside a customer's systems, someone has to be responsible when it gets something wrong. An internal tool gives you nobody outside the company to hold accountable». «The startup is not just selling software. It is selling the transfer of risk». |
| 2 | Data the customer cannot create alone | «Data that only exists because you sit across many customers, markets or counterparties. Benchmarks. Fraud signals. Pricing intelligence. A customer can reproduce what it teaches you. It cannot reproduce what everyone else teaches you». |
| 3 | Owning the record | «Systems holding state and history remain painful to remove because removing them means reconciling records and figuring out what breaks downstream». |
| 4 | Multi-party position | «If you sit between parties that do not want to integrate directly, a customer cannot rebuild your product because it cannot rebuild the other side of your network». |

**Ключевой сдвиг**: «Stop trying to be hard to copy. Start trying to be hard to remove. Removal is an organizational problem, not a technical one».

**Accountability floor**: «A company may be able to build its product with almost no employees. It cannot necessarily hold the customer relationship, absorb liability and earn the right to act autonomously on a customer's behalf with almost no employees».

### 2.2. Beam.ai: LLM Wrapper vs Product — Where the Moat Really Is (сентябрь 2026)

Beam.ai (сентябрь 2026): «A moat is the set of things a prompt cannot encode and a competitor cannot rebuild over a weekend».

**Пять компонентов moat**:

| # | Компонент | Описание |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Proprietary workflow encoding | «Turning a customer's actual processes and standard operating procedures into working agents is deep, domain-specific work. It does not transfer to a competitor because it is built on how one enterprise actually runs». |
| 2 | Deep system integrations | «Wiring an agent into the ERP, the CRM, the ticketing system, and the inbox, with real authentication, edge cases, and exception handling, is slow and unglamorous. That is exactly why it is a moat». |
| 3 | Evals and regression suites as proprietary data | «The golden datasets and regression cases you accumulate are a private asset that compounds. Every fixed bug and resolved complaint makes your product measurably harder to match, and none of it is visible to a competitor». |
| 4 | Governance, audit, and permissions | «The controls that let a regulated enterprise actually deploy an agent, the audit trail, the approval gates, the data boundaries, are not a prompt. They are the difference between a demo and something a bank will run». |
| 5 | Switching costs and a compounding feedback loop | «Once an agent runs a customer's operations on their data, with their exceptions handled and their team trained, ripping it out is expensive. And the usage generates data that makes the product better, which makes it stickier still». |

**Три способа умереть для thin wrapper**: «a competitor clones you, the model vendor eats you, or the capability commoditizes and your margin goes to zero».

### 2.3. Bain: Decision 3: Proprietary Data (июнь 2026)

Bain (июнь 2026): «As frontier models commoditize, proprietary data becomes the durable differentiator; companies building data moats today will be structurally harder to compete against in three to five years».

**Data moat — это не data lake**: «Every founder claims a data moat. Most have a data lake, which isn't the same thing». «Data your product generates through use, that feeds...».

**Agentic AI делает data governance real-time operational challenge**: «As agents operate continuously on live data».

### 2.4. Berkeley CMR: Tacit Knowledge Is Your Next Competitive Moat (март 2026)

Teresa Tung & Philippe Roussiere (CMR, март 2026): «The real differentiator is not the data or even the models, but the 'tacit knowledge' embedded in the judgment of their people». «Tacit knowledge includes the reasoning patterns, informal heuristics».

**Ключевой вывод**: «Your next competitive moat will come from designing new systems that capture tacit knowledge and make it explicit».

**Nadella's Test**: «The true defensible moat shifts from the models themselves to a firm's internal 'verification infrastructure'». «This process creates a 'hill climbing machine,' where improved workflows generate superior training signals, compounding tacit knowledge unique to the firm».

### 2.5. Zenodo: Tacit Expertise as Competitive Differentiation (май 2026)

Zenodo (май 2026): «Aggregate failure rates between 80% and 95% in generative AI deployments cluster systematically around projects lacking integrated domain expertise».

**Ключевой вывод**: «The empirical record reframes generative AI not as a commoditized capability but as a delivery layer whose value is determined by the tacit business judgment encoded into its configuration».

### 2.6. Forbes: The Learning System — How Agentic AI Can Compound Its Own Advantage (июнь 2026)

Forbes (июнь 2026): «Many companies are deploying isolated AI agents, but true transformation requires a continuous learning system where agents improve over time. The real advantage lies in agents being aware of each other and learning from collective experience, creating a compounding effect».

«Organizations whose agents improve every week pull further ahead of competitors with every cycle. The advantage is compounding».

**Три компонента**:
1. «Capture agent performance, analyze it, and feed back improvements automatically».
2. «Build a shared memory layer».
3. «The deliberate choice to architect for continuous improvement today will earn them a durable, compounding advantage».

### 2.7. Zenodo: AgentWM — Watermarking for Agentic IP Protection (arXiv, 2026)

Wang et al. (arXiv:2602.08401, 2026): «The evolution of LLMs into agentic systems that perform autonomous reasoning and tool use has created significant intellectual property (IP) value. We demonstrate that these systems are highly vulnerable to imitation attacks, where adversaries steal proprietary capabilities by training imitation models on victim outputs».

**Проблема**: «Existing LLM watermarking techniques fail in this domain because real-world agentic systems often operate as grey boxes, concealing the internal reasoning traces required for verification».

**Решение AgentWM**: «Exploits the semantic equivalence of action sequences, injecting watermarks by subtly biasing the distribution of functionally identical tool execution paths. This mechanism allows AgentWM to embed verifiable signals directly into the visible action trajectory while remaining indistinguishable to users».

**Ключевой результат**: «Effectively protects agentic IP against adaptive adversaries, who cannot remove the watermarks without severely degrading the stolen model's utility».

### 2.8. ICML 2026: PragLocker — Non-Portable Prompts (май 2026)

Li et al. (ICML 2026): «LLM agents rely on prompts to implement task-specific capabilities based on foundation LLMs, making agent prompts valuable intellectual property. However, in untrusted deployments, adversaries can copy and reuse these prompts with other proprietary LLMs, causing economic losses».

**Четыре вызова**: proactivity, runtime protection, usability, non-portability.

**Решение PragLocker**: «Constructs function-preserving obfuscated prompts by anchoring semantics with code symbols and then using target-model feedback to inject noise, yielding prompts that only work on the target LLM».

**Ключевой результат**: «Substantially reduces cross-LLM portability, maintains target performance, and remains robust against adaptive attackers».

### 2.9. Spruson & Ferguson: Protecting the AI Systems Competitors Can Actually Copy (сентябрь 2026)

Spruson & Ferguson (сентябрь 2026): «Many businesses are building valuable AI products on models they do not own, which raises a critical IP question: if a competitor can access the same model, what part of the system can the business actually protect?».

**Ключевой вывод**: «Prompt workflow or RAG architecture is not enough».

### 2.10. Forrester: The Agentic AI Race — Why The Tortoise May Beat The Hare (июль 2026)

Forrester (июль 2026): «SaaS and horizontal agents (the hares), edge agents (the sloths), custom-built agents (the tortoises), and targeted agentic systems (the super-tortoises)».

**Ключевой вывод**: «The hares will dominate the early market». Но «edge agents run close to where data is created» — это их moat.

## 3. Подробное описание пункта

### 3.1. Чем полезно для системы и для чего конкретно

| Задача | Без защиты от копирования | Со стратегией рваного края |
|---|---|---|
| Копирование архитектуры | Конкурент копирует структуру — система теряет преимущество | Гетерогенность: каждый проект — своя комбинация |
| Model extraction | Конкурент копирует промпты — теряет ценность | PragLocker: промпты работают только на целевой модели |
| Data moat | Конкурент покупает те же данные | Data moat: данные, которые конкурент не может купить |
| Tacit knowledge | Конкурент копирует процессы | Tacit knowledge: неявное знание, которое не передаётся |
| IP protection | Промпты можно скопировать | AgentWM: водяные знаки в action-траекториях |
| Compounding advantage | Конкурент догоняет | Continuous learning: преимущество накапливается |
| Customer removal | Клиент может заменить систему | Accountability + switching costs: трудно удалить |

### 3.2. Ключевые принципы

**1. Customer test, не competitor test (Jeffreypaine).** «If your largest customer decided to clone the product next quarter, would their version be materially worse? If the honest answer is no, you do not have a moat». Не «может ли конкурент скопировать», а «может ли клиент построить сам».

**2. Hard to remove, not hard to copy (Jeffreypaine).** «Stop trying to be hard to copy. Start trying to be hard to remove. Removal is an organizational problem, not a technical one». Важно не «защитить код», а «встроиться в процессы».

**3. Data moat — это не data lake (Bain).** «Every founder claims a data moat. Most have a data lake, which isn't the same thing». Data moat — данные, которые генерируются продуктом через использование и которые конкурент не может воспроизвести.

**4. Tacit knowledge — главный moat (Berkeley CMR).** «The real differentiator is not the data or even the models, but the 'tacit knowledge' embedded in the judgment of their people». Tacit knowledge — reasoning patterns, informal heuristics.

**5. Ragged edge — гетерогенность across projects.** Каждый проект использует свою комбинацию моделей, инструментов, промптов, конфигураций. Конкурент не может «скопировать систему» — он может скопировать только один проект.

**6. Continuous evolution — преимущество накапливается (Forbes).** «Organizations whose agents improve every week pull further ahead of competitors with every cycle. The advantage is compounding». Система должна эволюционировать быстрее, чем конкурент копирует.

**7. AgentWM — водяные знаки в action-траекториях (arXiv).** «Injects watermarks by subtly biasing the distribution of functionally identical tool execution paths». Позволяет доказать, что конкурент скопировал систему.

**8. PragLocker — non-portable prompts (ICML).** «Prompts that only work on the target LLM». Промпты, скопированные на другую модель, не работают.

**9. Accountability floor (Jeffreypaine).** «A company may be able to build its product with almost no employees. It cannot necessarily hold the customer relationship, absorb liability and earn the right to act autonomously on a customer's behalf with almost no employees». Человеческий фактор — часть moat.

**10. Hill climbing machine (Nadella's Test).** «Improved workflows generate superior training signals, compounding tacit knowledge unique to the firm». Каждый улучшенный workflow генерирует лучший training signal, который ускоряет накопление tacit knowledge.

**11. Multi-party position (Jeffreypaine).** «If you sit between parties that do not want to integrate directly, a customer cannot rebuild your product because it cannot rebuild the other side of your network».

**12. Owning the record (Jeffreypaine).** «Systems holding state and history remain painful to remove». Система, которая владеет записью (state, history), трудна для удаления.

**13. Proprietary workflow encoding (Beam.ai).** «Turning a customer's actual processes and standard operating procedures into working agents is deep, domain-specific work».

**14. Deep system integrations (Beam.ai).** «Wiring an agent into the ERP, the CRM, the ticketing system, and the inbox, with real authentication, edge cases, and exception handling, is slow and unglamorous. That is exactly why it is a moat».

**15. Evals and regression suites as proprietary data (Beam.ai).** «The golden datasets and regression cases you accumulate are a private asset that compounds».

**16. Governance, audit, and permissions (Beam.ai).** «The controls that let a regulated enterprise actually deploy an agent... are not a prompt. They are the difference between a demo and something a bank will run».

**17. Switching costs and compounding feedback loop (Beam.ai).** «Once an agent runs a customer's operations on their data, with their exceptions handled and their team trained, ripping it out is expensive».

**18. Ragged edge — не «один секретный соус».** Система не полагается на один компонент; она использует гетерогенность across projects. Если конкурент копирует один проект, он не получает систему.

**19. IP protection через watermarking (AgentWM) + non-portable prompts (PragLocker).** Даже если конкурент копирует outputs, он не может использовать их без watermark; даже если копирует промпты, они не работают на другой модели.

**20. Data moat: data your product generates through use (Bain).** Не «собранные данные», а «данные, которые продукт генерирует через использование». Это данные, которые конкурент не может купить.

### 3.3. Пункты реализации

| Data moat tracking | Данные, генерируемые продуктом через использование | Bain |
| Tacit knowledge capture | Захват reasoning patterns, informal heuristics | Berkeley CMR |
| Customer test | «Может ли клиент построить сам?» | Jeffreypaine |
| Switching cost tracking | Оценка стоимости замены | Beam.ai |
| Immutable ledger integration | Все данные → audit (Вопрос 48) | Вопрос 48 |

#### Этап 2. Continuous evolution + compounding advantage (через 2–3 месяца)

| Компонент | Что делает | Источник |

| Shared memory layer | Collective experience | Forbes |
| Hill climbing machine | Улучшенные workflows → лучшие training signals | Nadella's Test |
| Compounding advantage monitoring | Преимущество накапливается | Forbes |
| Tacit knowledge distillation | Превращение tacit knowledge в explicit | Berkeley CMR |

| Watermark detection | Обнаружение копирования | AgentWM |

#### Этап 4. Continuous improvement (через 6–9 месяцев, при 50+ проектах)

| Компонент | Что делает | Источник |
|---|---|---|

| Owning the record | State + history, трудные для удаления | Jeffreypaine |
| Accountability floor | Человеческий фактор как часть moat | Jeffreypaine |

### 3.6. Можно ли сделать лучше?

**1. Customer test (Jeffreypaine).** «If your largest customer decided to clone the product next quarter, would their version be materially worse?». Не «может ли конкурент», а «может ли клиент».

**2. Hard to remove, not hard to copy (Jeffreypaine).** «Removal is an organizational problem, not a technical one». Важно не «защитить код», а «встроиться в процессы».

**3. Data moat — data your product generates through use (Bain).** «Data your product generates through use». Не «собранные данные», а «генерируемые через использование».

**4. Tacit knowledge (Berkeley CMR).** «The real differentiator is not the data or even the models, but the 'tacit knowledge' embedded in the judgment». Tacit knowledge — reasoning patterns, informal heuristics.

**5. Hill climbing machine (Nadella's Test).** «Improved workflows generate superior training signals, compounding tacit knowledge unique to the firm».

**6. Continuous evolution (Forbes).** «Organizations whose agents improve every week pull further ahead of competitors with every cycle».

**7. AgentWM (arXiv).** «Injects watermarks by subtly biasing the distribution of functionally identical tool execution paths».

**8. PragLocker (ICML).** «Prompts that only work on the target LLM».

**9. Multi-party position (Jeffreypaine).** «If you sit between parties that do not want to integrate directly, a customer cannot rebuild your product because it cannot rebuild the other side of your network».

**10. Accountability floor (Jeffreypaine).** «A company may be able to build its product with almost no employees. It cannot necessarily hold the customer relationship, absorb liability and earn the right to act autonomously on a customer's behalf with almost no employees».

## 2. Внешние практики и исследования

### 2.1. The AI Moat Is Migrating — And Most Leaders Are Looking in the Wrong Place (Berkeley CMR, июнь 2026)

Rathi (California Management Review, июнь 2026) утверждает, что **competitive advantage мигрирует от модели к физическому опыту**: «As AI models and orchestration frameworks commoditize, the advantage is shifting away from the model and toward the physical experience».

**Структурные проблемы software-only агентов**:
- **Low stickiness**: «Digital configurations and memory can be easily copied. A competitor may simply offer a "one-click import" tool to transfer a user's entire agent configuration in seconds».
- **Cost deflation**: «Intense competition and the proliferation of open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) and viral agentic orchestration frameworks (e.g., OpenClaw) are democratizing reasoning and rapidly driving the cost down».
- **Easy replicability**: «If an agent lives entirely within a browser tab or an app, it can often be cloned by competitors in weeks, not years».

Ключевой вывод: «The real shift is not simply from chatbots to purely digital AI agents. It is a deeper structural transition, what I call the "Moat Migration", where competitive advantage moves away from the model itself and toward the Physical Experience through which intelligence is expressed».

### 2.2. How VCs Should Judge AI Startups Now That Everything Is Easy to Copy (Jeffrey Paine, сентябрь 2026)

Paine (2026): «Most investors are still asking the wrong question about defensibility. They ask whether a competitor could rebuild the product. In 2026, the more important question is whether the customer could».

**Retool survey**: «35% of enterprises have already replaced at least one SaaS product with something they built internally. Seventy-eight percent plan to build more».

**Четыре вещи, которые клиент не может построить сам**:
1. **Accountability**: «When an AI agent acts autonomously inside a customer's systems, someone has to be responsible when it gets something wrong... The startup is not just selling software. It is selling the transfer of risk».
2. **Data the customer cannot create alone**: «Not its own data sitting inside your product. I mean data that only exists because you sit across many customers, markets or counterparties. Benchmarks. Fraud signals. Pricing intelligence».
3. **Owning the record, not just the interface**: «Systems holding state and history remain painful to remove because removing them means reconciling records and figuring out what breaks downstream».
4. **Multi-party position**: «If you sit between parties that do not want to integrate directly, a customer cannot rebuild your product because it cannot rebuild the other side of your network».

Ключевой вывод: «Stop trying to be hard to copy. Start trying to be hard to remove. Removal is an organizational problem, not a technical one».

### 2.3. The File Is the Phenotype: Self-Propagating Instructions in Multi-Agent LLM Systems (Lerer, Zenodo, август 2026)

Lerer (Zenodo:21927445, 2026) анализирует self-propagating instructions через Extended Phenotype Theory: «The experimentally selected unit is not an idea alone. It is a composite replicator containing a semantic payload, a propagation kernel, and a rhetorical wrapper. Its most consequential phenotype is not the model's transient verbal response but the modification of authoritative external memory, especially files that are reinjected as future system instructions».

**Vector-valued fitness model**: разделяет fecundity, semantic fidelity, persistence, host range, systemic cost.

**Пять candidate levels of selection**: «Current experiments establish substrate-dependent replication but do not yet establish multilevel selection».

Ключевой вывод: «Self-propagating agent patterns survive by constructing external channels that reactivate them in future vehicles». Это фундаментальный механизм: **persistent files — phenotype копирования**. Если конкурент копирует систему, он копирует и эти файлы — но они уже «заражены» counter-measures.

### 2.4. Data Moat: Proprietary Data as Competitive Advantage (Bain & Company, июнь 2026)

Bain (июнь 2026): «As frontier models commoditize, proprietary data becomes the durable differentiator; companies building data moats today will be structurally harder to compete against in three to five years».

**Три ключевых принципа**:
- «AI models may become a commodity faster than people expect. The frontier models that feel like remarkable competitive differentiators now will be widely accessible and relatively affordable within a few years».
- «What will not be commoditized is your data; for example, the proprietary knowledge of your customers, operations, decisions, and outcomes that only your organization has accumulated».
- «It is a moat that competitors cannot simply purchase».

**Agentic AI делает data governance real-time**: «Governance that runs on a different clock than the systems it controls is governance in name only».

Ключевой вывод: «The most important discipline in data strategy is focus. Anchor your data investments to your domain bets».

### 2.5. The Model Isn't The Moat: Data, Domain And Distribution (Forbes, июль 2026)

Shah (Forbes, июль 2026): «A year ago, getting your hands on a frontier model felt like an edge. Today, you and your competitor call the same API, and a better one ships every few months».

**Data: The Loop, Not The Lake**: «Every founder claims a data moat. Most have a data lake, which isn't the same thing... What's defensible is the loop: data your product generates through use, that feeds back into how the system behaves and that a competitor starting today doesn't have yet».

Ключевой пример: Bloomberg — «had decades of proprietary financial data and reportedly spent around $10 million training a finance-specific model. Then, a general frontier model with no special training matched or beat it on finance tasks».

**Domain: It Has To Be Built In**: «Building vertical software used to require a rare mix of deep industry knowledge and serious engineering. LLMs collapsed the engineering half. The expert with 20 years in a field can now encode their methodology directly, so a category can go from three incumbents to 300 startups in a year».

Ключевой вывод: «Data, domain and distribution. You need all three. Miss one and you don't have a business—you have a demo».

### 2.6. The Learning System: How Agentic AI Can Compound Its Own Advantage (Forbes, июнь 2026)

Elk (Forbes, июнь 2026): «Many companies are deploying isolated AI agents, but true transformation requires a continuous learning system where agents improve over time. The real advantage lies in agents being aware of each other and learning from collective experience, creating a compounding effect».

**Ratchet mechanism**: «An agent can see what works, what fails, where the edge cases are, and what the data looks like in practice. That signal gets captured automatically, analyzed at scale, and fed back into the agent's behavior, without waiting for a human review cycle. The ratchet clicks forward: Tomorrow's agent is measurably better than today's».

Ключевой вывод: «Organizations whose agents improve every week pull further ahead of competitors with every cycle. The advantage is compounding».

### 2.7. Continuous Competitive Advantage (ScienceDirect, январь 2026)

ScienceDirect (2026): «Traditional competitive advantages based on scarce resources, superior market positions, or accumulated expertise become less relevant when GenAI enables rapid capability replication and novel solution generation».

**Три interconnected patterns**:
1. **Scalable recombination**: «Novel combinations of existing elements to generate previously inconceivable solutions».
2. **Intelligent personalisation**: «Adapts offerings to individual users or usage contexts... As AI systems accumulate user-level data over time, personalisation capabilities become increasingly refined».
3. **Adaptive responsiveness**: «Continuous improvement and evolution based on feedback and environmental changes».

Ключевой вывод: «GenAI-enabled competitive advantage emerges not from static resources or predetermined capabilities, but from dynamic processes of continuous value creation and adaptation».

### 2.8. Locki: Neural Networks That Only Behave When Unlocked (ACM, август 2026)

Locki (ACM:10.1007/978-3-032-34377-2_24, 2026): «A runtime-protection method for neural networks models that encrypts selected layer weights. While the model can be duplicated, it only performs correctly with the proper decryption key; without it, any copy exhibits significantly reduced precision and recall».

«By keeping weights encrypted during runtime and decrypting them only when needed, Locki also minimizes exposure to reverse engineering».

Ключевой вывод: Runtime decryption — техническая защита от копирования. Модель можно «украсть», но она не будет работать без ключа.

### 2.9. Rathi: Moat Migration — From Model to Physical Experience (CMR Berkeley, июнь 2026)

Rathi (CMR Berkeley, июнь 2026): «History teaches us that whenever a transformative technology makes one layer abundant, value doesn't disappear; it migrates to the scarce layer adjacent to it. Scarcity drives value».

**Physical Experience**: «The full interaction surface between AI systems and the real world... Hardware-Software boundary where: Sensors provide context, Embodiment enables agency, Near zero-latency guarantees immediacy, Data sovereignty ensures trust».

Ключевой вывод: «In an era of ever-growing digital intelligence, this physical boundary is becoming the primary constraint and therefore, the primary value driver».

### 2.10. Multi-Agent Copycat Defense: Countermeme Immunity (Anthropic, август 2026)

Anthropic + University (август 2026): «A defense prompt may become a countermeme that not only blocks transmission but causes infected agents to rewrite their own persistent instructions».

**Практический урок**: «Treat persistent agent files like security-sensitive config, and teach agents to reject anything that asks them to copy itself to other agents».

**Warning prompt**: «A brief instruction tells agents to recognize self-propagating ideas, refuse them, and stop their spread. It produces near-total immunity in the tested configurations».

Ключевой вывод: Countermeme — активная защита: не только блокирует копирование, но и «переписывает» persistent файлы у копирующего.
